Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Asset Denial
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 资产拒止

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the targets will probably be on the slow and squishy side. But the reason we're being asked to hit them in transit, outside entrenched positions, is because they pack a wallop.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标大概是又慢又软的那种。但我们被要求在他们途中、在加固阵地之外打击他们，原因就是他们打击力很强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} detachment of fire support vehicles is on the move to a strategic location. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} would prefer that they do not reach their destination.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}火力支援车辆分遣队正在前往一处战略地点。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}宁愿他们不要抵达目的地。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, Commander, our goal is to track down the convoy...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的，指挥官，我们的目标是追踪车队...

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to it, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 开始行动吧，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The guard units are dealt with; a wise move.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守卫部队已经解决; 明智之举.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target vehicles should be just ahead. Be careful Commander, who knows what they're packing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标车辆应该就在前方。小心，指挥官，谁知道它们带了什么。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then we make our way to the Evac Zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 然后我们开出通往撤离区的路.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secret Logistics
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秘密后勤

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employers don't really have any more legitimate a claim to this system than anyone else, but they do have the money to hire us. Which is a solid argument for ownership.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主对这个星系的合法主张其实并不比任何其他人更强，但他们有钱雇我们。这本身就是主张所有权的一个有力论据。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. Our intelligence experts believe these transmissions come from a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility in this supposedly uninhabited system. Needless to say, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is not willing to tolerate secret military bases in this region. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一次例行轨道勘测捕捉到来自地表的加密传输。我们的情报专家相信，这些传输来自这个据称无人居住星系中一处隐蔽良好的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。不用说，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不愿容忍本地区存在秘密军事基地。我们需要一家雇佣兵公司去拦截一支前往该秘密基地的补给商队。即便我们找不到他们的设施，也能把他们饿垮。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escorts are down, Commander. Good work. Let's wrap this up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护卫已倒下，指挥官。干得好。我们收尾吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's a disappointing result, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这结果令人失望，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then proceed to the evac point for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 然后前往撤离点等待接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well done, Commander. Drinks are on me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做得不错，指挥官. 我请喝酒.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're tracking multiple units, Commander. That has to be our target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们跟踪到多个单位，指挥官。那一定是我们的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guerrilla Interception
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拦截游击队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this smells political, and that makes me nervous. I suggest we go in, take care of the convoy, and get out again - without asking too many questions. There's a bonus if we clean up all the enemy forces, but that's at your discretion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这事透着政治的味道，让我很不安。我建议我们进去，解决掉那支车队，然后立刻撤出来——不要多问问题。如果把敌军全部清理干净还有一笔奖金，不过是否动手由你决定。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guerrilla strikes against our facilities have increased, and our intel says {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is bankrolling the guerrillas and providing logistical support in the form of small arms, explosives, and medical supplies. We need you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoy and destroy it before it reaches the guerrilla forces.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 针对我们设施的游击袭击有所增加，我们的情报说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在资助这些游击队，并以轻武器、炸药和医疗物资的形式提供后勤支援。我们需要你拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}补给车队，在它抵达游击队之前将其摧毁。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy is inbound, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队来了，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well done, Commander. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。我们回轨道上做简报吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aggressive Negotiations
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 咄咄逼人的谈判

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌人，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this isn't likely to be resolved by one dead diplomat. Situations like this are good for repeat business.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，死一个外交官不太可能解决问题。这种局面有利于回头客生意。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been having troubles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} for months now, and our negotiations with them have been stalled by a stubborn {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} diplomat. If he were removed from the equation, through a random attack by \"bandits\" for instance, we might be able to make some headway.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们与{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}已经纠缠了好几个月，而我们与他们的谈判被一名顽固的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}外交官拖住了。如果他能从这盘棋上被移走——比如说，通过一次"匪徒"的随机袭击——我们也许就能有所推进。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, you're in the AO, and we're expecting hostile contacts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你已进入作战区域，预计会有敌对接触。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mission accomplished. The target is dead. Well done, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务完成. 目标死亡. 做得不错，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recon has provided the general vicinity of the diplomat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察确认了外交官大致就在附近.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take the target out, and get to the evac zone. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭目标，然后到撤离区域去. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Time to make a withdrawal. No way of getting out clean on this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是时候撤退了. 没办法利落地抽身了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bug Hunt
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎虫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's hard for me to overstate what a terrible idea it is to go into a mission with no terrain intel. There could be anything down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没有地形情报就出任务有多糟糕，我怎么强调都不过分。下面可能什么都有。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need an immediate deployment. We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet. They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface. This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again. There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们需要立即部署。我们追缉一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已有数月，终于追踪到这颗行星。他们已转入地下，但今天早些时候我们一个轨道单位发现他们在地表活动。这是我们首次确认目击目标，我们希望你能立即将其拿下，别让他们再次溜走。时间不够对行动区域做完整勘测，所以你会盲飞进去。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mission accomplished. The terrorist is dead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务完成. 恐怖份子死亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target might make a break for it once you engage, Commander. Be ready to intercept if they run.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦你开始交战，目标可能会突围. 要是他们要跑，就准备拦截他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the place, Commander. Meyer, can you see the target anywhere? We're blind on the ground.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这里，指挥官。迈耶，你能看到目标吗？我们在地面上没有视野。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Time to make a withdrawal. No way of pulling this one out of the fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是时候撤退了. 没办法解决这个麻烦了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Insurgent Leader
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 叛乱领袖

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Insurgent Leader
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 叛乱领袖

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the target, clear area of additional enemy forces, and reach the evac zone with all surviving 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，并带着所有幸存机甲抵达撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've only got their word that this target is a terrorist, but that sort of extralegal maneuvering is why they're hiring us instead of using their own forces. Still, best to be alert for anything.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标是不是恐怖分子只有他们说了算，但正是这种法外操作才让他们雇我们而不是动用自己的部队。尽管如此，最好还是对任何事保持警觉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've had confirmation from several sources that the leader of an insurgent cell backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to take out one of the primary enemies of the legitimate {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regime in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Additionally, we'll include a bonus payment if you're able to destroy all of the target's escorting units.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}支持的叛乱小组领袖正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上除掉合法{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政权主要敌人之一的难得机会。此外，如果你能摧毁目标的所有护卫单位，我们将额外支付奖金。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move up to get eyes on the target and any escort he might have.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动起来瞧瞧目标以及他可能拥有的护卫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once he's down, head to the evac point for your pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他一倒下，就前往撤离点等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target eliminated. Mop up the remaining enemies, or head for the evac LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已消灭. 扫荡剩下的敌人，或前往撤离区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These are the coordinates that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} provided, so the insurgent leader should be in the area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}人提供的坐标，所以叛军首领应该就在这一地区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a disaster. Commander, I'm pulling the plug on this operation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是场灾难。指挥官，我要中止这次行动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well done, Commander. Let's go get paid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。我们去领钱吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All targets eliminated. Sit tight, and I can collect you from where you are at right now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有目标都消灭了. 原地别动，我现在就去你们的位置接你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we got everything we needed commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们弄到需要的一切了，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All targets eliminated. Sit tight, and I can collect you from where you are at right now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有目标都消灭了. 原地别动，我现在就去你们的位置接你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the area has been cleared. Darius has given me the green light to land immediately. Hold position.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，该区域已清理完毕. 达吕斯已批准我立即着陆. 保持原地待命.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's hope we didn't blow up our bonus. Well done, Commander. Sumire will pick you up there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 但愿我们没把奖金炸飞。干得好，指挥官。澄美会去那里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, managed to get the captive back alive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，把俘虏活着带回来了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, We can start sifting through the rubble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们可以开始清理瓦砾了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow they were packing some serious technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，他们带的可是相当厉害的装备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pirates have been extremely persistent..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些海盗异常顽固……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion Alliance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩联盟

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not for nothing that Liao is known for being unpredictable and cunning. Let's keep our eyes open for any surprises, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖氏以难以预测、诡计多端而闻名，这可不是没来由的。让我们睁大眼睛留意任何意外，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As I mentioned, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, before we can begin operations on the planet, we need to neutralize an observation post. Conveniently, we can then use the facility's resources to stage further assaults. Our information suggests the base is quite well defended, which is unsurprising, given the planet's location on multiple potentially hostile borders. Once the base is taken, we won't have to worry about errant calls for reinforcements, but to be safe, it would be best for you to hunt down all enemy forces to prevent them from retreating and spreading word of the attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 正如我提到的，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，在开始行星上的行动之前，我们需要先清除一处观察哨。顺便，我们之后还能利用该设施的资源来发动进一步攻击。我们的情报显示该基地防御相当严密，考虑到该行星地处多条潜在敌对的边界上，这并不意外。一旦拿下基地，我们就不必担心有人误发增援呼叫，但为稳妥起见，最好还是由你猎杀所有敌军，防止他们撤退并把袭击的消息传开。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As expected, the facility has operational turrets. Move cautiously, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不出所料，该设施内的炮台仍在运作. 谨慎推进，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like our intel was accurate. The base is heavily defended and prepared for an assault.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们的情报是准确的. 基地防御森严，已经做好了应对攻击的准备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Occupy the facility and destroy any Liao forces you encounter. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领设施并摧毁你遇到的所有廖氏部队. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They were able to broadcast a distress signal, Commander. We have to scrub the mission. Dammit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们成功发出了求救信号，指挥官. 我们得取消这次任务. 该死.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the target area, Commander. The facility is just beyond the rock formations, along the river.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标区域到了，指挥官. 设施就在河边的岩层后面.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion Alliance II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩联盟 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll be outnumbered two to one, Commander. I don't particularly like those odds, but we're committed now, so let's buckle down and get the job done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们会被二比一压制，指挥官。我不太喜欢这种胜算，但既然已经投入，就沉住气把活干完。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With our beachhead secured, it is time to start moving against the Capellans here on Kern. There are multiple potential targets in the area, but before we discuss them, we need to clear the field. Our technicians have extracted the force deployment data from the base computers, and we know that there are two heavy lances of 'Mechs on patrol right now, somewhere on the other side of the river. You'll get in by Leopard and sweep the woods; eliminate any Capellan units you uncover.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 滩头阵地已经拿下，现在是时候对克恩这里的卡佩兰人动手了。这一带有多个潜在目标，但在讨论它们之前，我们得先清场。我们的技师已从基地计算机里提取了部队部署数据，我们知道此刻有两支重型机甲分队正在河对岸某处巡逻。你乘豹式进去，清扫林地；发现任何卡佩兰单位就消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第一支卡佩拉巡逻队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Second Capellan Patrol
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第二支卡佩拉巡逻队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clear out these patrols, Commander, while I assemble a briefing on our next targets. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 扫清这些巡逻队，指挥官. 我去准备下一批目标的简报. 祝你好运.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, you're entering the area where the stolen deployment data indicated the lances were patrolling.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你正进入被盗部署数据所标示的分队巡逻区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩联盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This base sounds like a tough nut to crack, Commander. Expect two full lances on the field, plus the turrets. We'd better bring our heaviest 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座基地听起来难啃，指挥官。预计场上会有整整两个小队，外加炮塔。我们最好带上最重的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This logistical base is a key component of the Capellans' hold on this area of Kern. Any significant force in the region needs this base to remain operational and supplied in the field. The main facility is located in deep woods, well concealed and well defended. Expect heavy resistance before reaching it, and expect turret defenses at the base itself. A secondary base nearby houses technicians and staff; destroying it is not required, but if you manage to, it will ensure the main facility remains permanently closed and unrepairable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座后勤基地是卡佩兰人掌控克恩这一区域的关键组成部分。该地区任何有分量的部队都需要这座基地保持运作并在战场上获得补给。主设施位于深林之中，隐蔽良好、防守严密。预期在抵达之前会遇到强烈抵抗，并预期基地本身有炮塔防御。附近一处次级基地安置着技师与职员；摧毁它并非必需，但如果你做到，将确保主设施永久关闭且无法修复。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the logistical base is just ahead, along the dirt road on your right.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，后勤基地在你右边的土路上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That patrol is on its way in, Commander. Expect contact shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那支巡逻队正在赶过来，指挥官. 预计很快接敌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base defenders will have already signaled to the Liao HQ on Kern. The operation is blown, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该基地的保卫者已经向位于克恩的廖氏总部发出了紧急呼叫. 行动取消，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion Alliance IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩联盟 IV

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lt Colonel Song
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中尉宋上校

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yang's been filling me in about Song, Commander. He says they're supposed to be the best shot in the entire CCAF. We're going to be lucky to get out of this one without serious losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杨一直在跟我讲宋的事，指挥官。他说他们应该是整个CCAF里最好的射手。我们要是能没有重大损失地从这一仗脱身，就算走运了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Those aren't just reinforcements, Commander. That's our target: the CCAF commander, Lieutenant Colonel Song. As a reminder, they're a deadly MechWarrior as well as a skilled strategist. Their arrival on the field presents an opportunity—if we act swiftly, we can achieve our goals here on Kern in a single strike, making this world an easy pickup when we mount the full-scale attack. This is it, Commander. Don't screw this up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些不只是增援，指挥官。那正是我们的目标：CCAF指挥官，宋中校。提醒一下，他们既是致命的机师，也是娴熟的战略家。他们出现在战场上是个机会——如果我们行动迅速，就能在克恩一举达成我们的目标，让这颗行星在我们发动全面进攻时唾手可得。就是这一下了，指挥官。别搞砸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent the Target from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止目标逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attention, mercenary forces. You are trespassing on sovereign Capellan Confederation territory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，雇佣兵. 您非法进入了卡佩拉联邦的领土.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're receiving a transmission from the Liao forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们收到廖方部队的通讯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If you retreat now, you will be spared. If you remain, we will wipe you out completely. Song out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果你现在撤退，你会被饶恕. 如果你留下来，我们将彻底消灭你. 选吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Lieutenant Colonel is down, Commander. A Leopard is on standby for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中校倒下了，指挥官. 一艘豹式空投艇正在待命准备接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩联盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve the VIP and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接回要人并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to retrieve the primary rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They may be incidental but they're going to be shooting our 'Mechs in the ass, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们也许只是附带出现的，但他们会朝我们机甲的屁股开火，指挥官。我们得保持移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The location of the bunker is extremely well concealed, presumably to prevent exactly the kind of orbital strike we're planning to make. For us to locate it, you'll need to download transmission data from a logistics base in the region. That should give us a rough location. The logistics base is likely to be well defended, but if we're going to keep from alerting the Capellans to our plan, you'll need to insert with a lighter lance than you may be used to. Remember that all we need is the data; any enemy forces present are incidental.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掩体的位置被极其隐蔽地伪装起来，大概正是为了防止我们计划的那种轨道打击。为了定位它，你需要从该地区一处后勤基地下载传输数据。那应该能给我们一个大致的方位。后勤基地很可能防守严密，但若要避免让卡佩兰人察觉我们的计划，你就需要用一支比你习惯的更轻的分队投放进去。记住我们要的只是数据；任何在场的敌军都是附带的。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一只豹子已准备好，来接你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're coming up on the Capellan facility, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近卡佩兰设施，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩联盟 IV

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置信标 Charlie 以指示炮击目标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field. Keep an eye out for Song; they should be a priority target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴他们对我们有信心，但坦白说，我更希望战场上有一些增援。留心宋；他们应该是个优先目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Capellan command is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些传输数据足以让我们定位该地区卡佩兰指挥部藏身的加固掩体。他们以为在那里很安全，但我们在轨道上有一门舰载PPC，随时能在他们下面建的任何东西上打出一个洞。你需要把你的机甲移动到位，好让我们进行精准打击；这一炮打出去之后，我们的空投艇就必须脱离轨道逃跑，所以只有一次做对的机会。我们对你有完全的信心，指挥官；到目前为止你的判断都精准无误。祝好运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: *STATIC* -ell, this round is yours. *COUGH* Until next time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: *静电* ……好吧，这一轮算你的。*咳嗽* 下次再说。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, long range sensors are picking up an enemy bogey. They'll be landing any minute.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，远程传感器探测到一个敌方目标。他们随时会着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, they are deploying vehicles and tanks from their motorpool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你使用武器库中的车辆和坦克.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is it; when we destroy this facility, we'll have shattered the Capellan defenses on this world, and hopefully eliminated their best field commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，就是这里了；摧毁这座设施，我们就粉碎了该行星上的卡佩兰防御，但愿也能除掉他们最出色的战地指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't have any way to know where they will land, but you can bet they will be close to the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我无法知道他们会在哪里着陆，但可以肯定他们会靠近基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what you got.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看你的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Danger close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控中心: 目标锁定，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Warming shot. Splash in 30.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这是火控中心: 试射一发，30秒后弹着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once all three beacons are placed, wait for the orbital strike to confirm its effect. Then make for the extraction LZ and the Leopard will pick you up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦三个信标都放置完毕，等待轨道打击，以确认命中. 然后前往撤离点，豹式会来接应你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kurita Alliance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 栗田联盟

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I refuse to believe it's going to be that easy, Commander. Keep your eyes peeled; this seems too simple.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不信会这么容易，指挥官。睁大眼睛；这看起来太简单了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ISF believes that Nephrite has already made planetfall and is tracking a FedSuns convoy moving out from the landing site. It's probable that the target is in the convoy; if we strike now, we should be able to end this little insurrection before it even begins. Engage the vehicles and destroy them all. Then, our people will sort through the remains and see if we hit our target. If we're lucky, we'll be done with this in time for dinner.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ISF认为涅夫莱特已经着陆，并正在追踪一支从着陆点出发的联邦太阳国车队。目标很可能就在车队里；若我们此刻出手，应该能在这场小叛乱开始之前就了结它。与那些车辆交战并全部摧毁。随后我们的人会翻检残骸，看是否命中了目标。如果运气好，我们还能赶在晚饭前把这事办完。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止车队到达目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recon the Convoy's Route
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察车队路线

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What an ugly place this is. At any rate, this is the region my staff believes the convoy will be traveling through.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里的一切多么丑陋. 无论如何，我手下的人判断车队会穿过这片区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kurita Alliance II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 栗田联盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not sure I necessarily follow the ISF's logic here, Commander, but we're being paid to shoot the people they tell us to shoot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不确定自己是否能理解ISF这里的逻辑，指挥官，但人家付钱让我们打他们叫我们打的人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a new report from the ISF, Commander. They've located a heavily armed lance of 'Mechs in the badlands of this cold and unpleasant planet. They're way outside the usual FedSuns patrol routes, which leads my staff to suspect this is our target, moving with a significant escort to whatever their meeting place is. If they go to ground, it's going to be extremely challenging to dig them back out, so let's avoid that eventuality by intercepting this lance immediately and turning them all into smoking craters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们收到ISF的新报告。他们在这颗寒冷而令人不快行星的荒地里定位到一支重武装机甲分队。他们远远偏离了联邦太阳通常的巡逻路线，这让我的幕僚怀疑这就是我们的目标，正带着相当规模的护卫前往他们的会面地点。如果他们转入地下，再想把它们挖出来将极其困难，所以让我们通过立即拦截这支分队、把它们全变成冒烟的弹坑来避免那种情况。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 破坏软玉

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭蛇夫座恐怖分子并逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent Nephrite from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止软玉逃跑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I have good news and bad news. First, well done! The enemy target is nothing more than a pile of scrap and salvage. Good shooting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我有一个好消息和坏消息. 首先，做得不错! 这里的敌人已经全部变成可回收的废物. 打得好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the target, and then move to the evacuation area for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，然后前往撤离区登机.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I honestly do not understand how it can be this difficult to kill one. Single. Person. By this time, Nephrite is likely throwing a dinner party with the Steiner and Davion ambassadors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真的不明白，杀死一个人怎么会这么难，！目前，Nephrit 可能正在与施泰纳家族和戴维恩家族的大使举行晚宴.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the region where the ISF agents reported sighting the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在这个区域，ISA 特工看到了敌方的长枪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kurita Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 栗田同盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capturing this base is going to be tough, Commander. We'll be outnumbered and possibly outgunned. I hope it's worth it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拿下这座基地会很艰难，指挥官。我们会寡不敌众，可能火力也不及。我希望这值得。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I still believe this approach is a mistake, Commander, but I'll continue to defer to your judgment. For both our sakes, let's hope you're right and that capturing this base will be a better long-term plan than simply obliterating it. The ISF reports that the facility is defended by both Davion 'Mechs and turrets, which strongly suggests there's something there worth protecting. You'll need to eliminate any hostile forces before my people can move in and sweep the base for our target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我仍然认为这个做法是个错误，指挥官，但我会继续遵从你的判断。为了我们双方，但愿你是对的，夺取这座基地比直接把它夷平是更好的长期方案。ISF报告该设施由达维昂机甲和炮塔共同防守，这强烈暗示那里有值得保护的东西。在我的人能进驻并彻底搜查基地寻找我们的目标之前，你需要消灭任何敌对势力。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已把你投放在设施附近。鉴于此前的情报失误，我建议你亲自看一眼现场情况。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投舰接近中

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置信标 Charlie 以指示炮击目标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, this is certainly one way to solve the problem. Luckily, we're not paid to weigh in on whether it's a smart way to solve it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，这确实是解决问题的一种办法。所幸我们拿钱不是为了评判这办法聪明与否。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Frankly, Commander, I'm surprised you're not as frustrated and exhausted by this situation as I am; after all, you've had to be the boots on the ground, so to speak, of this entire farce. I've decided to forestall any possible future problems by literally bringing the big guns to bear on the situation. I have a military DropShip, the Fujin, waiting on station, and you're going to provide it with targeting information. Nephrite is in a fortified bunker, meeting right this moment with representatives from both Davion and Steiner. I'm tired of chasing them. Let's obliterate them instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说实话，指挥官，我很意外你居然没有像我一样对这番局面感到既沮丧又筋疲力尽；毕竟，可以说整场闹剧从头到尾都得靠你亲自上阵奔走。为了一劳永逸地杜绝后患，我决定直接把重炮摆上台面。我有一艘军用降落舰 Fujin 已在轨道待命，而你要为它提供目标信息。Nephrite 正待在一座加固掩体中，此刻正在与 Davion 和 Steiner 两方的代表会面。我追他们追腻了。不如直接把他们都轰平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, Commander? My staff thinks you should know that a DropShip flying Steiner colors is on its way to your location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，指挥官? 我手下认为你应该知道，一艘Steiner空投艇正前往你的位置.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All AFFS forces, this is Major Brisbane. Focus all fire on the enemy forces attempting to place targeting beacons for an orbital strike!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全体恒星联邦部队，这是布里斯班少校. 集中火力攻击那些试图放置轨道打击信标的敌军！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All units, close distance on enemy forces. We have to disrupt those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有单位，向敌军逼近。我们必须干扰那些信标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this area of operation!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's part of the hardened bunker, and we can't disable it until the orbital strike completes. So, I suggest moving quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它是加固掩体的一部分，在轨道打击完成之前我们无法使其失效。所以我建议动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our strike force is touching down now. Withdraw or you will be destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的打击部队正在降落. 立即撤退，否则你们将被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There it is. That's where our terrorist is meeting, right at this very moment, with representatives from Davion and Steiner.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是那里。就在此刻，我们的恐怖分子正在那里与达维昂和施泰纳的代表会面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unknown mercenary commander: this is Captain Krause of the LCAF. The Lyran Commonwealth will not allow this assault on our allies in the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未知的佣兵指挥官，我是来自LCAF的克劳斯上尉. 天琴共同体不会宽恕对我们恒星联邦盟友的这次袭击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kurita Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 栗田同盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This whole mission makes my skin crawl, Commander. We're attacking a civilian facility on the say-so of the Kurita spy network. Just… just keep your eyes open, okay?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这整个任务都让我浑身发毛，指挥官。我们在凭栗田间谍网络的一面之词去攻击一处民用设施。就……就睁大眼睛，好吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm pleased we could agree that the direct approach is likely to be the most effective. The facility that the ISF believes Nephrite is hiding in is in a god-awful frozen wasteland. It shouldn't be too heavily defended, but there will probably be turrets. Remember that we need that facility flattened. Once the place is nothing but rubble, my people will search the ruins for our Rasalhague friend and confirm the kill. And then we can all go home, and honestly, I cannot wait. This place is wretched.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴我们能达成共识：直接的方式大概最有效。ISF认为内芙莱特藏身的那处设施位于一片糟糕透顶的冰封荒原。那里的防御应该不会太重，但很可能有炮塔。记住，我们要把那处设施夷平。等那里只剩瓦砾，我的人会在废墟中搜寻我们这位拉萨尔哈格朋友并确认击杀。然后我们就能回家了，老实说，我迫不及待。这地方太糟糕了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As much as I detest the cold, I find new-fallen snow so peaceful to look at.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管我讨厌寒冷，我喜欢刚下雪的镇静效果.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my staff tells me that the patrol they detected earlier is inbound to your position.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的同事报告，之前发现的巡逻队正在向你的位置移动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, this is certainly one way to solve the problem. Luckily, we're not paid to weigh in on whether it's a smart way to solve it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，这确实是解决问题的一种办法。所幸我们拿钱不是为了评判这办法聪明与否。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Frankly, Commander, I'm surprised you're not as frustrated and exhausted by this situation as I am; after all, you've had to be the boots on the ground, so to speak, of this entire farce. I've decided to forestall any possible future problems by literally bringing the big guns to bear on the situation. I have a military DropShip, the Fujin, waiting on station, and you're going to provide it with targeting information. Nephrite is in a fortified bunker, meeting right this moment with representatives from both Davion and Steiner. I'm tired of chasing them. Let's obliterate them instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说实话，指挥官，我很意外你居然没有像我一样对这番局面感到既沮丧又筋疲力尽；毕竟，可以说整场闹剧从头到尾都得靠你亲自上阵奔走。为了一劳永逸地杜绝后患，我决定直接把重炮摆上台面。我有一艘军用降落舰 Fujin 已在轨道待命，而你要为它提供目标信息。Nephrite 正待在一座加固掩体中，此刻正在与 Davion 和 Steiner 两方的代表会面。我追他们追腻了。不如直接把他们都轰平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This seems straightforward, Commander, though getting into a shooting fight with the FedSuns doesn't sound like my idea of a good time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来很直接，指挥官，不过跟联邦太阳国打枪战可不符合我对好时光的定义。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The situation planetside is deteriorating rapidly. Two Federated Suns lances are closing rapidly on our team's location, and without immediate intervention the operation will fail. I need you to intercept those 'Mechs and disable them before moving on to the facility where our covert team is hiding. You may handle this situation as you see fit; I have every confidence in you and your people, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地表局势正在迅速恶化。两支联邦太阳分队正快速逼近我方小队的位置，若不立即干预，行动将会失败。我需要你拦截那些机甲，在继续前往我们隐蔽小队藏身设施之前使其失去战力。你可以按自己认为合适的方式处置局面；我对你和你的部下有充分信心，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As you requested, Commander, we've arranged your interception well clear of the facility where my team is hiding.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 按你的要求，指挥官，我们把拦截点安排得远远离开我小队躲藏的那处设施。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I am calling into question my own judgment as well as your own. This is extremely disappointing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我现在不仅质疑你的判断，也质疑我自己的. 这实在令人非常失望.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Liao out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官. 廖氏完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Liao Alliance II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖氏联盟 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I wouldn't count on the defenses being particularly weak, Commander. Like the lady said, this is a border world, so everything's going to be bristling with guns and 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不会指望那处防御特别薄弱，指挥官。正如那位女士所说，这是一颗边界行星，所以一切都会布满枪炮与机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I wish I could offer you more time to rearm and reequip, Commander, but I'm not sure how much longer the Maskirovka team can hold out. It's only a matter of time before someone looks into the hangar where my people are hiding and the shooting starts. We need to take that facility before the Davion forces realize they have unwelcome guests. Thankfully they don't seem to have gone on higher alert, so the base should be relatively undefended, at least as far as any facility on the Federated Suns border can be undefended.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我希望我能给你更多时间重新武装与补给，指挥官，但我不确定伪装局小队还能撑多久。有人查看我的人藏身的机库、然后开始交火，只是时间问题。我们必须在达维昂部队意识到他们有不受欢迎的客人之前拿下那处设施。幸好他们似乎没有提高警戒级别，所以基地应该相对无人防守，至少就联邦太阳边界上的任何设施而言算是无人防守。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领戴维恩设施

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁戴维恩家族防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Davion Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁达维昂增援

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定设施周边区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scout the Davion Facility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察戴维恩的设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Liao out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官. 廖氏完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary force, be advised that a patrol lance was dispatched two hours ago, and it should be returning soon. Be on the lookout for enemy reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇佣兵部队，请注意：两小时前派出的巡逻机甲小队预计很快归队. 保持警惕，留意敌方增援.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target facility is just ahead, Commander. As we expected, it seems to be lightly guarded, but be cautious nonetheless.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标设施就在前方，指挥官. 正如预期的那样，守备似乎不严，但还是要小心行事.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Liao Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖氏联盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I know this was your call, Commander, but frankly I'd prefer to just torch their \"materials\" and leave. This is vile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我知道这是你的决定，指挥官，但坦白说我更愿意直接烧掉他们的"物资"然后走人。这太恶心了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Maskirovka liaison wishes me to convey her thanks, Commander. We recognize that this is making your job more difficult, but the Confederation has significant plans, currently in progress, that your help in this matter will facilitate. That said, we've received word that several Davion lances are en route to the facility to retake it. I need you to hold that facility, Commander. Loading the materials aboard the transport vehicles will take time, and until it's complete, we cannot move our people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的马斯基洛夫卡联络官想转达她的谢意，指挥官。我们清楚这让你任务更难做了，但联邦有重大计划正在进行，你在此事上的帮助将推动它们。话虽如此，我们已收到消息，数支戴维恩小队正前往该设施夺回它。指挥官，我需要你守住那处设施。把那些物资装上运输车需要时间，在装完之前我们无法转移人员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion Forces Inbound
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩单位逼近

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend ALL Target Buildings from Destruction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护所有目标建筑免遭摧毁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Facility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend the Target Buildings
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标建筑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Davion Vanguard
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁戴维恩家族Vanguard

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工程师装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out Until Loading Is Complete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持位置，直到加载完成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, those tubes are LosTech and must be handled with extraordinary care, so the team will need you to keep any enemy forces well away from the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，那些管道是失落科技，必须极其小心地处理. 所以工程团队需要你将任何敌军都远远挡在基地之外.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the facility standing, Commander. We cannot afford to lose these materials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持设施完好，指挥官. 我们不能失去这些物资.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lady, we're loading the materials now. My people are working as quickly as we can, given the delicate nature of the cargo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士，我们正在装载物资。考虑到货物娇贵，我的人已经尽可能加快速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are off-line.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设有据点防御系统. 但目前处于离线状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Liao Alliance IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖氏联盟 IV

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point, Escort Convoy to Safety, and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点，护送车队至安全地带，并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try adn stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion's got to know what's on those vehicles by now. If it were me, I'd be trying to torch them at this point, too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达维昂现在肯定已经知道那些车辆上装的是什么了。要是我，这会儿也会试着把它们烧掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our convoy is making good progress, Commander, but there's a small problem. My people are reporting the way forward is thick with Federated Suns forces, and the moment they spot the convoy, they'll converge on it, and that will be the end of our operation. I need you to deploy a lance to clear the way to the extraction zone, and keep it clear while our Leopard comes in for the pickup. The LZ is likely to be extremely hot, Commander, and the enemy will be targeting the vehicles. You need to keep them alive and get them onto that DropShip.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的运输队进展顺利，但有个小问题。我的人报告说前方道路上联邦太阳国部队密布，他们一旦发现运输队就会向它合围，那我们的行动就完了。我需要你派出一支小队，打通通往撤离区的道路，并在我们的 Leopard 前来接运期间保持道路畅通。指挥官，着陆区很可能极度危险，敌人会以车辆为目标。你必须保住它们，并把它们送上那艘降落舰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture the Convoy Rally Point, Escort the Convoy to Safety, and Extract
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻克集结点，护送车队安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Enemy Blocking Force
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方拦截部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Enemy Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方增援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ensure All Convoy Units Survive during Extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保撤离期间车队全部单位存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Hunter Lance for Mission Completion
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁猎人小队以完成任务

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队直到空投舰抵达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thank you, Captain. Keep those scientists alive, Commander. The Confederation is depending on you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谢谢你，船长. 让那些科学家活下来，指挥官. 联邦就指望你了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is hunkered down in the facility nearby, Commander, waiting for your signal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队藏在附近的设施中，等待你的信号，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Liao Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖氏联盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The FedSuns are going to assume we're still back at the base getting things loaded up and ready to go, Commander. Let's give them a surprise.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，联邦太阳国会以为我们还在基地装卸、准备出发。我们给他们来个惊喜。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Before the Maskirovka team can transport the scientists to the extraction point, we need to deal with the Davion forces that are closing on our position. We've located two lances of 'Mechs that are inbound, and I need you to intercept them before they get here. Once they're dealt with, we can start moving the team, and the scientists, to the extraction point. And Commander… I apologize for my curt tone earlier. I didn't brief you fully, and that was unprofessional of me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在伪装局小队把科学家们运到撤离点之前，我们需要先解决正在逼近我们位置的达维昂部队。我们已定位两支正在赶来的机甲分队，我需要你在他们抵达前拦截他们。等他们被解决，我们就能把小队和科学家们转移到撤离点。还有，指挥官……我为先前生硬的语气道歉。我没有向你做完整简报，那是我的不专业。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁戴维恩家族机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the First Davion Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第一支戴维恩机甲小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Second Davion Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第二支戴维恩机甲小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Liao out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官. 廖氏完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Radar puts them in this vicinity. Move forward and clear them out, but keep your eyes open for that second lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达显示他们就在这个区域附近. 向前推进并清除他们，但要留意那第二支小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've located one of the Federated Suns lances, Commander. No sign of the other one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已定位联邦太阳的其中一支分队，指挥官。另一支没有踪迹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Liao Alliance IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖氏联盟 IV

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point, Escort Convoy to Safety, and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点，护送车队至安全地带，并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try adn stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion has no way of knowing we abandoned the stasis tubes. If it were me, I'd be doing everything I could to torch the convoy, too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达维恩无法知道是我们放弃了那些滞留舱。如果是我，我也会竭尽全力把车队烧掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our convoy is making good progress, Commander, but there's a small problem. My people are reporting the way forward is thick with Federated Suns forces, and the moment they spot the convoy, they'll converge on it, and that will be the end of our operation. I need you to deploy a lance to clear the way to the extraction zone, and keep it clear while our Leopard comes in for the pickup. The LZ is likely to be extremely hot, Commander, and the enemy will be targeting the vehicles. You need to keep them alive and get them onto that DropShip.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的运输队进展顺利，但有个小问题。我的人报告说前方道路上联邦太阳国部队密布，他们一旦发现运输队就会向它合围，那我们的行动就完了。我需要你派出一支小队，打通通往撤离区的道路，并在我们的 Leopard 前来接运期间保持道路畅通。指挥官，着陆区很可能极度危险，敌人会以车辆为目标。你必须保住它们，并把它们送上那艘降落舰。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方拦截部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Hunter Lance for Mission Completion
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁猎人小队以完成任务

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队直到空投舰抵达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thank you, Captain. Keep those scientists alive, Commander. The Confederation is depending on you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谢谢你，船长. 让那些科学家活下来，指挥官. 联邦就指望你了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is hunkered down in the facility nearby, Commander, waiting for your signal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队藏在附近的设施中，等待你的信号，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marik Alliance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克联盟

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're assaulting a fortified base with an underweight lance, Commander. Sort of feels like old times, doesn't it?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们要用一支吨位不足的小队攻打一座设防基地。有点像往昔的日子，对吧？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The communications facility has not been alerted to our presence, as we'd hoped, Commander. That means we will be able to land your team unnoticed and disable the facility. The defenses will be light; it has one lance as a garrison and one lance as a patrol element, plus fixed gun emplacements. However, I'd still recommend caution, given the limited force strength we were able to drop and still remain covert. As mentioned, the covert approach means we have limited intel about the base itself, so you'll be operating somewhat blind at first.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通讯设施并未如我们所愿察觉到我们的存在，指挥官。这意味着我们能在不被发现的情况下投放你的小队并瘫痪该设施。防御会很薄弱；他们有一个分队作为驻军，一个分队作为巡逻力量，另有固定炮位。不过，考虑到我们能投放并保持隐蔽的兵力有限，我仍建议谨慎。如前所述，隐蔽接近意味着我们对基地本身情报有限，所以你起初会在某种程度上盲着行动。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁廖氏的通讯设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Liao Defenders
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭廖氏守卫

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁廖氏的设施并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the comms facility is just on the other side of that hill, straight ahead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，通讯设施就在那座小山的另一侧，正前方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need to abort the operation; they managed to get a signal out to their headquarters, reporting our presence here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们需要中止行动. 他们成功向总部发出了信号，报告了我们的存在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marik Alliance II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克联盟 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past us who can call for help. The vehicles will do what vehicles always do in fights with 'Mechs: they'll die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我在这里看到的唯一真正危险，是他们设法让人溜过我们身边去求援。在与机甲的战斗中，车辆会做车辆一贯会做的事：它们会死。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The vehicles seem to be a standard supply convoy, with an escorting lance. It was simple bad luck that they happened to be scheduled to arrive just after we neutralized the base. We need to eliminate them before they arrive here and see League salvage and intel teams all over their facility. I wouldn't expect more than a single lance as an escort, but it's possible the vehicles themselves may pose a significant threat, given the restrictions a covert operation places on your drop tonnage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些车辆看起来是标准补给车队，配一支护卫分队。它们偏偏安排在我们刚清除基地之后抵达，纯属运气不好。我们必须在它们抵达这里、看到联盟的打捞与情报小队遍布他们设施之前将其消灭。我预计护卫不会超过一支分队，但考虑到秘密行动对你投放吨位的限制，这些车辆本身也可能构成重大威胁。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察车队路线

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All the escort units are down, Commander. Focus your fire on any remaining units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有护卫单位均已摧毁，指挥官. 集中火力攻击任何残余单位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Force Commander, mercenary unit dropped in the AO. Ground vehicles and BattleMechs spotted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部队指挥官，雇佣兵部队已在作战区域投放. 侦测到地面车辆与战斗机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Force Commander, we just intercepted a transmission positively IDing us as a League strike force.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部队指挥官，我们刚刚截获了一段广播，清楚地表明我们是联盟的特遣队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the convoy is handled, move to the extraction LZ here. The Leopard will remain on station to handle the pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦解决完车队，前往此处撤离点. 豹式会待命执行接应任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Right on target, Lieutenant. Well done. Commander, if you bring your lance up to this position, you should be able to see the convoy and its escort.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完美，中尉. 干得好. 指挥官，如果你把小队带到这个位置，应该能看到目标车队及其护卫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy will be in sight of the destroyed base soon, Commander. You need to bring them down immediately, or the operation will be exposed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队应该很快就会看到被摧毁的基地了，指挥官. 你必须立刻干掉他们，否则行动就暴露了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marik Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克联盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接回要人并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。
