Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Should be a simple pickup job, Commander, but remember that we're going in light, which means the pickup 'Mech is going to be more vulnerable than usual.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 应该是一份简单的接送活，指挥官，但记住我们是轻装前往，这意味着接人的那台机甲会比平常更脆弱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our operative, Jawad, is in deep cover at the naval logistics base on this tiny island, Commander. Once you arrive at the facility, he'll break cover and board your unit in the rumble seat. Then you just need to get him and the data he carries out of the facility. We'll have the Leopard on standby to pick you up. Because you're going in quiet, the facility shouldn't be alerted to our insertion, and the opposition should be light.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的特工贾瓦德正深藏在这个小岛上的海军后勤基地里，指挥官。你一抵达该设施，他就会现身并坐进你的单位副驾驶位。然后你只需要把他和他携带的数据带出设施。我们会让豹式待命接应你。由于你是静默进入，该设施不应察觉我们的投放，抵抗应该很轻。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Expect light opposition. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 预计会遇到轻微抵抗. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary unit deployed, Force Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇佣兵被废黜，部队指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once you have our operative, continue clockwise to reach the designated extraction LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦你接到我们的特工，就继续顺时针前进，到达指定的撤离着陆区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Signal from Jawad, Force Commander Singh. He has eyes on our friendlies and is moving out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来自贾瓦德的信号，部队指挥官辛格. 他已确认友方位置并开始撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marik Alliance IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克联盟 IV

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 防空炮塔

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 忠义哲原

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻击设施并为火力任务标记区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All this covert action has my nerves wound tight. I'm glad we're finally getting to flex our muscles a bit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些秘密行动搞得我神经紧绷。很高兴我们终于能活动活动筋骨了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're approaching the joint research base, Commander. Once you're in the AO, you'll need to move up to the base and set beacons to triangulate around it so that our covert DropShip, the Airavata, can transmit the authentication code and download the research data. We have a limited window of opportunity before the Liao ships in orbit detect our presence and come to investigate, so you'll be operating under a relatively tight timeline. So far, we've managed to keep things quiet, so while I expect significant opposition, you should be able to handle it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在接近联合研究基地，指挥官。一旦你进入行动区域，你需要推进到基地并设置信标对其进行三角定位，好让我们的隐蔽空投艇艾拉瓦塔能传送认证代码并下载研究数据。轨道上的廖氏舰船探测到我们并前来调查之前，我们的时间窗口有限，所以你将在相对紧张的时间表下作业。到目前为止，我们一直成功保持安静，所以虽然我预计会遇到可观的抵抗，你应该应付得来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 认证已确认. 传输开始.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, they are deploying vehicles and tanks from their motor pool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你使用武器库中的车辆和坦克.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the pressure on to deny them the chance to place those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持压制，防止他们有机会放置信标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary unit is on the ground in the area of operation, Force Commander Singh.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇佣兵部队已在作战区着陆，部队指挥官辛格.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once all three beacons are placed, wait for confirmation that our DropShip has received the data. Then, make for the extraction LZ and the Leopard will pick you up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦三个信标都放置完毕，请等待空投艇确认接收数据的信号. 随后立即前往撤离点，豹式会来接应你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upload complete. We have successfully transmitted the data.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 上传完成. 我们已经成功传输了数据.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marik Alliance III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克联盟 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve the VIP and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接回要人并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to retrieve the primary rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I doubt they'll have been able to get more than a single backup lance over to this remote island in the time they'll have before we show up, guns blazing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我怀疑在我们带着枪炮出现之前，他们来不及往这座偏远小岛再调一个后备小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our operative, Jawad, is in deep cover at the naval logistics base on this tiny island, Commander. Once you arrive at the facility, he'll break cover and board your unit in the rumble seat. Then you just need to get him and the data he carries out of the facility. We'll have the Leopard on standby to pick you up. We're going in loud, Commander, which means the facility is going to know you're coming. Be prepared for heavy resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的特工贾瓦德正深藏在这座小岛上的海军后勤基地里。你抵达设施后，他会现身并坐进你单位的简易座椅。接下来你只需把他和他携带的数据带出设施。我们会让豹式待命接你。指挥官，这次我们是大张旗鼓地进去，也就是说设施会知道你要来。做好迎击顽抗的准备。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blast. They must have caught him uploading the data on their facilities. Is there anything else, Lieutenant?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该死！他们肯定是在他上传数据时抓住了他. 还有其他情况吗，中尉?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Force Commander Singh, we're picking up a tight-beam transmission coming from the secondary facility in the lagoon. It's our operative's distress signal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 辛格部队指挥官，我们收到来自潟湖中次级设施的一束窄波通讯。那是我们干员的求救信号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: He knew the risks of this operation. Commander, get that data out intact. Make his death mean something.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他知道这次行动的风险. 指挥官，把那些数据完整带出来. 让他的死有所意义.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果他们正等着我们，指挥官，那下面会有多少单位就说不准了。这会变得很乱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're approaching the joint research base, Commander. Once you're in the AO, you'll need to move up to the base and set beacons to triangulate around it so that our covert DropShip, the Airavata, can transmit the authentication code and download the research data. We have a limited window of opportunity before the Liao ships in orbit detect our presence and come to investigate, so you'll be operating under a relatively tight timeline. Be aware that my people picked up a very large spike in comms chatter right after our previous mission, so they're expecting you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在接近联合研究基地，指挥官。一旦你进入行动区域，你需要推进到基地并设置信标对其进行三角定位，好让我们的隐蔽空投艇艾拉瓦塔能传送认证代码并下载研究数据。轨道上的廖氏舰船探测到我们并前来调查之前，我们的时间窗口有限，所以你将在相对紧张的时间表下作业。请注意，我的人在上次任务之后立刻截获了一次极为剧烈的通讯量激增，所以他们在等着你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once all three beacons are placed, wait for confirmation that our DropShip has received the data. Then, make for the extraction LZ and the Leopard will pick you up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦三个信标都放置完毕，请等待空投艇确认接收数据的信号. 随后立即前往撤离点，豹式会来接应你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upload complete. We have successfully transmitted the data.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 上传完成. 我们已经成功传输了数据.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This trafficking ring has to be put to a stop immediately Commander. We can't allow any more Nekos or Magistracy citizens to be captured
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这条贩运链必须立即制止，指挥官。我们不能再容许任何猫娘或治安官辖区公民被掳走

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As discussed previously {COMMANDER.LastName}, it is essential that you pounce on any defenders and capture this Neko Holding Facility before my fellow members of MEOW can be shipped away. Once under our control, we’ll have to make our hasty exit stage wherever. You'll have to keep the facility safe while we whisk any prisoners into our protection
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如前所述{COMMANDER.LastName}，你必须扑向任何守军并在我的MEOW同僚被运走之前夺取这处猫娘关押设施。一旦它归我们控制，我们就得从某个地方匆匆退场。在我们把任何囚犯纳入我们的保护之下时，你得保证设施安全

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the target area, Commander. Move forward with caution, eliminate any defenders and capture the Neko Holding Facility. Please, keep the prisoners safe and remember we're sensitive!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这就是目标区域，指挥官。谨慎推进，消灭任何守军并夺取猫娘关押设施。拜托，保证囚犯安全，记住我们很敏感！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'd usually expect well trained pilots with expensive gear Commander, but this time I'm not so sure. You'll have to assess the situation for yourself, but all this 'training' of theirs might just be nonsense. As always, use caution. We can't fail now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，通常我会预期遇到训练有素、装备昂贵的飞行员，但这次我不太确定。你只能自己判断局势了，而他们那套“训练”可能纯属胡扯。一如既往，谨慎行事。我们现在不能失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There were far more prisoners than originally anticipated, but thankfully due to your company's bravery and my quick thinking we were able to rescue them all. However, in the kerfuffle, one of the weeb leaders responsible for this outrage has blockaded our escape route. We’ll have to teleport behind them and take their forces down before we can escape. Don't let these fools stand in our way for a moment longer, let's show them the fury of a Canopian scorned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 俘虏比最初预估的多得多，但幸亏有你们连队的勇敢和我的机敏，我们得以把他们全部救出。不过在一阵混乱中，一个应对这场暴行负责的二次元头目封锁了我们的逃生路线。我们得瞬移到他们背后，在逃离之前先解决他们的部队。别让这些蠢货再多挡我们一刻，让他们见识被激怒的卡诺帕人的怒火。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你正进入我们侦察兵上次报告二次元们潜伏的区域

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡诺帕斯 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This base sounds like a tough nut to crack, Commander. Expect two full lances on the field, plus the turrets. We'd better bring our heaviest 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座基地听起来难啃，指挥官。预计场上会有整整两个小队，外加炮塔。我们最好带上最重的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This neko holding facility was specifically designed to keep us locked up with minimal risk of escape. Unfortunately we cannot commit to fully destroying it at this time for fear of damaging any of our equipment or any information pertaining to the location of Nyanderthal era artifacts. I’ve marked key structures to eliminate so we can recover the vital objectives later. This will be tricky, as while we were evacuating the prisoners additional forces have moved in to hold this position. That, and the heavy turrets...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这处猫娘关押设施专门设计为以最小逃脱风险把我们关住。不幸的是，由于担心损坏我们的任何装备或任何与尼安德特时代遗物位置有关的信息，我们目前无法承诺把它彻底摧毁。我已标出需要清除的关键建筑，以便我们稍后能回收重要目标。这会有难度，因为在我们撤离囚犯时，又有额外部队进驻守住这个位置。再加上那些重型炮塔……

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the facility is just up ahead. Get visuals and remain cautious.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，设施就在前方。获取视觉信息并保持谨慎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yang's been filling me in about this Maurice person, Commander. He says the mech signature reads like nothing he's ever seen, but the piloting appears wonky and unconfident. Be aware of any supporting forces, they may pose the real threat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杨一直在跟我讲这个叫莫里斯的人，指挥官。他说那台机甲的信号特征是他从没见过的，但驾驶手法看起来别扭而缺乏自信。留意任何支援部队，他们可能才是真正的威胁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've cornered them Commander, intel suggest his real name is 'Maurice', the vile ogre responsible for this atrocity. He speaks highly of his own skills on the battlefield but I'm not so certain at all. You'll have to determine that with your own wits, but we warned: His mech is sporting rather rare, expensive gear. It appears as though he hasn’t spared a dime on equipment. Let's slaughter this revolting individual and be done with it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们把他们逼到角落了，指挥官，情报显示他的真名是"莫里斯"，这场暴行的元凶、那个可憎的食人魔。他对自己在战场上的本领评价很高，可我一点也不确定。你得靠自己的判断力去验证，但我们要提醒你：他的机甲装备着相当稀有昂贵的器材。看来他在装备上不惜血本。让我们宰了这个令人作呕的家伙，了结此事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're recieving a transmission from... well our target himself. On screen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们收到一条来自……嗯，来自我们目标本人的通讯。在屏幕上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: MoC III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡诺帕斯 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve the VIP and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接回要人并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to retrieve the primary rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remember, clearing the enemry forces here isn't our objective. Getting back the Nyans stuff is. The mechs are incidental... however they're still going to be to be shooting our 'Mechs in the ass, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 记住，清掉这里的敌军不是我们的目标。夺回尼扬的东西才是。机甲是附带的……不过它们仍然会朝我们机甲的屁股开火，指挥官。我们得保持移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now that we’ve decrypted the location of the Nyanderthal era artefact and our stolen equipment, we can drop in and claim back what is justly ours by birth right and legal purchase! Getting our equipment back takes utmost priority, as we can’t bring our musical joy to the Canopian masses without our equipment. Investigating the Nyanderthal artefact takes secondary priority, although its important, these wild goose chases turn out to be hogwash more often than not.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 既然我们已经解密了尼安德特时代遗物和我们被盗装备的位置，我们就可以降落下去，夺回按出生权和合法购买本应属于我们的东西！取回我们的装备是最高优先事项，因为没有装备我们就无法把音乐的欢乐带给卡诺帕的民众。调查尼安德特遗物是次要优先事项，虽说它很重要，但这类大海捞针的追查十有八九是竹篮打水。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simply mark the three designated target zones and watch the fireworks, knowing you're doing some good in the galaxy, Commander. This facility has to be destroyed completely.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只需标出三个指定目标区域，然后看烟花绽放，同时知道自己为这个银河做了些好事，指挥官。这处设施必须被彻底摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Purrfect, now we get to witness the full firepower of this fully armed and operational… We have orbital units standing by with some particularly impressive fireworks ready to display, just for us.  You’ve got to move in and triangulate the target for us so we can accurately dispense some flashy justice. Yes, we enjoy a few explosions when we’re the ones setting them off. Additionally we have roused some local support for the battle, expect them to provide assistance as best they can
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完美，现在我们可以见证这套全副武装、完全运作的……的完整火力了。我们有轨道单位待命，准备好一些特别震撼的烟火表演，专为我们展示。你得推进去并为目标做三角定位，好让我们准确地施放华丽的正义。是的，当我们是点火的那一方时，我们挺享受几次爆炸的。此外我们还为该战唤起了当地一些支援，预计他们会尽力提供协助

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is it; destroying this facility will ensure no more nekos or citizens can be captured. Normal prisons are incapable of holding us for long, so once this is blasted into oblivion they'll have no place to keep us
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，就是这里了；摧毁这处设施就能确保不再有猫娘或平民被俘。普通监狱没办法长期关住我们，所以一旦这里被炸成虚无，他们就没有地方可以关押我们了

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Danger close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控中心: 目标锁定，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Warming shot. Splash in 30.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这是火控中心: 试射一发，30秒后弹着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部队指挥官奥诺沃

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They want us to take on a 20-year veteran of the Succession Wars with an underweight lance. This is going to hurt, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们想让我们用一个缺编的小队去对抗一位在继承战争中服役了20年的老兵. 这仗会打得很疼，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMarikFWLM],FWLM]] Force Commander is currently traveling between installations on an inspection tour. He is heavily guarded, with two escorting lances of 'Mechs piloted by veterans who have served with him for years. However, this is still the best opportunity we'll have to strike at the League's command structure in Claybrooke.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMarikFWLM],自由世界联盟军队]]的部队指挥官目前正在各设施之间进行视察旅行。他护卫森严，有两支由跟随他多年的老兵驾驶的机甲小队护航。但即便如此，这仍是我们打击克莱布鲁克联盟指挥体系的最佳机会。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, welcome to the operation. The target is confirmed to be in the region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，欢迎加入这次行动. 目标已确认在该区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good. Commander, you are clear to evacuate the area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的. 指挥官，您现在可以退出该地区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, the mercenary team is back aboard the Leopard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，佣兵部队已经回到了豹式空投艇上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, we have confirmation of target destruction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，我们已确认目标被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the target is down, make your way to the designated evacuation area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦目标关闭，前往约定的疏散区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a highly disappointing outcome that reflects poorly on you and your people, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个结果非常令人不满意，让您和您的团队处于非常糟糕的状态，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Steiner Alliance II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 施泰纳联盟 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is bizarre, Commander. We just finished a covert drop to avoid drawing attention, and now we're going to blow up a military base?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这太离奇了，指挥官。我们刚完成一次隐蔽投放以避免引起注意，现在却要去炸掉一处军事基地？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've received word from Margrave General Neil; our success was well received within Cavanaugh Theater Command. Margrave Neil has passed on the results of their stragetic planning session, and we've been asked to strike one of the local military installations. The goal is to completely neutralize the facility, to send a message to local forces that they are vulnerable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我收到尼尔边区将军的消息；我们的成功在卡瓦诺战区指挥部广受好评。尼尔边区将军转达了他们战略规划会议的结果，我们被要求打击当地一处军事设施。目标是彻底瘫痪该设施，向当地部队发出信号：他们并非固若金汤。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target facility is just on the other side of that highway.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，瞄准设施在这条高速公路的对面.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destruction of enemy forces in the region is not mandatory, but will be rewarded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁该地区的敌方单位不是强制性的，但是，它会得到奖励.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hmm. Commander, I trust that you can handle any additional enemy forces?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 唔指挥官，我猜，你会和几个额外的敌人相处?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, we have additional contacts in the area. It might be an ambush.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，我们在该区域发现了更多接触信号. 这可能是个埋伏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a highly disappointing outcome that reflects poorly on you and your people, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个结果非常令人不满意，让您和您的团队处于非常糟糕的状态，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your objective is to cause as much damage as possible to critical facility structures.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的任务是，对设施中最重要的建筑物造成尽可能多的破坏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move quickly… with assault-class 'Mechs. Commander, this is absurd. I hope they're paying well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用突击级机甲快速机动。指挥官，这太荒唐了。我希望他们给的报酬够好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I approve of your choice of 'Mechs for this mission, Commander. This ought to be just the show of force that Margrave Joss was hoping for. Also, I have additional support to provide, thanks to Kommandant General Plath; you'll need to clear the antiair defenses before the support lance can land, though. Remember: Gungnir, our DropShip, can remain on station to fire at the planet only for a limited time. Move quickly, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我赞成你为这次任务选择的机甲，指挥官。这应该正是约斯边区将军所希望的那种武力展示。另外，多亏普拉特总监将军，我还有额外的支援可以提供；不过你得先清除防空防御，支援分队才能降落。记住：冈格尼尔，我们的空投艇，只能有限时间内停留在轨道上对行星开火。动作快点，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, Commander, that extra support I promised is arriving now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，指挥官. 我承诺的额外支援现在就到了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, yes, Commander. The objective is to place three targeting beacons around the hardened military facility, so that our DropShip can fire its main gun at the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，是的，指挥官. 任务是要在这个坚固的军事设施周围放置三个目标信标，好让我们的空投艇能够用主炮攻击基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All units, close distance on enemy forces. Move quickly!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有单位，缩短与敌军的距离. 快速推进！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this area of operation!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is LCAF First Lieutenant Langford. My people and I will be assisting you on the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这是Langford中尉，来自LCAF(天琴共和军). 我的人会在战场上协助你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Expect enemy forces to interfere with your beacon placement. You will need to protect the beacons for a short time by remaining nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 预计敌军会干扰你的信标放置. 你还需要在附近停留，保护一段时间.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the pressure on to deny them a chance to place those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持压制，阻止机甲放置信标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what you got.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看你的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, the mercenary lance is now in the operational area. Opening comms to them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，雇佣兵小队现已进入作战区域. 正在开启与他们的通讯.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, we have new contacts. Looks like vehicles from a hardened motor pool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，我们发现了新目标. 看起来像是来自一个加固车辆维修场的车辆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the facility is destroyed, move to the evacuation point. I await reports of your success, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 设施摧毁后立即前往撤离点. 我会等待你的好消息，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a highly disappointing outcome that reflects poorly on you and your people, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个结果非常令人不满意，让您和您的团队处于非常糟糕的状态，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are on a very short timeline, Commander. Our orbital asset can conceal its signature only for a short time before it will be discovered, after which expect more enemy resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的时间窗口非常有限，指挥官. 我们的轨道平台只能在短时间内隐藏其信号特征，之后便会被发现. 一旦暴露，预计会遭遇更强烈的敌军抵抗.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Steiner Alliance IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 施泰纳联盟 IV

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I really don't like going in with this little information, Commander. This seems very rushed and poorly prepared.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真的很不喜欢带着这么点情报就上，指挥官。这看起来非常仓促、准备不足。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to catch her while she's still in transit, and eliminate her. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们对军事设施的打击带来了一个机会，指挥官。克莱布鲁克的军事统治者切斯汀中校正从首都逃往一处未公开的安全地点，想必是为了避免再次被打击。如果我们行动迅速，应该能趁她还在途中抓住她并除掉她。这次任务由卡瓦诺战区边区将军艾丽丝·施泰纳女公爵亲自要求，所以我们必须成功。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队护卫

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌方车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if you do not act quickly, the convoy is likely to escape, and the target with it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果你不迅速行动，车队将与我们的目的地一起逃跑.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, your performance has disappointed not only myself, but Duchess Steiner and by extension the entire Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你的表现不仅让我失望，还让施泰纳男爵夫人失望，因此也让整个天琴共同体失望.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent. My agents have not been able to pinpoint which vehicle the Lieutenant Colonel is traveling in, so to be safe, just eliminate all of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很好. 我的特工们一直无法确定中校乘坐的是哪辆车. 因此，为了安全起见，把他们全部消灭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good. Commander, focus your fire on the vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的. 指挥官，将火力集中在车辆上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, the convoy is arriving at its extraction point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，车队到达撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, we have deployed the mercenary force in the area of operation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，我们已将雇佣兵部队部署在行动区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the convoy is destroyed, move to the evacuation zone for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦车队被摧毁，就移动到撤离区等待接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，除了“轰，你的基地没了”，我不知道他们还能期待什么样的武力展示。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is LCAF First Lieutenant Langford. My people and I will be assisting you on the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这是Langford中尉，来自LCAF(天琴共和军). 我的人会在战场上协助你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Expect enemy forces to interfere with your beacon placement. You will need to protect the beacons for a short time by remaining nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 预计敌军会干扰你的信标放置. 你还需要在附近停留，保护一段时间.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the pressure on to deny them a chance to place those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持压制，阻止机甲放置信标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what you got.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看你的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, the mercenary lance is now in the operational area. Opening comms to them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，雇佣兵小队现已进入作战区域. 正在开启与他们的通讯.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My Lord, we have new contacts. Looks like vehicles from a hardened motor pool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大人，我们发现了新目标. 看起来像是来自一个加固车辆维修场的车辆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the facility is destroyed, move to the evacuation point. I await reports of your success, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 设施摧毁后立即前往撤离点. 我会等待你的好消息，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a highly disappointing outcome that reflects poorly on you and your people, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个结果非常令人不满意，让您和您的团队处于非常糟糕的状态，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are on a very short timeline, Commander. Our orbital asset can conceal its signature only for a short time before it will attract attention from our foes. After that time we can all expect enemy reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的时间非常紧迫，指挥官. 我们的轨道平台只能短暂隐藏自身信号，之后就会引来敌军注意. 在那之后，我们就要面对敌人的增援了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Steiner Alliance IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 施泰纳联盟 IV

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point, Escort Convoy to Safety, and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点，护送车队至安全地带，并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try adn stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I really don't like going in with this little information, Commander. This seems very rushed and poorly prepared.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真的很不喜欢带着这么点情报就上，指挥官。这看起来非常仓促、准备不足。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to intercept her convoy and take her captive. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们对军事设施的打击创造了一个机会，指挥官. Claybrooke的军事指挥官，Chestine中校，正在逃离首都前往一个未公开的安全地点 - 大概是为了避免成为另一次打击的目标. 如果我们行动迅速，应该能在途中拦截她的车队并俘虏她. 这个任务是卡瓦诺战区总督Iris Steiner女公爵亲自要求的，所以我们取得成功至关重要.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻克集结点，护送车队安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方拦截部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方增援

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保撤离期间车队全部单位存活

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Hunter Lance for Mission Completion
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁猎人小队以完成任务

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队直到空投舰抵达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, your performance has disappointed not only myself, but Duchess Steiner and by extension the entire Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你的表现不仅让我失望，还让施泰纳男爵夫人失望，因此也让整个天琴共同体失望.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent. Commander, please escort our guests to the extraction area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很好. 指挥官，请陪同我们的客人到疏散区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My staff informs me that the convoy has taken shelter in a nearby facility and requested reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的工作人员报告称，车队已就近躲入某设施并请求了增援.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then, escort them to where our Leopard will load them aboard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 然后护送他们到LZ，在那里他们将被装载到我们的豹式中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chapter 1 Verse 76
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一章第 76 节

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pirates tend not to be the best armed forces, at least.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少，海盗往往不是装备最好的军队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a large pirate strike force moving on our base. While they try to encircle us, you'll use the opportunity to crush their forward position. Smash through their defenders and move onto their base as quickly as you can.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支大规模海盗打击部队正向我们的基地推进。当他们试图包围我们时，你将利用这个机会碾碎他们的前沿阵地。冲垮他们的守军，尽快推进到他们的基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the pirate Lances
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁海盗小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have enemy contact, I would recommend a solid firing line. Tactics should not be their strong suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 发现敌军接触，我建议排成稳固的射击线。战术应该不是他们的强项。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With such light resistance, I figured you would get here pretty quickly. The pirate's forward base is up ahead and I need it captured so I can retrieve any information about their motives. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抵抗这么弱，我猜你很快就到了。海盗的前沿基地就在前方，我需要它被夺取，好让我取回任何关于他们动机的信息。祝好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture the pirate Facility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺取海盗设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out as Enemies Counterattack
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pacify the Area around the Facility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定设施周边区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As expected, their base is lightly guarded. Always use caution though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如我们所料，他们的基地守卫松散。不过永远要谨慎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chapter 1 Verse 76 III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一章第 76 节 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We made the right call, commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们做对了，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Instructions are to hold our position until relieved. Protect those buildings at all costs. I'll stay in contact as we move to stop the flanking pirate unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指令是坚守阵地直到被替换。不惜一切代价保护那些建筑。我们移动去阻截那支包抄的海盗部队时会保持联系。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护所有目标建筑免遭摧毁

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend the Target Buildings
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标建筑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工程师装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out Until Loading Is Complete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持位置，直到加载完成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we will need to buy a bit more time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们得多争取一点时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are off-line.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设有据点防御系统. 但目前处于离线状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一章第 76 节 IV

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pirates got to know what's on those vehicles by now. Might be a fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗现在肯定已经知道那些车辆上装的是什么了。可能会有一场仗打。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We had a spy who infiltrated this rabble-rousing lot some time ago. They have picked up valuable information and now require a field extraction. I'm sure you're familiar with the specifics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有个间谍早先打入了这群煽动闹事的人当中。他们已获取了宝贵情报，现在需要一次战地撤离。具体细节想必你很清楚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've located one of the Pirate Lances, Commander. No sign of the other one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们定位到了其中一支海盗小队。另一支没有踪迹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point, Escort Convoy to Safety, and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点，护送车队至安全地带，并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am surprised we have enough forces to complete this, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很惊讶我们还有足够的兵力完成这件事，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hope you're holding up okay, Commander. We got word that a caravan carrying an ally of ours was near the area where you were fighting the pirate leadership. We now need you to retrieve an agent of ours who infiltrated their ranks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 希望你撑得住，指挥官。我们得到消息，一支载着我们一位盟友的商队曾在你与海盗首领交战区域附近。我们现在需要你去接回我们一名已潜入他们内部的干员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Scouts
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance, Star... Whatever.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标是摧毁敌方小队，星……随便吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clanners may be difficult to handle, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's put on our game faces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部族分子可能不好对付，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。让我们摆出认真脸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am so glad you answered our call, Commander. These Clanners know no mercy and they have just about driven us underground at this point. I trust you are familiar with doing violence and we'll leave the small details of this operation to you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴你响应了我们的召唤，指挥官。这些氏族人毫无怜悯，他们此刻几乎把我们逼到地下去了。我相信你熟悉动武这套，行动的小细节就交给你了。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And I captured the entire show on Holovid! Nice, crisp footage, ready for air.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 而且我已经用全息影像全程录下来了！画质清晰利落，随时可以播出.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our surveillance drones have spotted a group of Clanners near this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的监视无人机在此位置附近发现了一群氏族人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That was glorious, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! You beat them bloody without a shred of hesitation or remorse!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是精彩绝伦，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}！你毫不犹豫、毫无怜悯地把他们打得落花流水！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What about refits and repairs? Our lance just took fire down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那改装和维修呢? 我们的小队刚刚在下面挨了打.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard the man. Let's get this job done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听到他的话了。我们把活干完。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clan forward base is directly ahead of you. Capture it to get the Clan Galaxy Commander's attention. We want you to make a noise and show these interlopers that the Inner Sphere isn't finished here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部族前进基地就在你正前方。夺取它以引起部族星系指挥官的注意。我们要你闹出动静，让这些闯入者知道内层星域在这里还没完。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领基地

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Turrets. Remember they can spot you from a very long way off, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炮台. 请记住它们能在很远的距离上发现你，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dropship inbound for landing! We're going to get in and out quick!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投舰正在降落！我们要速进速出！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is ours, Commander. Well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座基地是我们的了，指挥官. 做得不错.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The facility looks unoccupied save for some automated turrets, Commander. If we can bust those defenses and get inside the perimeter, our employer can send in their salvage crews to take control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这座设施看来还没有被占领，除了一些自动炮台. 如果我们打破那些防御力量并进入周界，我们的雇主就可以派遣他们的回收人员接管控制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're here to capture the Base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们来这里是为了夺取基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Scouts III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族侦察兵 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I will mark a possible ambush spot just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以防万一，我会标记一处可能的伏击点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep your eyes open down there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. We're going in with a single MechWarrior, and I don't trust this one bit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在下面睁大眼睛，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们要只带一名机师进去，而我一点都不信这事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. The Clan Commander has issued a batchall and you have accepted. One on one, honourable combat with the freedom of this world at stake. We'll be recording it for posterity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一下了，指挥官。氏族指挥官发出了批战挑战，而你接受了。一对一，荣誉之战，赌注是这颗行星的自由。我们会把它录下来留给后人。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我向你发起泽尔布林根挑战，一对一决斗！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，那真是……挺有娱乐性？

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我终于能把这事了结了。杀掉那个偷走我手下的贱人。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the region where we agents reported sighting the enemies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这就是我们的特工报告发现敌人的区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Evolving Situation III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 局势演变 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this won't be an easy task. We're going up against a well-defended enemy stronghold, and we may be outnumbered and outgunned. But if you think it's worth the risk, we'll do our best to succeed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这不会是件容易的事。我们要对付一座防御良好的敌方要塞，而且可能在数量与火力上都处于劣势。但如果你认为值得冒险，我们会尽力成功。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mission is to capture the enemy base intact. The QuadVees will be a critical asset for this mission. We need to approach the base carefully, neutralize any enemy forces, and then secure the facility. Once we have control, we can search for any intelligence that might be valuable to our cause.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务是完整夺取敌方基地。四足机甲将是这次任务的关键资产。我们需要谨慎接近基地，清除任何敌军，然后拿下该设施。一旦控制住，我们就能搜寻任何可能对我们事业有价值的情报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's part of the hardened bunker, and we can't disable it until the orbital strike completes. So, I suggest moving quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它是加固掩体的一部分，在轨道打击完成之前我们无法使其失效。所以我建议动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There it is. Whatever they are building, it's not good for any of us. Take that base down!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是那里。不管他们在造什么，对我们都没好处。端掉那座基地！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm glad to hear that, Pillow. An easier mission is always more favorable to us. Let's get in there and take out their production facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听到这个我很高兴，枕头。任务轻松些对我们总是更有利。我们进去把他们的生产设施端掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ok so our chances of obtaining the valuable data and research have been cut short, but this way does have a higher survivability. We will be destroying their production capabilities to hopefully drive them off this rock.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，所以我们获取那些宝贵数据与研究的机会已经断了，但这条路确实生存率更高。我们将摧毁他们的生产能力，希望能把他们赶出这块石头。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, it looks like we'll have to destroy the base after all. It's a shame we couldn't get our hands on their data and research, but I suppose it can't be helped.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，看来我们终究还是得摧毁那座基地。可惜我们没能弄到他们的数据与研究，但我想这也没办法。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。
