Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's part of the hardened bunker, and we can't disable it until the orbital strike completes. So, I suggest moving quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它是加固掩体的一部分，在轨道打击完成之前我们无法使其失效。所以我建议动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There it is. Whatever they are building, it's not good for any of us. Take that base down!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是那里。不管他们在造什么，对我们都没好处。端掉那座基地！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Extracurricular Activities
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 附带活动

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard the man, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. This deployment is just setup for a larger fight to come, so try not to get too beat up out there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你听到他说的了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 这个任务只是一场更大的战斗的第一部分，所以尽量别在外面伤得太重.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You'll find the Davion munitions factory at the coordinates I've outlined, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Take it from them, that it may serve as the bait for the trap that I'm paying you to set.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你会在标出的坐标找到达维昂弹药厂，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。从他们手中夺过来，好让它充当那个我付钱请你设下的陷阱的诱饵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture the Munitions Factory
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领军工厂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Davion Garrison
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁戴维恩驻军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Davion Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭戴维恩增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out As Enemies Counterattack
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Occupy the Munitions Factory
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领军工厂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pacify the Surrounding Area
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定周边区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scout the Munitions Factory
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察军工厂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip inbound, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投艇抵达，指挥官!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander! Most excellent work indeed. The munitions factory is yours, and our trap has been set. Now all we need do is sit back and wait.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官！实在漂亮极了. 军工厂归我们了，陷阱也已设好. 现在只需静待猎物上钩.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Davion munitions factory should be just ahead of your lance, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩军工厂应该就在你机甲小队前方了，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You are defeated, Commander. And I am extremely disappointed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你失败了，指挥官. 而我对你失望透顶.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Extracurricular Activities II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 附带活动 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of those locations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施以夺取那些地点的控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard the man. Hold the base and take out all comers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你听到他说的了. 守住基地并消灭所有来犯之敌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杰斯珀领主和他的小队正在赶来挑战你的路上. 守住工厂并让他弹射逃生，败兴而归！把他那珍贵的祖传机甲烧成冒烟的废墟！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Baddies Inbound
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌人来袭

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend the Munitions Factory
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫弹药工厂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Davion Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁达维昂增援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ensure All Buildings Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保所有建筑存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And you did your work beautifully! The pride of House Bisset lays strewn across the battlefield, reduced to a broken heap!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你出色地完成了工作! 比塞特家族的骄傲在战场上散落得遍地都是，成了一堆废铁!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't know who you are or who sent you, mercenary. But in the name of House Bisset and House Davion, you will abandon this factory or you will be destroyed!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不知道你是谁，也不知道是谁派你来的，雇佣兵。但以比塞特家族与戴维恩家族之名，你要么放弃这座工厂，要么就会被彻底摧毁！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger that, Graf Stieglitz-Bradford.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，斯蒂格里茨·布拉德福德伯爵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You are beaten, mercenary! Run back to your masters and never return!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你败了，佣兵！滚回你主子那儿去，永远别再回来！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Extracurricular Activities II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 附带活动 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point and Escort Convoy to Safety
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点并护送车队至安全地带

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's knock this out quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I don't want to try Graf Stieglitz-Bradford's patience any more than we have to.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们快点解决这事，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我不想比必要更久地去耗施蒂格利茨-布拉德福德伯爵的耐心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'd be dead without your assistance, Commander. Full stop. There are at least a dozen different bandit gangs operating on the outskirts of our territory, and any one of 'em would jump at the chance to gun us down. So… thanks for doing what's decent. From all of us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没有你的协助我们就死定了，指挥官。句号。我们领地郊外至少有十几伙不同的匪帮在活动，任何一伙都会扑上来把我们打成筛子。所以……谢谢你做了体面的事。我们所有人都是。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Bandit Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭强盗增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Bandit Roadblock
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 清除土匪路障

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ensure that All Refugee Vehicles Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保所有难民车辆到达目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the Refugees to Safety and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把难民带到安全的地方然后撤退

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the Refugees to the Safe Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送难民到安全区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Hunter Lance for Mission Completion
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁猎人小队以完成任务

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队直到空投舰抵达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recover your lance and return to the munitions factory. You still have a fight to win, and I am counting on your success.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 回收你的小队并返回军工厂. 你还有一场仗要赢，我指望你成功.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thank you for helping us out of this, Commander. I've gotta admit, when I first reached out to you, I didn't have much hope that you'd respond.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 感谢你帮我们摆脱这件事，指挥官。我得承认，我第一次联系你时，并没抱多大希望你会回应。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Extracurricular Activities III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 附带活动 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of those locations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施以夺取那些地点的控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard the man. Hold the base and take out all comers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你听到他说的了. 守住基地并消灭所有来犯之敌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now that your humanitarian responsibilities have been seen to, perhaps you'll be good enough to focus your attention on your real job? Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 既然你的人道主义责任已经尽到，也许你可以好心把注意力放在你真正的工作上了？杰斯珀领主和他的分队正在前来挑战你。守住工厂，把他打回他的弹射舱里，让他败北受辱！把他那台珍贵的祖传战斗机甲留成一堆冒烟的废墟！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鹰巢

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve the Data and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 回收数据并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They seem confident, but the opposition is firing on our 'Mechs, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们看起来很自信，但对手正在向我们的机甲开火，指挥官。我们需要保持移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're starting this simple, Commander. Your job is asset extraction. This is complicated by the Local Government not wanting you to escape, but I'm sure you know what to do. They've posted a heavily armed escort to stop this, but we trust that this won't trouble you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次先从简单的任务开始。你的任务是撤离目标资产。麻烦之处在于当地政府不想让你离开，但我相信你知道该怎么做。他们已派出重装护卫来阻止这件事，不过我们相信这难不倒你。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近政府设施，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护设施，取回样品

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All units, close distance on enemy forces. We have to disrupt those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有单位，向敌军逼近。我们必须干扰那些信标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's part of the hardened bunker, and we can't disable it until the orbital strike completes. So, I suggest moving quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它是加固掩体的一部分，在轨道打击完成之前我们无法使其失效。所以我建议动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They really want to hold on to that technology. It's a real shame we have to blow them up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们真的很想守住那项技术。真遗憾我们不得不把他们炸掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Operation: Flattened Earth
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动: 焦土

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Razorback Company C&C Unit
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尖背野猪公司指挥机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the target, clear area of additional forces, and escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，肃清区域内的额外部队，并撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's do this thing quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I don't want us spending any more time on these jokers than we have to.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快点把这事办了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我不想在这些活宝身上多花一分钟时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Before you can rid us of the Volkovites, you're going to have to deal with Razorback Company, the hired guns they imported from the Frontier. Our surveillance drones have identified the company's command-and-control 'Mech, a CP-10-Z Cyclops. Eliminate it to cripple Razorback Company and clear a path to your real target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在你除掉沃尔科维特人之前，你得先应付剃刀背连，那是他们从边疆雇来的枪手。我们的监视无人机已确认该连的指挥控制机甲，一台CP-10-Z独眼巨人。消灭它就能瘫痪剃刀背连，为通往你真正目标清出道路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装甲击穿

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Razorback Company Cyclops and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁尖背野猪公司的“独眼巨人”机甲并撤退

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Supporting Mercenary Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭支援的佣兵部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Ambushers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭伏击中的敌人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Razorback Company Cyclops
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭尖背野猪公司的“独眼巨人”机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent the Cyclops from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止“独眼巨人”逃跑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As brave as she is foolish. Engage the enemy and destroy them, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Liao out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勇敢……但愚蠢. 攻击并消灭他们，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 廖完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For this first drop, I want you to hunt down Razorback Company's C&C 'Mech, a CP-10-Z Cyclops. It appears to be running a stock configuration, and it will be combat-capable at any range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次首个投放，我要你猎杀剃刀背连的指挥控制机甲，一台CP-10-Z独眼巨人。它似乎运行的是原厂配置，在任何射程上都具备战斗能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kill confirmed, Commander. The Cyclops is down, and you are cleared for extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 击杀确认，指挥官. “独眼巨人”已被击倒. 你可以进行撤离了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You are defeated, Commander. The Chancellor has asked me to express his displeasure at your performance, and to inform you that he will find another company to carry out his will.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你失败了，指挥官. 总理让我向你传达他对你表现的不满，并告知你，他会另找一家公司来执行他的意志.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Operation: Flattened Earth II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动: 焦土 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tough luck for Razorback Company, but they knew what they were getting themselves into when they took sides against House Liao.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尖背野猪公司运气不佳，但他们选择与廖氏为敌时就该明白后果.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My contacts in the Maskirovka tell me that you rejected Commander Elliathy's offer. A wise decision, Commander. Bring down the remainder of Razorback Company, and nothing will stand between you and the seditionist camp.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在伪装局的联络人告诉我，你拒绝了埃利亚西指挥官的提议。明智的决定，指挥官。把剃刀背连的残部也打掉，你与煽动者营地之间就没有任何阻隔了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Razorback Company's BattleMechs
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁剃刀背连的战斗机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And I will remember it, Mr. Oliveira. Now proceed to your next drop site.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我会记住的，奥利维拉先生. 现在，前往下一个降落点吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Holy shit! We won! We actually won!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天啊！我们赢了！我们真的赢了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chancellor has asked me to express his displeasure at this humiliation, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. I will find another company to carry out the will of House Liao.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 总理已要求我转达他对此次蒙羞的不满，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 我会另找一家公司来执行廖氏家族的意志.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The remnants of Razorback Company have taken position ahead of you, Commander. I'd advise you to approach them with the caution you would a wounded animal. Commander Elliathy has little left to lose.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剃刀背连的残部已在你前方占据阵地，指挥官。我建议你像接近受伤野兽一样谨慎地接近他们。埃利亚西指挥官已经没什么可失去的了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Operation: Flattened Earth III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动: 焦土 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Volkovite Structures
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁沃尔科维特建筑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The sooner we can finish this, the better. Let's just… get it done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们越早办完这事越好。我们就……把它办了吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The remaining Volkovites have holed up in a sanctuary you'll find in this valley. Destroy it, and eliminate whatever resistance they can bring to bear. The eyes of the Chancellor are on you, Commander. Don't disappoint him.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剩余的沃尔科维特人窝藏在这个山谷里你会找到的一处避难所。摧毁它，消灭他们能组织起的任何抵抗。议长的目光在你身上，指挥官。别让他失望。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Volkovite Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭沃尔科维特的增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Volkovite Sanctuary and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁沃尔科维特的避难所并逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Volkovite Sanctuary
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁沃尔科维特的避难所

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭沃尔科维特驻军

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guardians and protectors, come to us in our hour of need!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守护者和保护者，在我们最黑暗的时刻站在我们身边！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Outstanding work, Commander. You have performed your task with the grim efficiency that it required.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 出色的工作，指挥官. 你以任务所要求的坚强不屈完成了它.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Volkovite compound should be just ahead of you, Commander. With Razorback Company out of the way, you should have no trouble putting it to the torch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 沃尔科维特据点应该就在你前方，指挥官. 既然尖背野猪公司无法再妨碍你，你应该能毫不费力地把它付之一炬.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are professionals, Lady Marina. We carry out our assignments, however distasteful they may be.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们是专业人士，玛丽娜女士——无论任务多么令人厌恶，我们都会完成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Operation: Flattened Earth II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动: 焦土 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No good deed goes unpunished, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Not ever.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好心没好报，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 历来如此.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good on you for being on the right side of this conflict, {COMMANDER.Callsign}… I know it couldn't have been an easy decision. And speaking of difficult matters, you're about to have a fight on your hands. House Liao has sent a detachment of 'Mechs to finish your job for you, and unfortunately, Razorback Company is no position to deal with 'em.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你能站在这场冲突正确的一方，值得称赞，{COMMANDER.Callsign}……我知道这个决定不容易。说到棘手的事——你马上就有仗要打了。廖氏家族派出了一队机甲来替你完成任务，可惜剃刀背连可没能力应付他们。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Uh, Boss? I'm seeing a couple of Liao attack lances on my screen, and I'm willing to bet their pilots are pretty angry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 呃，老大？我在屏幕上看到两支廖氏攻击分队，而我敢打赌他们的飞行员相当愤怒。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动: 焦土 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point and Escort Convoy to Safety
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点并护送车队至安全地带

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try adn stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is turning into one hell of a long haul, but the sooner we get these people out of Capellan space, the sooner we can collect our pay.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这将变成一段艰难的长途旅程，但我们越早将这些民众带离卡佩拉联邦，就能越早拿到酬劳.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The last of the Volkovites have packed themselves onto a series of transport vehicles, and they're ready to roll. We've lined up a DropShip to take them to Joppa, but you're gonna have to get 'em there. We're nearly through this situation, Commander… just a little bit further to go.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最后一批沃尔科维特人已经挤进了一串运输车辆，随时可以出发。我们已经安排好一艘空投艇送他们去约帕，但你得把他们送到那儿。我们快熬过这个局面了，指挥官……再往前走一点点就到了。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁猎人小队以完成任务

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护沃尔科维特人员登舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck and godspeed, Commander. Get us to safety and protect us, for we cannot protect ourselves. Our lives are in your hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官. 把我们带到安全的地方并保护我们吧，因为我们无法自保. 我们的生命掌握在您的手中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I truly hope that it never comes to that, Mr. Oliveira. But if it does, your company will be the first that I call.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真诚地希望事情不会走到那一步，奥利维拉先生. 可如果发生了，那我第一个找的就是你们公司.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Commander. We've got the Volkovites all bundled up into a convoy of vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官。我们已经把沃尔科维特人全都塞进了一支车辆车队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take care of yourself, Commander. And cheers again for doing the right thing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请多保重，指挥官. 再次为你选择正确之举而致敬.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Here we go chasing ghosts again, Commander. I think she will have an aneurysm if we run into Jimmy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又来了，我们又在追鬼影，指挥官。我想我们要是撞上吉米，她会气得血管爆掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have tracked ComStar to this hell hole of a planet. Whatever they are hiding here, I have to have. So let's start simple. Agent X has been sighted here with his crew. Get down there and take him out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们追踪康星到了这颗地狱般的行星。不管他们在这里藏了什么，我都要拿到。所以从简单的开始。X特工和他的队伍在这里被发现过。下去，把他做掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have him this time. I am going to skewer his eyeballs and serve them for dessert tonight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次我们逮住他了。我要把他的眼珠串起来，今晚当甜点端上桌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I have a sneaky suspicion Jimmy has some serious Plot armor Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有个偷偷的猜测，吉米身上有很厚的剧情护甲，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am going to put this ship in a bottle, even if it kills him. That little bastard stole from me, made me chase him all around the Sphere, and now he taunts me from inside a base. Use extreme prejudice eliminating him.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我要把这艘船装进瓶子里，哪怕这要了他的命。那小混蛋偷了我的东西，让我绕着内天体追了他一圈，现在他还躲在一座基地里嘲弄我。用极端手段消灭他。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work Commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Why did the Pirate cross the road? TO KILL JIMMY!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗为什么要过马路？为了杀吉米！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fortress Door IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 堡垒大门 IV

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Oh boy, let's hope Jimmy isn't down there or we may not get anything.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天哪，但愿吉米不在下面，否则我们可能什么都拿不到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, we made it to the planet. We have everything we need except for the geo-location of the fortress where they have whatever they have, and I want it. Get down there and smash that convoy and kill whoever to get the information we need.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，我们到行星了。我们什么都不缺，只差那座堡垒的地理位置——他们手里有什么都无所谓，我要的就是它。下去摧毁那支车队，杀掉任何人，拿到我们需要的情报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, we're here.  Let's go clean up a convoy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，我们到了。去清理一支车队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good times, large explosions, maybe a plot twist. Sounds like a fun time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好时光、大爆炸，也许还有个剧情转折。听着挺有意思。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: By now you know the drill. We will be firing our Naval Gauss Rifle from orbit, We can only keep it charged so long. Get the beepy things in the Target zone so we can blow a hole in this base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 到现在你该熟悉流程了。我们将从轨道上发射舰载磁轨炮，我们只能让它充能这么久。把那些会叫的东西放进目标区，好让我们在这座基地上炸出一个洞。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Steel Beast

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've got nothing to add, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's go beat up some violent drunks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我没什么要补充的，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们去揍几个暴力的醉汉吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we are to draw the Steel Beast into a fight, we must first provoke him. The wholesale slaughter of his revolting followers seems like a reasonable first step. I'll point you in the right direction, you'll bring the firepower, and we'll scour this world of Bogdan Tubbs's fan club. Then we'll move on to a more high-profile target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们要把钢铁野兽引出来打一场，就必须先激怒他。把他那些令人作呕的追随者成批屠杀，看来是合理的第一步。我给你们指方向，你们带来火力，我们就把博格丹·塔布斯的粉丝俱乐部从这个世界上彻底清除。然后我们再转向更引人注目的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And I captured the entire show on Holovid! Nice, crisp footage, ready for air.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 而且我已经用全息影像全程录下来了！画质清晰利落，随时可以播出.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our surveillance drones have spotted a group of the Steel Beast's friends and followers near this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的监视无人机在此位置附近发现了一群钢铁野兽的朋友和追随者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That was glorious, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! You beat them bloody without a shred of hesitation or remorse!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是精彩绝伦，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}！你毫不犹豫、毫无怜悯地把他们打得落花流水！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then by all means, we should broadcast it. We move on Ironwood Productions and their Holo-distribution facility, and we do it now!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 既然如此，那就尽管播出去吧！我们现在就行动，占领Ironwood Productions的全息分发设施！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What about refits and repairs? Our lance just took fire down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那改装和维修呢? 我们的小队刚刚在下面挨了打.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Steel Beast II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢铁野兽 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard the man. Let's get this job done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听到他的话了。我们把活干完。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ironwood Productions' Holo-distribution facility is just ahead of you, Commander. Take it, and we will use it to ensure that the Steel Beast hears your challenge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁木制作公司的全息发行设施就在你前方，指挥官。拿下它，我们就能用它确保钢铁野兽听到你的挑战。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Huh. Looks like Ironwood Productions shelled out for point-defense turrets. I was not expecting that.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哼. 看起来Ironwood Productions还真掏钱买了点防御炮台. 这我倒没料到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am inbound for landing, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正在进场准备降落，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I would advise your lance to scout the facility before engaging it. Ironwood Productions has security contracts with a number of local mercenary outfits, and resistance is likely to be heavy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我建议你的机甲小队先侦察设施再发动攻击. Ironwood Productions与多家当地雇佣兵公司签有安保合约，预计将遭遇激烈抵抗.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Holo-distribution facility should be just ahead of you, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全息分发设施应该就在你前面，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Steel Beast III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢铁野兽 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep your eyes open down there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. We're going in with a single MechWarrior, and I don't trust this joker to stick to his end of the deal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在下面睁大眼睛，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们要只带一名机师进去，而我不信这个活宝会守约。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. Your one-on-one contest with the Steel Beast. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一刻了，指挥官. 你和那头“钢铁野兽”的一对一对决. 让他尝尝他应得的正义制裁吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shut up and fight, you murderous swine. Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} will make you suffer, as you made my nephew Arjun suffer!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 闭嘴受死吧，你这杀人猪猡. 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}会让你尝尽痛苦，就像你折磨我侄子阿琼那样！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What is wrong with him?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那有什么问题?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're here. Good! I've been LOOKING FORWARD to BREAKING YOUR NECK!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你来了。好！我一直盼着扭断你的脖子！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Steel Beast III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢铁野兽 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm willing to bet that Bogdan Tubbs is bringing friends to this drop, same as we are. Just a feeling I get. So, yeah… keep your eyes open.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我敢打赌博格丹·塔布斯这次投放会带朋友来，跟我们一样。只是我的感觉。所以，嗯……睁大眼睛。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. Your lance versus the Steel Beast, and whatever reinforcements he dares to call. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是现在，指挥官. 你的机甲小队对上“钢铁野兽”，以及他敢叫来的任何增援. 给予他罪有应得的正义！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭钢铁野兽

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch one Steel Beast. He had it coming, I have to say.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决掉一头“钢铁野兽”. 他这是自找的，不得不说.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shut up and fight, you murderous swine. Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} will make you suffer, as you made my nephew Arjun suffer!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 闭嘴受死吧，你这杀人猪猡. 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}会让你尝尽痛苦，就像你折磨我侄子阿琼那样！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're here… and look, you've brought friends! You're a LIAR and a CHEAT, and you're gonna REAP THE STEEL BEAST'S WHIRLWIND!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你来了……而且你看，你还带了朋友！你是个骗子、一个作弊鬼，而你将承受钢铁野兽的旋风！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve the Data and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 回收数据并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They seem confident, but the opposition is firing on our 'Mechs, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们看起来很自信，但对手正在向我们的机甲开火，指挥官。我们需要保持移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're starting this simple, Commander. Your job is asset extraction. This is complicated by the Local Government not wanting you to escape, but I'm sure you know what to do. They've posted a heavily armed escort to stop this, but we trust that this won't trouble you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次先从简单的任务开始。你的任务是撤离目标资产。麻烦之处在于当地政府不想让你离开，但我相信你知道该怎么做。他们已派出重装护卫来阻止这件事，不过我们相信这难不倒你。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Leopard is on station to pick you up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一只豹子已准备好，来接你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're coming up on the government facility, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近政府设施，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安放Bravo信标，用于火炮指示

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't like the sound of this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不喜欢这听起来的样子。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Today we will see if you can accomplish tasks by staying On Mission. Do not dissapoint us. Blow that base up by placing the beacons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 今天我们要看看你能否坚守任务目标完成任务。别让我们失望。放置信标把基地炸掉。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置信标 Charlie 以指示火力任务目标

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快速放置火炮信标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Facility and Designate the Fire Mission Target
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护设施，取回样品

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All units, close distance on enemy forces. We have to disrupt those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有单位，向敌军逼近。我们必须干扰那些信标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's part of the hardened bunker, and we can't disable it until the orbital strike completes. So, I suggest moving quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它是加固掩体的一部分，在轨道打击完成之前我们无法使其失效。所以我建议动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They really want to hold on to that technology. It's a real shame we have to blow them up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们真的很想守住那项技术。真遗憾我们不得不把他们炸掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Criminal Minds
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犯罪思维

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bront Shivraj
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勃朗特·希瓦吉

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the target, clear area of additional forces, and escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，肃清区域内的额外部队，并撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seems straightforward enough, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Get in there and make it happen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务很明确，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 进场执行吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, find and eliminate the Iron Sparrow's courier and his bodyguard. I want Shivraj dead and whatever intelligence he's carrying in my hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，找到并消灭铁麻雀的信使和他的保镖。我要希夫拉杰死，他携带的任何情报都要落在我手里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Assassination Lance Hidden Objective
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁刺杀小队的隐藏目标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate Bront Shivraj
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭勃朗特·希瓦吉

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Iron Sparrow's Courier
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭铁麻雀的信使

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent Shivraj from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止希瓦吉逃跑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A timely arrival, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. My people have eyes on Mr. Shivraj and his bodyguard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来得正是时候，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 我的人已锁定希瓦吉及其护卫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good hustle, Subcommander Boris. Our people will be ready.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，副指挥官鲍里斯. 我的人会做好准备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They are CCAF soldiers, Mr. Oliveira. Their efficiency is beyond question. Now I suggest that you clear the line and prepare your lance. They will be deploying imminently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们是卡佩拉武装部队的士兵，奥利维拉先生. 他们的效率不容置疑. 现在我建议你保持通讯通畅并让你的小队做好准备. 他们即将部署.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You have your orders, Commander. Do not disappoint me. Tianyu out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 命令已下达，指挥官. 不要让我失望. 天宇完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Criminal Minds II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犯罪思维 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to Subcommander Tianyu, the warehouse should be full of mining equipment… generators, churn drills, that sort of thing. Nothing we'd be interested in, but worth a lot to the right people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据田雨副指挥官的说法，那座仓库里应该全是采矿设备……发电机、螺旋钻之类的东西。我们不会感兴趣，但对合适的人来说值不少钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The intel you got from the Iron Sparrow's courier points here, to the warehouse you'll find just ahead. Take it for House Liao until the Liao Reserves arrive to relieve you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你从铁麻雀的信使那里得到的情报指向这里——你正前方的那座仓库。为廖氏家族夺取它，直到廖氏预备队抵达接替。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pacify the Area around the Warehouse
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定仓库周围的区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A terrible disappointment, Commander. But the Liao Reserves will succeed where you have failed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太令人失望了，指挥官. 但廖家的预备役部队会完成你未能做到的事.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip inbound, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投艇正在进场，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gee, Subcommander Boris. Thanks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，鲍里斯副指挥官. 谢谢.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the place, Commander. The Iron Sparrow's warehouse lies just ahead of you, its contents ripe for the picking.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这里，指挥官。铁麻雀的仓库就在你前方，里面的东西正等着人去拿。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犯罪思维 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Base from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抵御进攻者保卫基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unpleasant as Subcommander Tianyu may be, he's getting his vault, SLDF Griffin and all. Our reputation with House Liao is worth more than a single 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 田雨副指挥官虽然讨人厌，但他会拿到他的金库，连同SLDF格里芬一起。我们与廖家族的声望比一台机甲更值钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Iron Sparrow has dispatched all of his remaining units to attack the vault's northmost entrance, Commander. Hold them off until the Liao Reserves arrive to relieve you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，铁麻雀已派出他所有剩余部队攻击金库最北端的入口。顶住他们，直到廖氏预备队抵达接替。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A terrible disappointment, Commander. But the Liao Reserves will succeed where you have failed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太令人失望了，指挥官. 但廖家的预备役部队会完成你未能做到的事.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Only one building is still standing, you fool! If the Iron Sparrow brings it down, this whole campaign will be over!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你这个蠢货，只剩下一栋建筑了！如果“铁麻雀”也摧毁了它，整个战役就全完了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Run, then. Flee like the coward you are.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跑吧. 像个懦夫一样逃跑吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Iron Sparrow's forces are converging on the vault's northmost entrance point, Commander. Doubtless, they were hoping to catch you by surprise. Ready yourselves, they'll be on you soon enough.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁麻雀的部队正向金库最北端的入口点集结，指挥官。毫无疑问，他们本想打你个措手不及。做好准备，他们很快就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Subcommander Tianyu isn't going to let us keep what's in this vault without a fight, and it'll take time for Yang's crew to gather up all the pieces of that SLDF 'Mech. Now that we're committed to doing this, let's do it right.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 田雨副指挥官不会让我们不战而保住这个金库里的东西，而杨的团队要收齐那台SLDF机甲的所有部件也需要时间。既然我们已经决定要做，就把它做对。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I know what your man has done. Lady Marina may be fool enough to trust in mercenaries, but I've had agents watching you from the start—and now I find my suspicions confirmed. Prepare yourself to face the full wrath of the Liao Reserves, Commander—I will claim the contents of that vault you so covet, and then I will bury you in it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我知道你的人做了什么。玛丽娜女士也许蠢到去信任雇佣兵，但我从一开始就派了特工监视你——如今我发现我的怀疑得到了证实。准备好面对廖氏预备队的全力怒火吧，指挥官——我要夺取你如此觊觎的那个金库里的东西，然后我会把你埋在里面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'll tear that thrice-damned shack down around you to reclaim what you have stolen from me, mercenary scum!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我会把那座三度该死的破屋在你周围拆平，夺回你从我这里偷走的东西，雇佣兵渣滓！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未在此闪点中使用 - 块已关闭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your treachery is matched only by your incompetence, Commander. The spoils of this conflict are mine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的背叛程度，唯有你的无能能与之匹敌，指挥官. 这场冲突的战利品全归我了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's make some noise, {COMMANDER.Callsign}. Do as much damage as you can. When the Zhao siblings scatter, we'll choose our target and finish this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来点动静吧，{COMMANDER.Callsign}。尽可能造成破坏。等赵家兄妹散开，我们就选定目标，收尾。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Descend on the Flak Jackals and punch a hole in their lines. Make them pay for the Federation citizens they've killed, Commander—it is imperative that this pirate filth learn the cost of crossing the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突袭高炮豺狼，在他们防线上打穿一个洞。让他们为杀害的联邦公民付出代价，指挥官——必须让这些海盗渣滓明白冒犯联邦太阳的代价。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 出击让他们见识真正佣兵团的实力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Oh, the things that we did to your lance, Commander. The absolute horror of it! Did you hear your little friends screaming over the comms? Makes my heart bleed, knowing how terribly they suffered.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哦，我们对你的小队做了什么，指挥官. 真是太可怕了！你听到你那帮小朋友在通讯频道里的尖叫了吗? 知道他们遭受了如此可怕的痛苦我的心都碎了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stratford Narwhal is one of Garrilac's favorite watering holes. It's also a cesspool of vice, corruption, and terrible music. Taking it out may prove more difficult than you'd think; the bar was built in the husk of an old military complex, and its MechWarrior patrons will probably attack you on sight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯特拉特福独角鲸是加里拉克最爱的酒馆之一。它同样也是恶习、腐败和糟糕音乐的污水坑。拿下它可能比你想象的更难；这家酒吧建在一座旧军事建筑群的残骸里，其机师顾客大概一见到你就会动手。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌方酒鬼

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dump with point-defense turrets. This Garrilac guy must really like drinking in peace.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 带点防御炮台的垃圾场. 这个加瑞拉克真的不想在喝酒的时候被打扰.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good news and bad news, Commander. On the good side, the Stratford Narwhal is out of business.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有好消息还有坏消息，指挥官. 好的方面就是，斯特拉特福独角鲸停业了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I was with you, then you lost me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我想同意你的看法，但我只能摇头.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Picking up more belligerent drunks on radar, Boss. Just an FYI.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上出现了更多恼怒的醉汉，老板——只是提醒你一下.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stratford Narwhal is just up ahead, Commander. Looks like a real dump.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯特拉特福独角鲸就在前方，指挥官. 看起来真是个垃圾场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bourbon & BattleMechs II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 波旁威士忌和战斗机甲II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Garrilac may seem like kind of a joke, but you shouldn't underestimate Mason's Marauders. I've heard stories about their effectiveness on the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 加里拉克看起来也许像个笑话，但你不该低估梅森的劫掠者。我听说过他们在战场上的效力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Garrilac's lance is on the ground and waiting for you. Destroy them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 加里拉克的分队已经落地，正等着你们。摧毁他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Marauder Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭掠夺者增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep talking, hotshot. Our lance will take you down first.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 继续说吧，高手. 我们的机甲会先把你干掉.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So. You're {COMMANDER.Callsign}. I hope you're ready to get your teeth kicked in, because that's what's about to happen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那么，你就是{COMMANDER.Callsign}。我希望你准备好被打得满地找牙，因为那正是即将发生的事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yes, thank you. We get it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，谢谢. 我们已经明白了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Large Military Building
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大型军用建筑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} mechs back to the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲返回基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius is pretending he has useful advice to offer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达里乌斯正在假装自己有什么有用的建议可提。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This facility is close to where the rumors of massive tanks seem to originate. It's probably the best place to start your search.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这处设施离那些关于巨型坦克的传言似乎发源的地方很近。那里大概是你开始搜寻的最佳地点。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, one of our lances was hit on the way to the facility and has suffered 50% losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我方一支小队在前往设施的途中遭到袭击，已损失过半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we lost a building!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们损失了一栋建筑!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is secure. Hopefully {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} can hold it themselves, now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基地安全了. 希望{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}人能够靠他们自己坚守下来，至少现在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Welcome Commander.  About 100 clicks east of here is where some civvies reported unusual activity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欢迎，指挥官。往东约100公里处，有平民报告了异常活动。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大型军事建筑 II

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 防空炮塔

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻击设施并为火力任务标记区域

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等待进一步指示

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完成火力任务

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dropship on Approach
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投舰接近中

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Ally Special Reinforcement Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方盟友特种增援小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Garrison Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方驻防小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Supplemental 1 Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方补充 1 小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Supplemental 2 Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方补充 2 小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, there is nothing glamorous about sighting targets for big guns, but the fireworks can be exciting. Just make sure you're clear of the blast radius before those shells land.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，为大口径火炮观测目标不是什么光鲜的活，但那场面确实够刺激。只要确保炮弹落地之前你已经离开爆炸半径就行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We traced the origin of the Soarece tanks to this location. We're not sure if it's a cache or a functioning automated factory. Either way, it needs to go. Place beacons for our Artillery to target, and exfiltrate while our guns destroy the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们追踪索阿雷斯坦克的来源到了这里。我们不确定这是一处储藏库还是一座在运转的自动化工厂。不管是哪种，它都得消失。为我方炮兵放置信标，在我方火炮摧毁基地时撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等待空投舰抵达

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方守军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Special Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌方的特别援军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip on Approach
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投舰接近中

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援来袭

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Extract before Enemy Reinforcements Arrive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌方增援抵达前撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get Visual Confirmation of Artillery Effect
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 获取火炮打击效果的目视确认

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move to the Evac Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Place Beacon Alpha
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置信标 Alpha

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Place Beacon Bravo
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置信标 Bravo

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Place Beacon Charlie
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置信标 Charlie

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Place Beacons for Artillery Quickly
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快速放置炮击信标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: *STATIC* -ell, this round is yours. *COUGH* Until next time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: *静电* ……好吧，这一轮算你的。*咳嗽* 下次再说。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All units, close distance on enemy forces. Send a short wave burst near them to disrupt enemy Artillery from locking on! Move quickly!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有单位注意，缩短与敌军的距离. 在他们附近发起一次短促突击，扰乱敌方大炮的锁定! 快点!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Artillery does not discriminate about what it destroys. Be sure to clear the area once the firing starts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炮击可不长眼睛. 开火后务必确保撤离出该区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, long range sensors are picking up an enemy bogey. They'll be landing any minute.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，远程传感器探测到一个敌方目标。他们随时会着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy units can disrupt the targeting of the beacons. They will deploy forces with the intent to disrupt our beacons. Do not let enemies get near them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方单位能中断信标的指示. 他们会派遣部队试图破坏我们的信标. 不要让敌人接近信标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Confirmed. Shot, out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控，这里是观察员: 确认——射击完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am putting a stop to this, no way we pull this out of the fire. Abort Mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正在叫停这个任务，我们没办法解决这个麻烦了. 放弃任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't have any way to know where they will land, but you can bet they will be close to the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我无法知道他们会在哪里着陆，但可以肯定他们会靠近基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the pressure on to prevent them a chance to place those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 继续压制，别给他们安放那些信标的机会!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what you got.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看你的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Shot Over. Splash in 30
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，请注意，这里是火控: 发射完毕. 30秒后弹着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Firing for Effect. HE 5 rounds. Danger Close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控: 目标锁定，实施火力压制——发射高爆5发，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are tasked with marking an area for artillery strike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的任务是标定一块区域进行炮击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You need to place beacons to designate the attack position. This will take some time to do, so keep the unit placing the beacon nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你需要放置信标指示攻击位置. 这需要一些时间，所以让安放信标的单位留在附近.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Limited Gladiator
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 限定角斗士

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, this should be fun.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，这应该会很有趣。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A local mercenary is trying to make it big. He thinks by calling you out he can gain fame and fortune.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名本地佣兵想出头。他以为向你叫板就能名利双收。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，游戏结束。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是本回合开始的信号！祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Welcome to Team Gladiator Combat, Mechwarrior. Duncan Fisher here where we are more interested in new sponsorship than a Mechwarrior's life. Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欢迎来到团队角斗士对战，机甲战士。我是邓肯·费雪，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机甲战士的性命。说到这个，本场比赛的赞助方是——没有人……因为赞助商都太怕我那出了名的"解说一句倒一家公司"的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdrawal, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们所有目标都已完成，掩护我们撤退，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 精彩，我就知道指挥官有这个本事！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that lance Leader, welcome to the party.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队队长，欢迎加入。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, it's a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, it's a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander. I see Drop Pods inbound.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官。我看到空投舱来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，邓肯！今天能与你共事真是荣幸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我还请来了一位客座解说，他自称是超级粉丝。各位，欢迎达里乌斯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我是说四换一的交易！谁能拒绝这个？！？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 但愿他们的准头比长相好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来其他佣兵也加入了战斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer has kindly added destroying this group to our objectives. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主好心地把这群敌人的消灭也加进了我们的目标。想拿到报酬，我们就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer has offered a bonus if we eliminate this group as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主承诺如果我们一并消灭这帮人，会有额外奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stepping in the drop area may be good for polls, but it wont be good for your 'Mech repair costs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 站到投放区里也许对民调有好处，但对你的机甲修理费用可没好处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This fight just got tighter than two hairs in a manbun!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这场战斗的气氛紧得像发髻里的两根头发！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说这场战斗刚变得动真格的，都是轻描淡写！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Understood Lance Leader, glad to have you with us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白，小队队长，很高兴你加入我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等，你说过我们没有被录音的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等……达里乌斯，这是你安排的吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
多么适合经典近战的一天！
 我们的选手清楚自己的价值，这正是他们今天到场的原因。
 我听说其中一位角斗士被许诺了一份麦片盒代言，所以他才露面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，你看看这个。看来今天的赔率制定者大错特错了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇。这是我今天见过的最精彩的战斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你之前可没这么自信。解说席上的一些音频已经传疯了。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 限定角斗士队伍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来是一场三队近战，指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName}。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer has offered a bonus if we eliminate this group as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主承诺如果我们一并消灭这帮人，会有额外奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stepping in the drop area may be good for polls, but it wont be good for your 'Mech repair costs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 站到投放区里也许对民调有好处，但对你的机甲修理费用可没好处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This fight just got tighter than two hairs in a manbun!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这场战斗的气氛紧得像发髻里的两根头发！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说这场战斗刚变得动真格的，都是轻描淡写！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Understood Lance Leader, glad to have you with us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白，小队队长，很高兴你加入我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等，你说过我们没有被录音的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等……达里乌斯，这是你安排的吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
多么适合经典近战的一天！
 我们的选手清楚自己的价值，这正是他们今天到场的原因。
 我听说其中一位角斗士被许诺了一份麦片盒代言，所以他才露面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，你看看这个。看来今天的赔率制定者大错特错了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇。这是我今天见过的最精彩的战斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你之前可没这么自信。解说席上的一些音频已经传疯了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Limited Gladiator Team
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 限定角斗士队伍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like a 3 team brawl commander, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来是一场三队近战，指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName}。
