Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander. I see Drop Pods inbound.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官。我看到空投舱来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我还请来了一位客座解说，他自称是超级粉丝。各位，欢迎达里乌斯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我是说四换一的交易！谁能拒绝这个？！？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来其他佣兵也加入了战斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maybe you should try again later. Much, much later!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 也许你该晚点再来。晚很多很多！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer has kindly added destroying this group to our objectives. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主好心地把这群敌人的消灭也加进了我们的目标。想拿到报酬，我们就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer has offered a bonus if we eliminate this group as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主承诺如果我们一并消灭这帮人，会有额外奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stepping in the drop area may be good for polls, but it wont be good for your 'Mech repair costs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 站到投放区里也许对民调有好处，但对你的机甲修理费用可没好处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This fight just got tighter than two hairs in a manbun!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这场战斗的气氛紧得像发髻里的两根头发！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说这场战斗刚变得动真格的，都是轻描淡写！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Understood Lance Leader, glad to have you with us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白，小队队长，很高兴你加入我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等，你说过我们没有被录音的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等……达里乌斯，这是你安排的吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
今天可真是打一场经典乱斗的好日子！
我们的参赛者清楚自己的价值，这正是他们今天到场的原因。
我听说有位角斗士收到了一份麦片盒代言合约，这就是他露面的理由。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，你看看这个。看来今天的赔率制定者大错特错了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇。这是我今天见过的最精彩的战斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你之前可没这么自信。解说席上的一些音频已经传疯了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Limited Gladiator Team
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 限定角斗士队伍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like a 3 team brawl commander, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来是一场三队近战，指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName}。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdrawal, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们所有目标都已完成，掩护我们撤退，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amazing tactics there, kid. Except... not really!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战术真精彩啊，小子。只不过……其实并不！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 精彩，我就知道指挥官有这个本事！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that Lance Leader, welcome to the party.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队队长，欢迎加入。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, it's a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, it's a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander. I see Drop Pods inbound.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官。我看到空投舱来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，邓肯！今天能与你共事真是荣幸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我还请来了一位客座解说，他自称是超级粉丝。各位，欢迎达里乌斯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我是说四换一的交易！谁能拒绝这个？！？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 但愿他们的准头比长相好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来其他佣兵也加入了战斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maybe you should try again later. Much, much later!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 也许你该晚点再来。晚很多很多！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer has kindly added destroying this group to our objectives. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主好心地把这群敌人的消灭也加进了我们的目标。想拿到报酬，我们就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer has offered a bonus if we eliminate this group as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主承诺如果我们一并消灭这帮人，会有额外奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stepping in the drop area may be good for polls, but it wont be good for your 'Mech repair costs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 站到投放区里也许对民调有好处，但对你的机甲修理费用可没好处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This fight just got tighter than two hairs in a manbun!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这场战斗的气氛紧得像发髻里的两根头发！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说这场战斗刚变得动真格的，都是轻描淡写！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Understood Lance Leader, glad to have you with us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白，小队队长，很高兴你加入我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等，你说过我们没有被录音的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等……达里乌斯，这是你安排的吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
多么适合经典近战的一天！
 我们的选手清楚自己的价值，这正是他们今天到场的原因。
 我听说其中一位角斗士被许诺了一份麦片盒代言，所以他才露面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，你看看这个。看来今天的赔率制定者大错特错了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇。这是我今天见过的最精彩的战斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你之前可没这么自信。解说席上的一些音频已经传疯了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Limited Gladiator Team
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 限定角斗士队伍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like a 3 team brawl commander, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来是一场三队近战，指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName}。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Welcome to Team Gladiator Combat, Mechwarrior. Duncan Fisher here where we are more interested in new sponsorship than a Mechwarrior's life. Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... 'cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欢迎来到团队角斗士对战，机甲战士。我是邓肯·费雪，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机甲战士的性命。说到这个，本场比赛的赞助方是——没有人……因为赞助商都太怕我那出了名的"解说一句倒一家公司"的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't have to tell you that speed is of the essence here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不用我多说，你也知道速度在这里至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good day, Commander. Mission intelligence is as follows: conditions on the ground do not allow for dropping 'Mechs of heavy tonnage, or particularly large numbers of them. You're being tasked with deploying a fast strike force into a hostile zone. Bring the best you can squeeze into a small package.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 日安，指挥官。任务情报如下：地面条件不允许投放重型吨位的机甲，也不允许投放特别多的数量。你的任务是把一支快速打击部队投放进一处敌意区域。在有限载荷内塞进你所能带的最好的东西。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抵达撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领次要指定区域以接回要人的助手

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 取回氏族技术并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Best of luck, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target location is likely to be well defended.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标地点很可能防守严密。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold this location until our people can grab the asset.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守该位置直到我们的人拿到资产.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need to move up, get eyes on the location, and neutralize any enemy forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要行动起来看看那个地方，然后消灭任何敌方部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Limited Gladiator
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 限定角斗士

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guess he is pissed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来他气坏了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I will mark a possible ambush spot just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以防万一，我会标记一处可能的伏击点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, this should be fun.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，这应该会很有趣。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A local mercenary is trying to make it big. He thinks by calling you out he can gain fame and fortune.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名本地佣兵想出头。他以为向你叫板就能名利双收。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard what Lees did on Shaul Khala. The galaxy will be a better place without a man like him in it.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My agents have traced Colonel Basil Lees to a stronghold in the basin ahead. I want you to raze it to the ground, and destroy anything that attempts to protect it. Show this Davion animal what the Draconis Combine does to those who would slaughter its people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的特工已经追踪到巴泽尔·利斯上校在前方盆地的一处据点. 我希望你将其夷为平地，摧毁一切试图保护它的东西. 向这头戴维恩猪展示，天龙联合体会对那些屠杀其人民的人做什么.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Davion Garrison
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭戴维恩驻军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I raise my glass to you and your lance, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Bring that son of a bitch to justice.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我举杯向你和你的小队致敬，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 将那个混蛋绳之以法.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I will, but to listen only. I have nothing to say to that murderous swine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我会的，但只是听而已. 我对那个杀人恶徒无话可说.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quitting the field, eh? Go on and run, then. Run back to your Kurita masters like the lickspittle coward you are.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已经放弃了吗?然后迅速跑回到你的栗田大师那里 - 就像你是舔唾液的懦夫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sorry to butt in, but we just received a message from Colonel Lees. I hate to say it, but it looks authentic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抱歉打断你们，但我们刚收到一条来自利斯上校的消息. 我讨厌这么说，但看来是真的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is down, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基地完了，指挥官. 干得好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The disused stronghold that Colonel Lees and his band of war criminals have holed up in should be just ahead of you, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 利斯上校及其一群战争罪犯占据的废弃据点应该就在你前方，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch yourself, Boss. It looks like Lees just called in the cavalry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，老板. 看起来像利斯刚才召唤的骑兵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Long Hunt II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 漫长的狩猎 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is our best shot at finding a way out of here, Commander. Let's get it done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是我们找到离开这里办法的最佳机会，指挥官。把它办成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The sensor array that you'll need to capture to escape this system is further ahead, but there are Davion 'Mechs between you and the facility. Kill them before they kill you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你需要夺取以逃离该星系的传感器阵列还在更前方，但你与那处设施之间有达维昂机甲。在他们杀了你之前先杀了他们。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁达维昂增援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Davion Hostiles
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌方戴维恩单位

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm picking up a lot of enemy movement on my sensors, Commander. We may not be hunting Colonel Lees anymore, but it doesn't look like he's given up on hunting us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在传感器上读到大量敌方动向，指挥官。我们也许不再猎杀利斯上校了，但看起来他并没有放弃猎杀我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm pulling you out, Commander. We're done here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我要把你撤出来，指挥官。我们这里结束了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Long Hunt III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 漫长的狩猎 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This has been a hell of a slog, but we're almost through it. Keep moving, Commander. Get our people home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一路真是苦战，但我们快熬过去了。继续前进，指挥官。带我们的人回家。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Davion sensor array you'll need to capture is just ahead, Commander. Take it, and Ms. Meyer will have what she needs to neutralize Lees's threat to the Argo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你需要夺取的Davion传感器阵列就在前方。拿下它，Meyer女士就能得到她所需要的东西，用以解除Lees对Argo的威胁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're running, eh? Fleeing like a craven? Let me guess: you want to use the array to expedite your escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你在跑，是吧？像懦夫一样逃？让我猜猜：你想用阵列来加速逃跑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Long Hunt II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 漫长的狩猎 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a bit of a Catch-22 situation, Commander… we can't afford to leave these jokers standing, but I'll bet you anything that Lees sent them here to soften us up before our attack on the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这有点进退两难，指挥官……我们承受不起让这些活宝活着，但我敢跟你打赌，利斯派他们来这里是为了在我们攻打基地之前削弱我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My people on the ground have picked up a lance of Davion BattleMechs on their sensors, Commander. If you move on Lees without dealing with them, they'll be in position to outflank you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在地面的人员在传感器上发现一支达维昂战斗机甲分队，指挥官。如果你不先解决他们就向利斯推进，他们就会处于包抄你的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A performance as pathetic as it was disappointing. Bask in your shame, Reynauld! Your attempt on my life has failed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一场既可悲又令人失望的表演. 沉浸在你的耻辱中吧，雷纳德！你对我的刺杀失败了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acknowledged, Colonel Lees. It will be our pleasure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，利斯上校. 这将是我们的荣幸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. You've accepted my challenge, then? Good. It would have been terribly anticlimactic if you'd fled.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官。那么你接受了我的挑战？很好。如果你逃了，那可就太虎头蛇尾了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My mercenaries will punish you for the butchery you committed on Shaul Khala, Lees. You will die in disgrace.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的雇佣兵将严惩你在绍尔哈拉犯下的暴行，利斯. 你终将耻辱地死去.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apprehend Colonel Basil Lees
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 俘获巴泽尔·利斯上校

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to retrieve the primary rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got Lees backed into a corner. Time to finish the job.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已把里斯逼到角落。是时候了结这桩事了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonel Lees's stronghold is just ahead of you, Commander. For all his arrogant bluster, it would seem that the Butcher of Shaul Khala is a coward at heart. I've seen no sign that he intends to meet you on the field of battle. So be it; if he won't leave his fortress voluntarily, then I will have your BattleMechs remove him by force.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，利斯上校的据点就在你前方。尽管他吹得狂妄，绍尔哈拉的屠夫骨子里似乎是个懦夫。我没看到任何他打算在战场上与你会面的迹象。那就这样吧；既然他不肯主动离开堡垒，我就让你的战斗机甲把他强行搬走。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pull Colonel Lees from His Hiding Place
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把利斯上校从藏身之处拖出来

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I welcome your mercenaries to try, drunkard. They will find themselves quite outmatched.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我欢迎你的雇佣兵来试试，你这个酒鬼. 他们会发现自己完全不是对手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Justice? You call this justice?! Those Kuritan dogs will have me executed without trial!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 正义?你这叫正义?！这些栗田混蛋会不经审判就处决我！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. My agents tell me that the Butcher of Shaul Khala is sheltering in a disused tower just ahead of you. Apparently, he'd rather hide in his command center than face you directly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这里，指挥官。我的特工告诉我，绍尔哈拉的屠夫就藏在你正前方一座废弃塔楼里。看来他宁愿躲在自己的指挥中心里，也不愿直接面对你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Joint Venture
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 合资企业

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the Steiner Convoy to its Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送施泰纳车队前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try adn stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Steiner isn't even supposed to have a presence in this system, so be careful. When the Capellans pick you up on their sensors, I imagine that all hell is gonna break loose.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯坦纳家族本不该在这个星系有任何存在，所以小心。当卡佩兰人在传感器上发现你时，我想一切都会乱了套。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have eyes on Sentry Team Alpha, Commander—they're patrolling the AO, just as I said they would be. Expect moderate-to-heavy resistance on the path to your objective. As a reminder, it is absolutely vital that this convoy reach its destination. Do not disappoint me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们盯上哨兵小队阿尔法了，指挥官——他们正在巡逻行动区域，正如我所料。通往目标的路途上预期会遇到中到重度抵抗。提醒一下，这支车队抵达目的地绝对至关重要。别让我失望。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队直到空投舰抵达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All Capellan troops, destroy that convoy! Your families will be held accountable if you fail!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有卡佩拉军队: 摧毁这支车队！如果你们失败了，你们的家人会为此付出代价！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've marked Graf Stieglitz-Bradford's rendezvous point on your map, Commander. Convoy leader, do you copy?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已在地图上标出施蒂格利茨-布拉德福德伯爵的会合点，指挥官。车队领队，收到了吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Joint Venture II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 合资企业 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targetted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objetive: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏任务: 消灭第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This new Steiner-Davion BattleMech looks pretty damned impressive for its class. Let's hope it's enough to get us through this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台新的施泰纳-达维昂战斗机甲在其级别里相当惊艳。但愿它足以让我们撑过去。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Liao's occupation force is moving on our Mech Bay in force, Commander. I know that you've had no time to refit or repair your BattleMechs, but I'm going to need your assistance all the same. In light of this, I've authorized the deployment of a Steiner asset—the very rare and precious BattleMech that you just delivered to this site—to assist you, with one of my own MechWarriors to pilot it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，廖氏家族的占领军正大举逼近我们的机甲库。我知道你还没来得及改装或修理你的战斗机甲，但我还是需要你的协助。鉴于此，我已授权部署一件施泰纳资产——你刚送到这里的、极为稀有珍贵的战斗机甲——来协助你，并由我的一名机甲战士驾驶。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. I'm afraid that Dr. Murad's sensor readings have been confirmed: a large contingent of Liao Reserves are en route to the Mech Bay at this moment, and they are eager to strike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。恐怕穆拉德博士的传感器读数已经得到证实：大批廖氏预备部队此刻正前往机甲库，他们急切地想要发起攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Like the man said, we're going into this one blind, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. House Steiner isn't even supposed to have a presence in this system, so whatever we're about to walk into, we're doing it alone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就像那人说的，我们这次是盲着进去，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。施泰纳家族本不该在这个星系有任何存在，所以不管我们即将撞上什么，都得独自应对。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have little to no intel on what you're going to find out there, Commander. Keep your eyes open; it's absolutely vital that this convoy reach its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们对你将在外面遇到什么几乎一无所知，指挥官。睁大眼睛；这支车队抵达目的地绝对至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，肃清区域内的额外部队，并撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remember, Viribium is an airless planet. Watch your heat levels out there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别忘了，维里比姆是一颗没有大气层的行星. 注意机甲的热量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beasts of Balawat have units scattered all across this basin. More importantly, they've got a monster LRM boat that needs to go down before we can even try to move the convoy to a landing site. It's an assault 'Mech, Stalker-class, heavily modified for indirect fire. Destroy it and proceed to the rendezvous site.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴拉瓦特野兽队在这一盆地里散布着各单位。更重要的是，他们有一艘怪物级LRM艇，必须在我们可以试着把车队移向着陆点之前先干掉。那是一台突击机甲，潜行者级，为间接火力大幅改装。摧毁它，然后前往会合点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It looks like my faith in your company was misplaced, {COMMANDER.LastName}. Pick up the pieces of your lance and fall back to a safe distance. My Kell Hounds and I will handle this situation on our own.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我对你们公司的信任是错付了，{COMMANDER.LastName}. 收拾好你们小队的残局，撤退到安全距离. 我和我的凯尔猎犬会自行处理这个局面.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beasts of Balawat's modified Stalker should be somewhere in this area of operation, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴拉瓦特的野兽那台改装潜行者应该就在这一行动区域的某处，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Baying of Hounds II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎犬的狂吠 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rendezvous with Tempest's Convoy and escort it to the Evac Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与暴风雨的车队会合并护送其前往撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In theory, we've already done the heavy lifting on this one, but keep your eyes open. We still don't know why the Beasts of Balawat are chasing Kell's people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 理论上，我们在这件事上已经干完了重活，但睁大眼睛。我们仍不知道巴拉瓦特野兽队为什么追凯尔的人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the LRM Stalker down, you should be clear to rendezvous with Tempest's convoy. Escort the vehicles to the pickup point, and get them there in one piece. All other considerations are secondary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着LRM潜行者被击倒，你应当可以安全地与暴风的车队会合了。护送车辆抵达接应点，并确保它们完好无损地到达。其余一切考虑都是次要的。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队，直到空投艇安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rendezvous with Tempest's Convoy and Escort It to the Evac Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与暴风雨的车队会合并护送其前往撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is holed up near this location, Commander. They're surrounded by BattleMechs flying the colors of the Beasts of Balawat; you may have taken out their fire support, but they're still in the fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队窝藏在这个位置附近，指挥官。他们被涂着巴拉瓦特野兽队配色的战斗机甲包围着；你也许打掉了他们的火力支援，但他们仍在战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Baying of Hounds III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎犬的狂吠 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If Kell is saying that this will be tough, I'm inclined to believe him. Get your war face on, Commander. This is gonna be a hell of a drop.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果凯尔说这会很难，我倾向于相信他。摆出你的战斗表情，指挥官。这一投可够狠的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This will be a difficult fight, Commander. The Beasts of Balawat are former Kell Hounds; they've received some of the best training and equipment you'll find anywhere. But more than that, they've got something to prove.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一仗会很艰难，指挥官。巴拉瓦特野兽队是前凯尔猎犬；他们受过你所能找到的最好的训练、拥有最好的装备。但更重要的是，他们有东西要证明。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭“巴拉瓦特野兽”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Morgan. You're here. After all these years, you can't imagine how gratifying it is to see you on the other end of a battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摩根。你来了。这么多年之后，你无法想象在战场另一端见到你有多令人欣慰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You promised to release Tempest and Megan. I expect you to keep your word.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你承诺过会释放坦佩斯特和梅根. 我希望你能遵守诺言.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Baying of Hounds III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎犬的狂吠 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is going to be risky, but it seems like the only way to be certain that Kell's people make it home safe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这会有风险，但看起来这是唯一能确保凯尔的人安全回家的办法。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beasts of Balawat's armory is just ahead of you, Commander. Strike swiftly, take the facility, and hold it until Megan and Tempest can be extracted. The Kell Hounds and I will handle Rhee and her people. Let's do this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴拉瓦特野兽队的军械库就在你前方，指挥官。迅速出击，拿下设施，并守住它，直到梅根和暴风能被撤离出来。凯尔猎犬和我来处理李和她的人。动手吧。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Damn it. We bit off more than we could chew, {COMMANDER.LastName}. This is my failure as much as it is yours.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该死的. 我们胃口太大，吞不下了，{COMMANDER.LastName}. 这次失败，我跟你一样有责任.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip inbound, Commander. Watch your heads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投艇正在进场，指挥官. 注意头顶.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, {COMMANDER.Callsign}. I've got an assault lance on the ground keeping Rhee and her Beasts occupied. They won't be expecting a backdoor attack on their armory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，{COMMANDER.Callsign}。我已派出一支突击分队在地面缠住李和她的野兽们。他们不会料到有人从后门打他们的军械库。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's keep our eyes open for any surprises, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 睁大眼睛留意任何意外，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There she is - up in that base. I want my 'Mech back. Bring it in, and we'll clear the area of these traitors. I'm sure you understand the need for vengeance when your name is on the line and they've stolen your fighting machines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 她就在那儿——在那座基地里。我要拿回我的机甲。把它带出来，我们就替这片区域清掉这些叛徒。我相信你能理解，当你的名字被挂在上面、而他们偷走了你的战斗机甲时，复仇是多么必要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is odd. Pirates fighting pirates. Wait, now that I think about it... it makes perfect sense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这真奇怪。海盗打海盗。等等，仔细一想……这完全说得通。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, you've been referred to us for your reputation for discretion and efficiency. The job is as follows: we need you to help us break the Queen out of jail. Then extract her from the area safely.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你因谨慎高效的声名被推荐给我们。任务如下：我们需要你帮我们把女王从监狱里弄出来。然后把她安全撤离该地区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If ya move up, you can secure the area and we can bust our Queen out of jail!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果你继续推进，就能控制该区域，我们就能把女王从监狱里捞出来！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This should be extremely painful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该会非常痛苦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Time for some payback. Since Sybil's unit isn't here. I am going to pound her men into the ground. Be a good minion and help me with this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该算账了。既然西比尔的部队不在这里，我就要把她的人砸进地里。做个好手下，帮我一把。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们就在附近某处，让我们把这些叛徒追到地底下去。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Time to bring the thunder.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是时候降下雷霆了。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As expected, the facility has operational turrets. Move cautiously, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不出所料，该设施内的炮台仍在运作. 谨慎推进，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Occupy the facility and destroy any forces you encounter. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领该设施，并摧毁你遇到的任何部队. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the target area, Commander. The facility is just beyond the rock formations, along the river.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标区域到了，指挥官. 设施就在河边的岩层后面.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hopefully we have bought the clan leaders enough time to gather.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 但愿我们已经为部族首领们争取到足够时间聚集。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ComStar Reinforcments have arrived. Let us meet them in the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 康星的增援已抵达。让我们在战场上会会他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taking it directly to the head of the clan. Nothing like some honorable combat in the morning
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 直接把事摊到氏族首领面前。早上来点荣誉战斗再没有更好的了

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're receiving a transmission from the Clan Forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们收到氏族部队的通讯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数表明埋伏的单位没用了. 雇主会满意的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴他们对我们有信心，但说实话，我更希望在战场上有些增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have reached the destination: The bunker containing the genetic legacy of the Reaved Clan.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已抵达目的地：收容被洗劫氏族基因遗产的掩体。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: *静电* ……好吧，这一轮算你的。*咳嗽* 下次再说。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, they are deploying vehicles and tanks from their motorpool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你使用武器库中的车辆和坦克.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is it. When we destroy this facility, we will have reaved the genetic legacy of this clan.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，就是这里了。摧毁这座设施，我们就等于洗劫了这个氏族的基因遗产。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Danger close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控中心: 目标锁定，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once all three beacons are placed, wait for the orbital strike to confirm its effect. Then make for the extraction LZ and the Leopard will pick you up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦三个信标都放置完毕，等待轨道打击，以确认命中. 然后前往撤离点，豹式会来接应你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rescue Max Billings
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 营救马克斯·比林斯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to retrieve the primary rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More spies. Makes me wonder how deep ComStar infiltration actually goes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又是间谍。让我不禁想康星的渗透到底有多深。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have another agent trying to safely return to base. We need you to retrieve and deliver them to us. The agent's knowledge is crucial to providing us with strike coordinates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们又有一名特工正试图安全返回基地。我们需要你去接应他们并把人交给我们。这名特工掌握的情报对提供打击坐标至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Max has always been a reliable source. Presently, he has an archive of the targets these pirates have been hitting and their future goals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马克斯一直是个可靠的来源。目前他手里有一份档案，记录着这些海盗袭击过的目标以及他们未来的意图。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Revelations II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 启示录 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like more fighting overpowered pirates. Least I don't see the Queen's unit marked on the map.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来又是打那些不堪一击的海盗。至少地图上没标出女王的部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You will need to fight through to get to the base we talked about. They have it guarded pretty decently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你得一路打过去才能抵达我们谈过的那座基地。他们守得相当严密。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm picking up a lot of enemy movement on my sensors, Commander. They seem agitated that we rescued Max.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的传感器探测到大量敌军动向，指挥官。他们似乎因为我们救出马克斯而躁动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm pulling you out, Commander. We're done here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我要把你撤出来，指挥官。我们这里结束了。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些海盗抢劫掠夺。无需为他们难过，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pirate Base straight ahead, and beyond that their drop zone. Let's move up and send a message!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗基地就在正前方，再过去是他们的投放区。我们推进，发个信息过去！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is down, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基地完了，指挥官. 干得好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pirates forward base is just ahead of you, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗的前沿基地就在你前方，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guess we will go in and capture the base. Should provide more information on what these Pirates are actually doing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我想我们就进去夺取基地吧。应该能提供更多关于这些海盗到底在干什么的信息。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, leave my crap alone. I have had enough of you Mercs!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，别碰我的东西。我受够你们这些雇佣兵了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lady Alekto
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿勒克托女士

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taking down a Dropship on a full night's rest and fully repaired 'Mechs might be easier. Make sure to withdraw Commander, if you get stuck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果有一整晚休息和完好机甲，干掉空投艇也许更容易。指挥官，如果陷住了，务必撤退。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I need you to take down the pirate Dropship before they can take off. This could be quite dangerous, but it may be our only hope of saving the Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我需要你在那艘海盗空投艇起飞之前把它拿下。这可能会相当危险，但这也许是我们拯救内天体的唯一希望。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's flush out this guy and restore our rating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们把这家伙揪出来，恢复我们的评级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The communications facility has not been alerted to our presence as we'd hoped, Commander. That means we will be able to land your team unnoticed and destroy the facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，通讯设施并未如我们所愿察觉到我们的存在。这意味着我们能让你的队伍在无人察觉的情况下着陆并摧毁该设施。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the facility is just on the other side of that hill, straight ahead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，设施就在那座山丘的另一侧，正前方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Return of the Steel Beast II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢铁野兽归来 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我在这里看到的唯一真正危险，是他们设法让人溜过我们身边。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Their command structure is fleeing, with an escorting lance... I wouldn't expect more than a single lance as an escort.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们的指挥体系正在逃跑，带一支护航小队……我不指望护航超过一支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察车队路线

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All the escort units are down, Commander. Focus your fire on any remaining units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有护卫单位均已摧毁，指挥官. 集中火力攻击任何残余单位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Force Commander, mercenary unit dropped in the AO. Ground vehicles and BattleMechs spotted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部队指挥官，雇佣兵部队已在作战区域投放. 侦测到地面车辆与战斗机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the convoy is handled, move to the extraction LZ here. The Leopard will remain on station to handle the pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦解决完车队，前往此处撤离点. 豹式会待命执行接应任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Right on target, Lieutenant. Well done. Commander, if you bring your lance up to this position, you should be able to see the convoy and its escort.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完美，中尉. 干得好. 指挥官，如果你把小队带到这个位置，应该能看到目标车队及其护卫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy will be in sight of the destroyed base soon, Commander. You need to bring them down immediately, or the operation will be exposed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队应该很快就会看到被摧毁的基地了，指挥官. 你必须立刻干掉他们，否则行动就暴露了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Return of the Steel Beast III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢铁野兽归来 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I will mark a possible ambush spot just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以防万一，我会标记一处可能的伏击点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not questioning your judgement about bringing a single 'Mech against this guy. All I'm saying is I could lose a lot of money on the company betting pool if this goes South.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不是在质疑你带一台机甲去对付这家伙的判断。我只是说，要是这事搞砸了，我在公司的赌盘上会输很多钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Steel Beast is back. And he's searching for revenge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢铁野兽回来了。而他正在寻找复仇。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am going to show the universe the Steel Beast is not to be messed with!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我要让全宇宙知道，钢铁野兽不是好惹的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tubbs needs to go down hard, Commander. The only acceptable measure of victory is enemy tonnage destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔布斯必须被彻底打倒，指挥官。唯一可接受的胜利标准是摧毁敌方吨位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, Tubbs is down there. He has supporters - mostly gladiators with no love for you. Exercise caution, but remember your goal here: drop and eliminate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，塔布斯就在下面。他有支持者——大多是看你不顺眼的角斗士。谨慎行事，但记住你在这里的目标：投放并消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的名字将与失败划上等号！我要用你的头骨饮酒，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These 'debt collectors' have BattleMechs. Cheating only pays the enforcers, it looks like.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些"讨债人"有战斗机甲。看来作弊只养肥了执法者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You won't like this, but Tubbs is signaling for a rescue. Talk about choosing beggars. He is currently up to his ass in debt, and our Solaris reps want him off planet alive. We are to pick him up and then turn him over to local authorities for processing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你不会喜欢这个，但塔布斯正在发信号求救。真是会挑人。他目前深陷债务，而我们的索拉里斯代表要他活着离开这颗星球。我们要去接他，然后把他交给当地当局处置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're picking up a tight-beam transmission coming from the secondary facility in the lagoon. It's Tubbs' distress signal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到来自潟湖中次级设施的一束窄波通讯。那是塔布斯的求救信号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Target has gone to ground, apparently a Stable has set up base for him here to retreat to. I say we blow it sky high and end our Tubb-y friend.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已转入地下，显然有一家马疚在此为他设了据点供他退守。我说我们把它炸上天，了结我们这位胖乎乎的塔布朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, they are deploying vehicles and tanks from their motor pool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你使用武器库中的车辆和坦克.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the pressure on to deny them the chance to place those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持压制，防止他们有机会放置信标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solaris Stable Gladiators are on the ground in the area of operation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索拉里斯马疚角斗士已抵达行动区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Opportunist
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机会主义者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point, Escort Convoy to Safety, and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点，护送车队至安全地带，并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This shouldn't be anything out of the ordinary, Commander. Let's get it done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该没什么特别的，指挥官。我们把它办完。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ms. Hadley's prison transport is waiting for you on the planet's surface, Commander. You will meet with it at a designated rendezvous point, then escort it to a distant repair bay. The personnel there stand ready to hold Ms. Hadley and patch up the prison transport APCs. When they're finished, you'll be free to press on to the extraction point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哈德利女士的囚犯运输车在行星地表等着你，指挥官。你将在指定会合点与它会合，然后护送它前往一处遥远的维修舱。那里的人员随时准备关押哈德利女士并修补囚犯运输装甲车。他们完工后，你就可以自由前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭强盗增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Bandit Roadblock
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁土匪的路障

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ensure That All Prison Transport Convoy Units Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保所有囚车护卫队单位存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the Prison Transport to the Repair Bay
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送囚车到维修站

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to the Repair Bay
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 去维修区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队直到空投舰抵达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good to see you, Commander. We're ready to get moving as soon as you reach the rendezvous point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴见到你，指挥官。你一抵达会合点，我们就准备出发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Opportunist II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机会主义者 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targetted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objetive: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏任务: 消灭第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, this just got interesting. Saddle up, {COMMANDER.FirstName}, we've got a prison to defend.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，这下有意思了。上马，{COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们有座监狱要守。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our sensors indicate several large groups of incoming vehicles and BattleMechs, Commander. Whoever they are, I need you to hold them off and drive them away. Above all, they cannot be allowed to free Ms. Hadley from confinement. She belongs to us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的传感器显示有多支大型车辆和战斗机甲部队正在逼近，指挥官. 无论他们是谁，我都需要你挡住他们并将其击退. 最重要的是——绝不能让他们把哈德利女士从监禁中解救出来. 她是我们的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌人来袭

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护所有目标建筑免遭摧毁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend the Fortified Repair Bay
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫加固的维修区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Incoming Hostiles
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭进攻的敌方单位

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [Incoming transmission.]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [传入传输.]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Both groups of unidentified hostiles are moving into comms range now, Commander. Hopefully they're in a talking mood, because I want to know what we're up against.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，两群不明敌意单位现在都进入了通讯范围。但愿他们愿意谈，因为我想知道我们要面对什么。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: NOT USED IN THIS FLASHPOINT.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本闪点中未使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your attention, please: this is Commander Mitchell Pearle of the Joppan Light Cavalry. You have custody of a woman who is wanted on my world for multiple charges of larceny, burglary, and grand theft. You will surrender her to me immediately, or my people will take her from you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，注意！我是乔帕轻骑兵的指挥官米切尔·珀尔. 你们目前关押着一名女子，她在我的世界因多项盗窃、入室行窃和重大盗窃罪而被通缉. 请立即将她移交给我，否则我方将强行夺人.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置信标 Charlie 以指示炮击目标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't trust Hadley—or Sweeney, or whatever her name really is—for a second, but she should be secure enough in the repair bay's makeshift brig. My advice? Let's go in expecting a double cross, and let's monitor Hadley's cell. At the first sign of trouble, we double back and get her to Lady Cunningham.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我一秒也不信任哈德利——或者说斯威尼，不管她真名叫什么——但她待在维修舱那个临时牢房里应该足够安全。我的建议？我们进去时就假定会被摆一道，并盯住哈德利的牢房。一有麻烦的迹象，我们就折返把她交给坎宁安女士。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm glad that you decided to listen to reason, Commander—you'd be surprised how many so-called mercenaries lack the savvy to jump on an opportunity like this when it presents itself. Now, the LosTech cache that I'm sending you after is close to our location, but there's a catch: it's sealed away in a defunct mineshaft. I've got a way in, though. Follow my instructions, and we'll all get rich.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴你决定听从理性，指挥官——你会惊讶地发现，有多少所谓的雇佣兵在机会来临时缺乏抓住它的精明。现在，我派你去找的那处失传科技储藏点离我们位置很近，但有个条件：它被封在一处废弃的矿井里。不过我有进去的办法。照我的指示做，我们都能发财。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gods, what a fiasco. On the plus side, this little diversion bought me all the time I needed to slip out of my cage with my new friend here from the repair crew.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天哪，真是一场灾难. 但至少这个小小的分心让我有时间，和我的小伙伴从维修队逃跑.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like the big guns have a target lock, Boss. The fireworks should begin any second now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看起来大家伙已经锁定了目标，老板. 烟花随时都会开始.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Commander. Tell your lances to put their game faces on, 'cause there's a lot of lovely salvage out there for the taking, and we're only going to get one shot at this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官。让你的人摆好比赛脸，因为外面有大量可爱的战利品等着拿，而我们只有一次机会。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shot out, cue the explosions any second now!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 发射大炮 - 声音会很大！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This should not be used in this Flashpoint.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不应在本闪点中使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Opportunist III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机会主义者 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point, Escort Convoy to Safety, and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点，护送车队至安全地带，并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try adn stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The sooner we get these people to the rendezvous point, the sooner we can go home. Let's get a move on, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们越早把这些人送到会合点，就能越早回家。快点动身，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've received the coordinates for the rendezvous point from Lady Cunningham, Commander… we should be ready to roll when you are. I haven't managed to get Lady Cunningham herself on the horn—some kind of atmospheric interference is scrambling our long-range comms. But it should be pretty straightforward, all things said.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我从坎宁安女士那里收到了会合点的坐标，指挥官……你准备好我们就能出发。我没能联系上坎宁安女士本人——某种大气干扰扰乱了我们的远程通讯。不过总的来说，应该相当直接。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌对的土匪

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送囚犯运输车至坎宁安女士的空投艇

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to the Rendezvous Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往集合点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Prison Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在囚犯押运车队登上空投艇时保护该车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Prison Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在空投艇抵达前保护囚车护卫队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, Commander, we're all patched up and ready to roll.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官，我们都修补好了，随时可以出发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pack it in, Commander. Nothing left to do here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收工吧，指挥官。这里没别的事了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sounds like a plan. Our lance will keep them off of you while you move on the pickup point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听起来是个计划. 当你们前往撤离点时，我们的机甲将把敌人挡在外面.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seven Pieces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 七块碎片

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to move Jimmy to another prison. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌对方渣滓正试图把吉米转到另一所监狱。杀了他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I refuse to believe it's going to be that easy, Commander. Keep your eyes peeled; this seems too simple.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不信会这么容易，指挥官。睁大眼睛；这看起来太简单了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seems simple enough. Stop a local government convoy carrying a suspected traitor. No one should even care if he dies to be honest.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听起来够简单。拦下一支载着一名疑似叛徒的当地政府车队。说实话，就算他死了也该没人在乎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队的护卫舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Convoy Guards
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队护卫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止车队到达目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recon the Convoy's Route
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察车队路线

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get on with it. Time's a tickin'.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快点动手吧。时间不等人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Told you this wouldn't be simple.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我早说过这事不会简单。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently they are moving our target again. This time by 'Mech. We are switching this to an assassinate mission and giving you the coordinates. Good Luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 显然他们又把我们的目标转移了。这次是用机甲运。我们把这次改成刺杀任务并给你坐标。祝好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor Breached
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装甲击穿

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Assassination Lance Hidden Objective
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁刺杀小队的隐藏目标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Jimmy's 'Mech and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁吉米的机甲并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Ambushers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭伏击中的敌人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！
