Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arslan's Janissaries maintain a fortified stronghold and base of operations here, on this plateau. It was from this site that they negotiated their contract against my family.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔斯兰的禁卫军在这片台地上维持着一处筑垒据点和作战基地。他们就是从这处地点谈判签下针对我家族的合约的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I need you to take the structure, but you must capture it in one piece.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我需要你夺取该建筑，但不要摧毁它.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nicely done, Commander. Sit tight and hold the facility. My forensics team should be joining you within the hour.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官. 留在那里并保护设施. 我的取证小组应该会在一小时内抵达.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the facility is ours and the Janissaries have been vanquished, my forensics team will scour the area. Gods willing, they will uncover the identity of my true enemy, that we may visit justice upon him.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当设施被我方控制且禁卫军被歼灭后，我的取证团队将彻底搜查该区域. 诸神保佑，愿他们能揭露我真正敌人的身份，以便我们施以正义.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: White Lies II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 善意的谎言 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nice, clean, and simple. Just the kind of job I like, and just what we'd have missed if we'd taken our shadowy friend up on his offer. You made the right call, {COMMANDER.FirstName}—now let's finish this thing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干净利落、简单明了。正是我喜欢的那种活儿，也正是我们若接受那位神秘朋友的提议就会错过的。你做了正确的决定，{COMMANDER.FirstName}——现在我们把这事办完。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to the information my team pulled from the base you captured, our target—my enemy—is one Murdoch Dhawan, a small-time political extremist from Kilarney. He's here, in this basin. Destroy him and you will be well rewarded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据我团队从你夺取的基地中提取的信息，我们的目标——我的敌人——是基拉尼的一个小混混式政治极端分子，名叫默多克·达万。他就在这个盆地里。摧毁他，你会得到丰厚报酬。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Assassination Lance Hidden Objective
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁刺杀小队的隐藏目标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Criminal BattleMechs
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁罪犯的战斗机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate Murdoch Dhawan
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭默多克·达万

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent Dhawan from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止Dhawan逃跑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dhawan is here, in this basin. According to the intel my people dug up in the computers you seized, Dhawan is a political extremist whose juvenile philosophy begins and ends with \"eat the rich.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达万就在这里，就在这个盆地里。根据我的人在你缴获的计算机中挖出的情报，达万是一名政治极端分子，他那幼稚的哲学从头到尾只有一句"吃掉富人"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our intitial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They can try, Singh. I will spit on their corpses, and then I will spit on yours.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们可以试试，辛格. 我将在他们的尸体上吐口水……然后再吐到你的尸体上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: White Lies II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 善意的谎言 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like Force Commander Singh's forensics team bought the false intel we planted. Let's hope it leads to the payoff we were promised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来辛格部队指挥官的取证小组买下了我们植入的假情报。但愿它能带来承诺的回报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to the information recovered by my forensics team, our target—the person responsible for my family's suffering—is Lord Parzival Gurung, the head of a minor noble house from Atreus. Lord Gurung is well connected and well defended. If we're going to capture him, first we must strike against his bodyguard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据我的法医团队恢复的信息，我们的目标——那个对我家族苦难负责的人——是帕齐瓦尔·古隆领主，来自阿特柔斯的一个小贵族家族的族长。古隆领主关系网深、护卫严密。如果我们要俘获他，必须先打击他的保镖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Enemy Units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方单位

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Hostile Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌人的增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gurung is no MechWarrior, but he has a robust and powerful bodyguard. I need you to eliminate as many of them as you can before we can advance on his location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Gurung不是机甲战士，但他拥有强大且久经考验的保镖. 在我们面对他之前，你必须尽可能多地消灭他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thanks to you, Commander, I finally know who's been attacking my family. In retrospect, his identity should have been obvious to me. My father sent Gurung's mother to prison for sedition nearly 20 years ago, and evidently he's still holding a grudge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多亏了你，指挥官，我终于知道是谁一直在袭击我的家族。事后看来，他的身份本该显而易见得让我一眼认出。我父亲近二十年前以煽动叛乱罪把古隆的母亲送进了监狱，显然他到今天还怀恨在心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: White Lies III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 善意的谎言 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Singh still believes that Gurung was behind the attacks on his family. That's bad news for Gurung, but it's good for us. Let's do this thing and get paid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 辛格仍相信古隆是他家族遭袭的幕后黑手。这对古隆是坏消息，对我们却是好消息。我们把这事办了拿钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With Lord Gurung's bodyguard in ruins, we are clear to advance on the armory he's taking refuge in. When the building is ours, I will deal with the man personally. He will pay for what his hirelings have done to my family.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 古隆领主的保镖已被击溃，我们可以放心向着他藏身的军械库推进。等那栋建筑归我们，我会亲自处置这个人。他会为他的雇佣手下对我家人所做的一切付出代价。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture the Armory
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领军械库

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Security Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭安保部增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold the Armory against Security Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住军械库，抵御安保增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pacify the Surrounding Area
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定周边区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A trace on Gurung's last comm signal places him at the armory just ahead of you, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对古隆最后一次通讯信号的追踪把他定位在你前方的军械库，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander! DropShip inbound!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官！空投艇逼近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While House Gurung hails from the capital system of Atreus, they have their fingers in industries all over the Frontier. This armory belongs to one of their top arms dealers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然古隆家族来自首都星阿特柔斯星系，但其产业遍布边境. 这座军械库属于他们最大的军火商之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simple Greeting
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简单问候

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not much to say, Commander. Shoot to kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没什么可说的，指挥官. 往死里打.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, no parlay, and no prisoners.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲分队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们一路焚毁人口中心、烧掉田地和炼油厂、洗劫仓储设施。他们显然在尽一切所能把我们的民众赶走。这是恐怖主义，纯粹而简单。我们要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不许谈判，不留俘虏。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方单位

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is going to be a stand-up fight, Commander. Your lance against the opposing force's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这将是一场正面硬仗，指挥官。你的分队对上对方的分队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simple Greeting II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简单问候 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy is trying to deliver contraband to a hostile faction. Destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队正试图向敌对势力运送违禁品。摧毁它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These are going to be lightly armored targets, Commander. The real challenge will be keeping them from making a run for it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些都是轻装甲目标，指挥官. 真正的挑战是阻止他们逃跑.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're tracking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoys that have been delivering weapons and explosives to a self-appointed warlord here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. In return, his fighters have been wreaking havoc on {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facilities in the region. We need you to interdict the convoy and destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在追踪{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给运输队，它们一直在向{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一个自封军阀运送武器和炸药。作为回报，他的战士一直在破坏该地区的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。我们需要你拦截并摧毁这支运输队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌对援军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Convoy and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Convoy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Convoy Escorts
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭车队护卫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Convoy Guards
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队护卫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intercept the Convoy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拦截车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stop Convoy From Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止车队逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need to stop those weapon convoys.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们得阻止那些武器车队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good hunting, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狩猎愉快，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy guards are down, Commander! Great work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队的护卫完了，指挥官! 干得漂亮.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simple Greeting
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简单问候

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I really like 'loud and fatal' as a job description, Commander. I may get it put on a plaque.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真的很喜欢"响亮而致命"这个职位描述，指挥官。也许我该把它刻在牌子上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're planning an operation and to pull it off, we need the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities to be temporarily distracted. We need you to create that distraction. We'll point you at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol. You do something loud and fatal to them. Meanwhile, we execute our operation and give you a cut of the proceeds. Oh, and there may be reinforcements. That's good; that's one less lance to get in our way.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's keep our eyes open for any surprises, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 睁大眼睛留意任何意外，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, While you capture Maximums Base We will sneak into their production Facilities and Snatch their prototype. We are counting on you Commander
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，当你们夺取Maximums基地时，我们会潜入他们的生产设施，抢夺他们的原型机. 我们指望你了，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As expected, the facility has operational turrets. Move cautiously, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不出所料，该设施内的炮台仍在运作. 谨慎推进，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like our intel was accurate. The base is heavily defended and prepared for an assault.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们的情报是准确的. 基地防御森严，已经做好了应对攻击的准备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Next we find a defensable Position and repel their Recovery lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接下来我们找一个可防守的位置，击退他们的回收小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Occupy the facility and destroy any forces you encounter. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领该设施，并摧毁你遇到的任何部队. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They were able to broadcast a distress signal, Commander. We have to scrub the mission. Dammit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们成功发出了求救信号，指挥官. 我们得取消这次任务. 该死.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the target area, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这就是目标区域，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Whats the next move?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 下一步行动是什么?

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 成功建立的殖民地 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll be outnumbered two to one, Commander. I don't particularly like those odds, but we're committed now, so let's buckle down and get the job done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们会被二比一压制，指挥官。我不太喜欢这种胜算，但既然已经投入，就沉住气把活干完。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now that we have secured the asset, The Company is going to be all over us.I expect heavy assortment of mercs and security guards coming after us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 既然我们已经拿到了资产，公司肯定会全力追击我们. 我预计会有各式各样的雇佣兵和安保人员追来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field. Keep an eye out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴他们对我们有信心，但说实话，我更希望在战场上有些增援。留意点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Maximum Distric Leadership is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些传输数据足以让我们定位该地区最高行政区领导层藏身的加固掩体。他们以为在那里很安全，但我们在轨道上有一门舰载PPC，随时能在他们下面建的任何东西上打出一个洞。你需要把你的机甲移动到位，好让我们进行精准打击；这一炮打出去之后，我们的空投艇就必须脱离轨道逃跑，所以只有一次做对的机会。我们对你有完全的信心，指挥官；到目前为止你的判断都精准无误。祝好运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, long range sensors are picking up an enemy bogey. They'll be landing any minute.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，远程传感器探测到一个敌方目标。他们随时会着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, they are depolying vehicles and tanks from their motorpool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，他们正从车辆调配场调动车辆和坦克.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is it; when we destroy this facility, we'll have shattered Maxiumu defenses on this world, and hopefully eliminated their best Distict Manager.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，就是这样；我们摧毁这处设施后，就能打碎该星球上最大的防御，并有望除掉他们最好的区域经理。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't have any way to know where they will land, but you can bet they will be close to the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我无法知道他们会在哪里着陆，但可以肯定他们会靠近基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what you got.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看你的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No! We were so close. So very close!!!!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不! 我们差一点就成功了. 就差那么一点点!!!!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Danger close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控中心: 目标锁定，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Warming shot. Splash in 30.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这是火控中心: 试射一发，30秒后弹着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once all three beacons are placed, wait for the orbital strike to confirm its effect. Then make for the extraction LZ and the Leopard will pick you up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦三个信标都放置完毕，等待轨道打击，以确认命中. 然后前往撤离点，豹式会来接应你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Test Drive III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 试驾 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌人，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, I guess that makes sense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，我想这说得通.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have decided to use these Mechs' advanced maneuverability to destroy the Local Government's leadership. I hope that this is within your abilities, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已决定利用这些机甲出色的机动性摧毁当地政府的领导层。指挥官，我希望这在你能力范围之内。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装甲击穿

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Assassination Lance Hidden Objective
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁刺杀小队的隐藏目标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Local Government Leadership and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁地方政府领导层并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Leader of the Local Government
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁地方政府首脑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭援军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Supporting Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁支援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent the Target from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止目标逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're receiving a transmission from Duchess.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们收到女公爵的通讯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I see him up there. I bet he thinks he can drive us off planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我看到他在上面了. 我敢打赌他以为自己能把我们赶出星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Local Leader has perished. A Leopard is on standby for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地方首脑已死亡. 一架豹式运输机已待命准备接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, that seems pretty straightforward.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，这看起来相当直接了当.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You performed within specifications of the mission. I will brief you on the Argo
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的表现符合任务要求. 我将在阿尔戈号上向你进行简报.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Test Drive II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 试驾 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Base Defense is usually a long and drawn out afair.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基地防御通常是一场旷日持久的事情.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad you could join us, Commander. The Local Government Leader has decided to try and take one of our bases. I want you to take these mechs and put them through their paces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴你能加入我们，指挥官. 当地政府首脑决定试图夺取我们的一处基地. 我要你驾驶这些机甲，让它们经历实战考验.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Davion Forces Inbound
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩单位逼近

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend ALL Target Buildings from Destruction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护所有目标建筑免遭摧毁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Facility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend the Target Buildings
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标建筑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Local Government Vanguard
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁当地政府先遣队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工程师装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, you managed to get the turrets online. I will note it in the performance review.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，你成功让炮台上线了. 我会在表现评估中记下这一点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I will add this to the Quad mission profile. Expect a new mission shortly when you get back to the Argo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我会将此加入四足机甲任务档案. 等你回到阿尔戈号后，很快就会收到一项新任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Local Government Forces arriving. Try to not disappoint me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当地政府部队正在抵达. 尽量别让我失望.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: See that the base is at least somewhat functional by the time I get there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保在我到那里之前，基地至少能维持基本运转.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are off-line.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设有据点防御系统. 但目前处于离线状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They might not matter to you, but I have friends who work in that facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它们对你可能不重要，但我有朋友在那个设施里工作.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Try and do something right. That last building must survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次可别再搞砸了. 最后那座建筑必须保住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning Commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You have made it to the half-way point. Our men will be there soon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已经撑到了半程. 我们的人很快就到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Test Drive I
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 试驾 I

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This should be extremely painful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该会非常痛苦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have arranged a training mission on this planet. Of course, we did not inform the Local Government we would be using their forces as training dummies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已在这颗星球上安排了一次训练任务. 当然，我们并没有通知当地政府我们将把他们的部队用作训练假人.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第一支巡逻队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Local Government Patrols
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁当地政府巡逻队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Second  Patrol
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第二支巡逻队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clear out these patrols, Commander, while I assemble a briefing on our next targets. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 扫清这些巡逻队，指挥官. 我去准备下一批目标的简报. 祝你好运.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, you're entering the area that the data indicated the lances were patrolling.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你正进入数据所标示的分队巡逻区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Defector
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 叛逃者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Liao is attempting to move Okada to safety. Kill him.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖家族正试图把冈田转移到安全处。杀了他。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This seems relatively straightforward, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's get in there and get it done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来相对直接，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们进去把事办了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your lance will be dropping directly in the path of Yoshito Okada's convoy. Smash it flat—there can be no survivors. When the defector's death has been confirmed, you will receive your reward.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的分队将直接降落在冈田义人的车队路线上。把它彻底砸平——不能有幸存者。叛逃者的死亡得到确认后，你就会收到报酬。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ambush and Destroy Yoshito Okada's Convoy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击并摧毁冈田义人的车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Liao Convoy Guards
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队的廖氏保护者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Liao Reinforcement Units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁廖氏的援军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Liao Convoy Guards
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭廖氏护送队的护卫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent the Convoy from Reaching Safety
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止运输队抵达安全区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A miserable performance, Commander. But fear not, the needs of House Kurita will be satisfied. The Galedon Regulars will succeed where you have failed!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多么可悲的成就，指挥官，但别担心，栗田家的需求会得到满足. 盖尔登常备团不会重蹈你的覆辙！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to my scouts, Yoshito Okada's convoy is already moving through the AO you've touched down in. All you need do is locate and destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据我的侦察兵说，冈田义人的车队已经穿过你降落的行动区域。你只需定位并摧毁它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An adequate showing, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. For mercenaries, your people showed remarkable discipline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 表现得相当不错，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 作为佣兵，你的部队展现出非凡的纪律性.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We shall see. If you do succeed in destroying the convoy, proceed to the extraction point. The Galedon Regulars will then take command of the area to confirm your kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们拭目以待. 如果你真的摧毁了车队，请前往撤离点. 盖尔登常备团将接管该区域以确认战果.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Defector II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 叛逃者 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: \"His honor,\" my ass. Let's just get this done, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "他的荣誉"，去他的。把这事办完吧，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've chosen to complete your contract, to satisfy your obligation to House Kurita. Good. On my honor, you will receive your pay when Okada is dead—and not a moment before.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你选择了完成合约，履行你对栗田家族的义务。很好。以我的荣誉起誓，冈田死后你才会拿到报酬——一秒钟都不会早。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent the Convoy from Arriving at Its Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止车队到达目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recon the Convoy's Route
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察车队路线

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A miserable performance, Commander. But fear not, the needs of House Kurita will be satisfied. The Galedon Regulars will succeed where you have failed!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多么可悲的成就，指挥官，但别担心，栗田家的需求会得到满足. 盖尔登常备团不会重蹈你的覆辙！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And I will be monitoring you to make sure that the job is done correctly this time. If your company gets in over its head, my lance is poised to relieve you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次我会监督你们，以确保任务正确执行. 如果你们公司搞砸了，我的机甲小队也能随时准备接手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Commander. We're here to take on yet another convoy—the correct convoy this time. I'd stake my reputation on it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官。我们来这里对付又一支车队——这次是正确的那支。我拿我的名声打赌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So be it, mercenary. Now get to work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如你所愿，雇佣兵. 现在开始工作.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There will be no need, Mr. Oliveira. Join me in a secure channel and we will discuss your payment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没有必要，奥利维拉先生. 请接入安全频道商议付款事宜.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Defector II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 叛逃者 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: He sounded awfully sure of himself. Let's wipe the smile off of that smug son of a bitch's face.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他听起来自信得过分。让我们把那个得意混蛋脸上的笑抹掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You dare take up arms against the Galedon Regulars?! Your hubris will destroy you, mercenary dog—and I will personally put your broken corpse into the ground!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你竟敢对加勒登正规军举兵？！你的狂妄会毁了你，雇佣兵野狗——而我会亲手把你那具破碎的尸体埋进土里！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 击败盖尔登常备团的增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 防御栗田的反击

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定前哨基地周边区域

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察进阶基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, be advised: it looks like the Galdeon Regulars have brought point-defense turrets online at the facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你应该知道，Galedon 正规军在设施周围激活了炮台.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Save your excuses and remove yourselves from my sight. My people and I still have a defector to kill, and we can waste no more time on you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收起你的借口，从我眼前消失. 我和我的人民要去处理一个叛徒，没时间在你身上浪费.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sumire was able to trace Chu-i Gaku Hironaka's transmissions to a structure just ahead of you, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苏米蕾成功追踪到了中尉学·广中的通讯，指向你前方的一处建筑，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You miserable fools! House Kurita will have your heads for this!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你们这些蠢货！栗田家会砍掉你的脑袋！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Place Targeting Beacons to mark the Steiner installation for an Artillery Strike
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放置瞄准信标，为炮击标定施泰纳设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As we discussed, this will be a joint operation. As long as Gwydion Company doesn't drop the ball, I'm confident that we can handle our end of the job.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 正如我们讨论过的，这将是一次联合行动。只要格威迪恩连不掉链子，我有信心我们能干好自己这摊事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Steiner has constructed a military stronghold within our territorial boundaries. We have artillery in place to destroy it, but we need you to place targeting beacons in key locations before we can pull the trigger. While you work, a mercenary lance from Gwydion Company will keep any Steiner reinforcements off your backs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 施泰纳家族在我们的领土内建立了一个军事要塞. 我们已部署炮兵准备将其摧毁，但在开火前，需要你们在关键位置布设信标. 在你们执行任务期间，格威迪恩公司的一支雇佣兵机甲小队将负责阻挡施泰纳的任何增援部队，确保你们无后顾之忧.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 施泰纳增援部队正在逼近

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beautifully done, Commander. That hideous barnacle of a fortress has been cracked in two, and House Steiner has lost its foothold in Marik space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 这座可憎的堡垒已成为历史，施泰纳家族在马里克领土的立足点已不复存在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Bravo 已部署，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie beacon deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Charlie 已部署。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 停火！停火！友军尚未离开弹着区。哦——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Close in on those artillery spotters, damn it! Crush them before their Long Toms can get a lock on us!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁炮兵观察员，该死的！在他们的长汤姆斯抓住我们之前摧毁他们，！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, your window of opportunity for this strike is closing! Move quickly and place the beacons before the Lyrans turn their own artillery on us!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次军事行动的时间窗口正在迅速关闭！在天琴人将他们自己的大炮对准我们之前，立即将信标安装到位！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control, this is Observer Actual: Confirmed. Shot, out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员. 目标确认. 开火，完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, no problem. Gwydion Company will work with you anytime.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，没问题. 格威迪恩公司期待下次合作.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: NOT USED IN THIS FLASHPOINT
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未在此闪点中使用

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: NOT USED IN THIS FLASHPOINT.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本闪点中未使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Shot Over. Splash in 30.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控中心: 发射完毕. 30秒后弹着

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual, this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Firing for Effect. HE 30 rounds. Danger Close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这是火控中心: 实施火力压制——发射高爆30发，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our pleasure, Force Commander Singh. Thanks for the assist, Commander Carnby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 乐意效劳，辛格指挥官. 感谢协助，卡恩比指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thank you, Commander Carnby. We appreciate the assist.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谢谢你，卡恩比指挥官. 我们很感谢此次协助.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a target acquisition run, Commander—we're going to mark House Steiner's unauthorized military base for destruction, and Marik artillery will handle the rest.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一次目标获取行动，指挥官——我们要把施泰纳家族的非法军事基地标定为摧毁目标，剩下的由马里克炮兵处理。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What about Gwydion Company?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 格威迪恩公司呢?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unwelcome Guests II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不速之客 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You know the drill, Commander. Get in there, take down the strike team, and rescue Gwydion Company. I'll call out targets for you as I see 'em.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你懂流程，指挥官。进去，干掉打击队，救出格威迪恩连。我看到目标就给你报点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carronade sends her thanks for the assist, Commander—we're doing Gwydion Company a solid that a lot of other mercenary commands wouldn't. Our friends have taken shelter in a subterranean bunker, and a Steiner strike team has them penned in. Carronade needs us to engage and destroy the Lyrans so that she and her people can escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短炮向你的协助致谢，指挥官——我们在帮格威迪恩连，这是许多其他雇佣兵部队不会做的事。我们的朋友躲进了一处地下掩体，一支施泰纳打击队把他们围住了。短炮需要我们交战并消灭这些莱兰人，好让她和她的人逃脱。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁施泰纳突击小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thank the gods, the cavalry is here at last. Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, you are a lifesaver, and I do mean that literally.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谢天谢地，援军终于来了. 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，你真是我们的救星——字面意思！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This should be a milk run, {COMMANDER.FirstName}… Graf Stieglitz-Bradford doesn't actually care about taking down this facility; he just wants us out of the way while his strike team takes down Gwydion Company.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该是一趟轻松差事，{COMMANDER.FirstName}……施蒂格利茨-布拉德福德伯爵其实并不在乎拿下这处设施；他只是想把我们支开，好让他的打击队干掉格威迪恩连。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm so pleased that you've chosen to work with us, Commander. You destroyed one of our facilities at the behest of House Marik; it seems only fair that you do the same for us. Turnabout is fair play, after all. The facility will be minimally guarded, and your pay will be extremely generous.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴你选择与我们合作，指挥官。你曾应马里克家族的要求摧毁了我们的一处设施；那么你为我们做同样的事，看起来才公平。毕竟，来而不往非礼也。那座设施只有最低限度的守卫，而你的报酬将极其丰厚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lovely world, this Pilpala. It seems a shame to bring war to such a beautiful place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Pilpala真的是一个美妙的世界. 在这样的地方开战真是太可惜了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: But House Marik has wronged us, and you were its triggerman. Not that I blame you, of course! We both know how enticing a paycheck can be.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 但是马里克家族袭击了我们，而你正是他们的执行者. 当然，我并不是在责怪你！我们都知道一张薪水单能有多诱人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Go on, Commander. Proceed to the armory and burn it to cinders. You will be well rewarded for your help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 继续，指挥官. 前往军械库，把它烧成灰烬. 你的帮助将会得到丰厚的回报.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Very good, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Exceptional work indeed. Honor is satisfied, an injustice has been repaid, and all is right with the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 非常好，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 真是杰出的工作. 荣誉得到了满足，不公得到了报应，世上的一切各安其位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When you reach orbit, you will find your payment overflowing your accounts. Enjoy it in good health, with the knowledge that I hold you in high esteem. Good day to you, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当你到达轨道的时候，你会发现你的账户装满了报酬. 带着健康的身心，还有我对你的尊敬享用它吧. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sounds like someone has a case of the Mondays.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听起来有人得了周一综合症。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The punishment for Mutiny, is called Walking the Plank. In this case I don't have a plank long enough to make them walk. So we're going to punish the Mutineers. And track down that bitch Sybil
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 叛变的惩罚叫做"走跳板"。这次我没有够长的跳板让他们走。所以我们要惩罚这些叛变者。并追查出那个贱人西比尔

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Found another group of Traitors. Let's see if they know anything about where I can find Sybil.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又发现一群叛徒。看看他们知不知道我在哪儿能找到西比尔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You'll find the Pirates Forward Base at the coordinates I've outlined, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Make sure to crush them... to make an example of course.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点并护送车队至安全地带

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把食物与医疗物资送到，是非常人道主义的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，我想这次是无偿劳动了，指挥官。当地政府被海盗占领军打得够呛。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If they destroy the cargo we are truly doomed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要是他们毁掉这批货，我们就真完了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thank you for helping, Commander. I've gotta admit, when I first reached out to you, I didn't have much hope that you'd respond.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谢谢你的帮助，指挥官。我得承认，我第一次联系你时，并没抱多大希望你会回应。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second Evac Zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队安全离开了行动区域. 干得漂亮，指挥官. 现在带你剩下的部队前往第二撤离区撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there and keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近当地政府设施，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Abandoned Factory
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 废弃工厂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somehow I doubt there's a lost 'Mech factory on this backwater world. It probably manufactures low-g bicycles or something else as useless.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有点怀疑这颗穷乡僻壤上会有什么失落的机甲工厂。它大概生产低重力自行车或者别的同样没用的东西。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol detected unexpected signals here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and we'd like you to investigate. Analysis suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an abandoned factory on the planet's surface. We don't know what this particular facility was used for, but given the effort they're sinking into this, it must be valuable. We want it.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}探测到意外信号，我们希望你去调查。分析显示{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}重新启用了星球地表一座废弃工厂。我们不知道这处设施具体做什么，但看他们投入的力气，它一定很有价值。我们要它。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip inbound for landing! We're going to get in and out quick!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投舰正在降落！我们要速进速出！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is ours, Commander. Well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座基地是我们的了，指挥官. 做得不错.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The facility looks unoccupied save for some automated turrets, Commander. If we can bust those defenses and get inside the perimeter, our employer can send in their salvage crews to take control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这座设施看来还没有被占领，除了一些自动炮台. 如果我们打破那些防御力量并进入周界，我们的雇主就可以派遣他们的回收人员接管控制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Turrets. Remember they can spot you from a very long way off, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炮台. 请记住它们能在很远的距离上发现你，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're here to capture the abandoned factory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们来夺取这座废弃工厂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bargaining Chip
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谈判筹码

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a general objective to indicate the player must keep playing and eliminate enemies as they come.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一个通用目标，表示玩家必须继续作战并消灭陆续出现的敌人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not sure the outcome will be what they want, but I don't specialize in interstellar politics. It sounds like a declaration of war to me so be prepared for more than a little resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不确定结果是否会如他们所愿，但星际政治并非我的专长。在我看来，这听起来就像一份宣战书，所以请做好准备，抵抗恐怕不会小。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Trade negotiations between {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have broken down. We believe that if we capture and hold a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system, we will be able to force them back to the negotiating table. Your job is to take the base and hold it until our forces can occupy it.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}之间的贸易谈判破裂。我们相信，如果我们夺取并守住{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系中一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地，就能迫使对方回到谈判桌。你的任务是拿下该基地并守住它，直到我们的部队能够占领。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're getting intel about the base's location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们收到了关于基地位置的情报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip arriving! Prepare to head out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投艇来了! 准备出发.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defenders and secure the base, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭所有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}守军然后拿下基地，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is ours, Commander. Well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座基地是我们的了，指挥官. 做得不错.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch for additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} forces on the ground, and expect contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意地面上可能出现的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}增援部队，准备迎战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Data Piracy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数据海盗

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This shouldn't be too difficult, but we'll need Dr. Murad on the ground to do the actual data hacking. She's already agreed to go in with your team.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该不算太难，但我们需要穆拉德医生亲自到场做数据入侵。她已经同意跟你的队伍一起进去。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been monitoring communications traffic on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and discerned a pattern. There's a well-defended {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we suspect of being a secure data storage facility. We'd like your team to land, capture the base, and take a complete image of the contents of their databases. Once the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces realize what we're doing, they'll launch a counteroffensive, so we'll need you to stay in the field until the download is complete.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们一直在监视{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的通讯流量，并辨认出一种规律。那里有一处防御严密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，我们怀疑它是安全数据存储设施。我们希望你的团队降落、夺取该基地，并完整拍摄其数据库内容。一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队意识到我们在做什么，他们就会发起反攻，因此我们需要你留在战场直到下载完成。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, once you reach the base I'll be able to start extracting the data. It shouldn't take very long; I can't imagine their data security is very sophisticated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，等你抵达基地，我就能开始提取数据了。应该不会花太久；我无法想象他们的数据安全措施有多精密。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip inbound for landing! We're going to get in and out quick!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投舰正在降落！我们要速进速出！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We should get eyes on that base before we charge in shooting. This should be a good vantage point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在我们冲进去射击之前，应该先看看那座基地. 这里应该是最佳视点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aborted Colony
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夭折的殖民地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point and Escort Convoy to Safety
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点并护送车队至安全地带

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My guess is that there was a credible threat made on the colony, and that's why they're pulling out. Expect fighting, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我猜是殖民地受到了可信的威胁，所以他们才撤离。准备战斗，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个星系是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}扩张计划的目标之一。不幸的是，殖民计划落空了，我们现在必须在殖民者被敌对势力拦截之前，把他们从行星表面撤出来。由于对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}存在互相矛盾且可疑的主权声索，而该殖民地本是秘密，我们不能公开进行一次大规模救援行动。我们需要一个可否认的中间人。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队前往撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送车队至安全地带并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect Convoy as they Embark on the Dropship
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect Convoy while Dropship Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在空投舰抵达期间保护车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The colonists have assembled into a convoy of vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 殖民者已经集合到一支车队里了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The survivors of the failed colony are safely away, Commander. Good job.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些沦陷殖民地的幸存者已经安全离开了，指挥官. 干得好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a disaster. We need to review the mission logs and see what went wrong.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这真是一场灾难. 我们需要回顾任务日志看看哪里出错了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there and keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try and stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rumor has it that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} have been smuggling restricted munitions in amongst their medical supplies. On the surface, at least, we're being tasked with a humanitarian escort mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有传言称{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}一直在把受限弹药混在医疗物资中走私。至少表面上，我们的任务被说成是一次人道主义护送。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 违背战场上一切体面与可接受的行为，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在把目标对准我们的医院与医疗物资。我们正设法把补给重新分配到更安全的地点，但有一支车队还没有适当护卫。这就需要你了。虽然{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会因试图拦截我们所有分开的货运而被摊薄，但你可以预料这一批不会无人注意。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect Convoy while Dropship Arrives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在空投舰抵达期间保护车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander. The medical convoy safely reached extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 医疗车队安全抵达了撤离点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move to their position and provide support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往他们的位置并提供支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pack it in, Commander. Those medical supplies are only so much trash now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 结束吧，指挥官. 那些医疗物资现在只是这些垃圾了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have friendly units under fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一个友方单位正受到攻击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there and keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 营救人质

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 假设人质还活着，我们要让他们保持活着可就难了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一艘{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇坠毁在这块空荡的岩石上，此后不久我们探测到来自地表的求救信号。我们赶到时，船员已被一支装备精良的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获。我们在该星系内没有足够大的军事存在来执行人质营救行动，所以我们在找一家称职的雇佣兵公司来做。我们需要你抵达关押船员的那处设施，摧毁看守他们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，并护送他们到安全地带。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 预计会遭遇激烈抵抗，因为{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已经警觉，准备应对营救行动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我收到设施的无线电通话，指挥官。听起来船员发动了起义。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 船员安全地返回了轨道，指挥官. 做得不错.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要抵达他们的位置，拿下这一地区，这样他们就可以逃走了.
