Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Algea A Varient Quadvee, designed by Clan Hells Horse, is a force to be reckoned with. Equipped with 60 LRM tubes and a trio of ER medium lasers, this 100-ton assault mech is a versatile and deadly addition to any battlefield. With its impressive long-range capabilities and quick maneuverability, the Algea can rain down a barrage of missiles on enemies from afar or close in for devastating laser strikes. Its armor plating is reinforced with the latest materials and its engines are top of the line, ensuring both speed and protection. The Algea is a true feat of engineering and a testament to the ingenuity of its creator. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由地狱马部族设计的 Algea A 变型 QuadVee 是一支不可小觑的力量。这台 100 吨的突击机甲装备了 60 管 LRM 和三门增程中型激光，是任何战场上多才多艺且致命的战力。凭借出色的远程打击能力和灵活的机动性，Algea 可以从远处向敌人倾泻导弹弹幕，也能逼近目标施以致命的激光打击。其装甲板采用最新材料强化，引擎也是顶级配置，兼顾速度与防护。Algea 是真正的工程杰作，也是其设计者智慧的明证。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Equipped with 60 Long Range Missile tubes and a trio of Extended Range medium lasers. At first, I was skeptical about how effective it could be without the Gauss rifles, but I have to say, I'm excited to see it in action. The LRM tubes will give us a serious punch at long range, and the ER medium lasers will provide some added flexibility up close. Let's hope the professor's other modifications are just as promising.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它装60具远程导弹发射管和三门增程中型激光器。起初我怀疑没有磁轨炮它能有多有效，但我得说，我很期待看它实战。LRM发射管会给我们远程带来沉重一击，增程中型激光器则在近距离提供额外的灵活性。希望教授的其他改装也同样有前途。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Variant B of the Algea Quadvee is equipped with 36 SRM tubes and a single ER medium laser. While it sacrifices some of the long-range capabilities of the original Prime variant, it excels in close combat situations with its impressive missile loadout. The single ER medium laser provides additional firepower for mid-range engagements. With its 100-ton weight and sturdy construction, the Algea Variant B is a formidable opponent on any battlefield. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Algea 四足变形车辆的 B 型配备 36 个 SRM 发射管和一具增程中型激光。它牺牲了原始 Prime 型的一部分远程能力，却凭借可观的导弹搭载量在近距离战斗中表现突出。单独一具增程中型激光为中距离交战提供了额外火力。凭借 100 吨的重量和坚固的结构，Algea B 型在任何战场上都是令人生畏的对手。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, you're going to love Variant B of the Algea Quadvee! It's a real brawler, equipped with 36 SRM Tubes and a single ER med laser. With this loadout, it can dish out massive damage at close range and keep the pressure on the enemy. It's perfect for those intense urban combat situations where you need to get up close and personal with the enemy. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你一定会喜欢阿尔盖四足机甲B型的！它是个十足的近战好手，装备36具SRM发射管和一门增程中型激光器。凭借这套配置，它能在近距离输出巨量伤害并持续压制敌人。对于那些需要与敌人贴身肉搏的高强度城市战场合，它是完美的选择。相信我，你不会失望的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Algea Variant C was designed as a highly mobile skirmisher, utilizing its top speed of 64kph to engage enemies at range with its primary weapon, a Rotary Autocannon 5. It also boasts a quad array of ER medium lasers for additional firepower. While lacking in heavier weaponry, its lighter weight and speed make it a formidable opponent in the hands of a skilled pilot. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Algea 的 C 变型被设计为高机动游击机甲，凭借 64kph 的最高速度，以主武器一门旋转自动炮 5 在远距离与敌交战。它还拥有四联装增程中型激光阵列以增强火力。虽然缺乏更重的武器，但它较轻的重量与速度使其在熟练机师手中成为可怕的对手。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have a Variant C of the Algea. It's been modified to replace the Hyper Gauss rifles with a Rotary Autocannon 5 and two tons of ammo. To be honest, I'm not thrilled about this setup, but we could use it as a brawler if we position it right. We'll need to be strategic with our movements and use cover effectively. It's not ideal, but we can make it work if we have to.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们有一台阿尔盖的C型。它经过改装，把超磁轨炮换成一门旋转自动炮5和两吨弹药。老实说，我对这套配置并不兴奋，但如果我们位置摆得好，可以把它当近战者用。我们需要在移动上讲策略，并有效利用掩体。这不是理想方案，但必要时我们能凑合。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Algea's advanced targeting systems and enhanced sensor suite make it a formidable opponent, capable of engaging multiple targets simultaneously with deadly precision. Its armored hull, reinforced by cutting-edge composite materials, offers unparalleled protection against enemy fire, while its sophisticated ECM suite can disrupt enemy communications and sensors, rendering them ineffective against its onslaught. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Algea 先进的瞄准系统和增强型传感器套件使它成为一名令人生畏的对手，能够以致命的精度同时应对多个目标。其装甲外壳由尖端复合材料强化，对敌方火力提供无与伦比的防护；而精密的电子对抗套件则能干扰敌方的通讯与传感器，使其在它的猛攻面前形同虚设。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not sure about this one, Commander. The hyper gauss rifles are impressive, no doubt, but can the chassis handle the recoil? And what about the ammo? Still, I have to admit, I'm excited to see it in action. If it works, we could have a real game-changer on our hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我对这个不太确定，指挥官。超高斯步枪无疑令人印象深刻，但底盘承受得住后坐力吗？弹药呢？不过我得承认，我很期待看它上场。如果它能行，我们手里就有了真正的游戏规则改变者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 1G 功能多样且威力强大，是现存最著名的战斗机甲之一。它通常搭载种类繁多的能量武器，能在任何距离上与敌人交战，并且打击力惊人。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Brawler & Close Assault
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型缠斗者与近距突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 1G 多才多艺而强大，是现存最知名的战斗机甲之一。它通常装备多样化的能量武器阵列，能在任何距离接敌，打击力很强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3141 on the King of the Mountain Arena and piloted by Adrienne Caselotti, this variant of the Calliope packs a pair of Streak SRM-4, supported by a Clan ER PPC augmented by a PPC Capacitor and a Clan Improved Heavy Medium Laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型于3141年在“山之王”竞技场首次亮相，由阿德里安娜·卡塞洛蒂驾驶。卡利俄佩的这款变型装有2具连发SRM-4，并辅以1门加装PPC电容器的部族增程粒子炮和1门部族改进型重型中型激光。 <特性：易于维护 <投放费用倍率：1.02 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3141 on the King of the Mountain Arena and piloted by Adrienne Caselotti, this variant of the Calliope packs a pair of Streak SRM-4, supported by a Clan ER PPC augmented by a PPC Capacitor and a Clan Improved Heavy Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该改型于3141年在山王竞技场首次亮相，由阿德里安娜·卡塞洛蒂驾驶，这台卡利俄佩装有两具连发SRM-4，由一门增程PPC支援——后者配有一座PPC电容器——以及一门氏族改进型重型中型激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，投石机 C1。正如它的名字一样，它擅长隔着地形向远处抛射大量导弹，而无需担心遭到反击。出人意料的是，它在迫不得已时打近战也毫不含糊。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Fire Support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一台坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也擅长打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离上交战，而且越接近目标，其伤害曲线越高。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brawler & General Assault
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 缠斗者与通用突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离交战，其伤害曲线随接近目标而上升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款定制Solaris改型于3128年在Noisiel首次登场，先后由Natalia Porter及其女儿Carolyn Fischer驾驶。这型Clint IIC的升级一反部族改装内层星域机体的潮流。它以部族制造的骨架为起点，拆除了跳跃推进器以更改武器配置。它保留了那两门部族增程中型激光，并把部族LB 10-X AC换成一门大型可变速度脉冲激光与一门中型再工程激光，再将它们全部连接至一具部族瞄准计算机。标准平板装甲则替换为实弹强化装甲。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clint IIC
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特 IIC

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clint IIC
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特 IIC

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款索拉里斯定制变型于3128年在努瓦西尔首次亮相，先后由娜塔莉亚·波特和她的女儿卡罗琳·费雪驾驶。这台克林特IIC升级版逆转了“部族改装内层星域机体”的潮流：它从部族制造的框架出发，拆掉跳跃推进器以更换武器载荷。它保留两门部族增程中型激光，把部族LB 10-X自动炮换成一门大型可变速度脉冲激光和一门中型再工程激光，并把它们全部接入一台部族瞄准计算机。标准板式装甲则换成弹道强化装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom chassis based on the Cougar is apparently an attempt by the Jade Falcons to use experimental technology in a combat unit. Unlike the early prototype designated the Cougar XR, this unit actually is a fully developed Land Air Mech. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一基于美洲狮的定制底盘显然是玉猫部族在战斗单位上使用实验技术的尝试。与早期被编号为美洲狮XR的原型不同，此单位实际上是一台完整开发的地空机甲。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cougar LAM
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮 LAM

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scout & Sniper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察与狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cougar LAM
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮 LAM

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely hybridized brawler built from the husk of a CRB-20. Bogdan ''The Steel Beast'' Tubbs had the Big Steel Claw's chassis rebuilt to support the mounting of ballistic weaponry, presumably in the interest of creating a louder and more violent spectacle in the arena. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款由CRB-20残骸打造出的独特混合式斗士。博格丹·“钢铁野兽”·塔布斯让人重建了大钢爪的底盘，以支撑弹道武器的安装，想必是为了在竞技场中制造更响亮、更暴力的场面。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Direct-Fire Support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 直射火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Check it out, Boss we've landed ourselves a FrankenMech! Looks like a Crab, but on the inside, it's at least a quarter Urbie... that's where the new ballistic mounting hardware came from. I'm honestly amazed that this thing even works, but it does, and it's ours now!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你瞧，老大，我们弄到一台拼装机甲！看着像螃蟹，但里面至少有四分之一是城市仔……新的弹道挂载硬件就是从那儿来的。老实说我很惊讶这东西居然能用，但它确实能用，而且现在是我们的了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙 1N 是一台皮糙肉厚的机器，能承受沉重打击，但武器配置略显单薄。不过作为重型机甲，它移动得很快，因此非常适合逼近较慢的目标发动近战攻击。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Skirmisher & Brawler
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 散兵与缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 1N 是一台结实的机器，能承受重击，但武器略显单薄。不过它作为重型机甲移动很快，这使它非常适合逼近较慢的目标进行近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets, a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮和大型激光的强大威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来，是致命的组合。这些机甲能从中远距离一路打到贴身距离，在战斗中灵活多变、出人意料。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Support & Skirmisher
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火力支援与散兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets, a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮与巨型激光的沉重威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来，是致命的组合。它能在中远距离一直到抵近射击的交战，这些机甲在战斗中灵活而令人意外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry, even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者 3F 搭载的武器多到离谱，即便对突击机甲来说也是如此。它还以极其糟糕的散热管理著称，这正是如此惊人输出能力的代价。强大，但要善加使用。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Juggernaut & Ranged Assault
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主宰者与远程突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry, even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者 3F 装备的武器数量即便对突击机甲而言也荒唐得多。它还以极其糟糕的散热管理著称，这是它为如此惊人的伤害输出付出的代价。强大，但需明智使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机于 3144 年在田纳西河谷竞技场首次亮相，由玛丽·科斯塔驾驶。这台机器上最引人注目的技术是虚空信号系统，其次是取代了原有卡佩兰式星盾隐形装甲的部族规格铁纤维装甲，以及十一台双散热器。武器方面，原本的双联 MML-3 变成了一具 MML-9 发射器，同时该机甲舍弃轻型粒子炮，换用更多增程中型激光（现为三门）。鱼鹰主动探测器被取消，改为一具改进型纳克导弹信标。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scout & Headhunter
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察与猎头

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该改型于3144年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由玛丽·科斯塔驾驶，这台机器最引人注目的技术是虚空信号系统，其次是取代其原卡佩兰式星盾隐形装甲的氏族规格铁纤装甲，以及它的十一具双重散热器。武器部分，原本的双MML-3换成了一具MML-9发射器，同时该机甲放弃轻型PPC，改用更多增程中型激光器（现为三门）。它不再有比格犬主动探测器，改为带一具改进型Narc导弹信标

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 1N 利用跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全的位置向对手倾泻火力。不过，如果它们整场都在战场上跳跃着打冷枪，就会过热。 特性：战斗拳套 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sniper & Fire Support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狙击手与火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 1N 利用跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全处向对手投掷火力。不过，如果它们整场都在战场上蹦跳打冷枪，也可能过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Griffin was introduced to the Taurian Concordat. It carries a Plasma Cannon and three ER medium lasers. It also has a higher top speed than its inspiration and can jump farther as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台狮鹫是为金牛座协约国推出的。它装备一门等离子炮和三门增程中型激光，最高速度也比其灵感来源更快，跳跃距离也更远。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Striker & Skirmisher
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击者与散兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Griffin was introduced to the Taurian Concordat. It carries a Plasma Cannon and three ER medium lasers. It also has a higher top speed than its inspiration and can jump farther as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台狮鹫是为金牛座协约国推出的。它装备一门等离子炮和三门增程中型激光，最高速度也比其灵感来源更快，跳跃距离也更远。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Gundam is a testament to cutting-edge technology and raw power. With advanced weapons and mobility systems, this machine is built for domination on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior provides unrivaled protection from enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent for any force that stands in its way. The Gundam is a technological marvel, and the pilots who use it should be ready for a high-powered and efficient machine. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高达是尖端技术与原始力量的证明。凭借先进武器与机动系统，这台机器为统治战场而生。其厚重装甲外壳提供无与伦比的防护，使它成为任何阻挡者的可怕对手。高达是技术奇迹，驾驶它的飞行员应准备好迎接一台高性能、高效率的机器。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Gundam is a technological marvel. Its advanced weapons and mobility systems make it a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior offers unparalleled protection from enemy attacks. I'm impressed with its capabilities and I have no doubt it will perform well in combat. Anyone using it should be prepared for a high-powered, efficient machine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高达是技术奇迹。其先进武器与机动系统使它成为战场上不容小觑的力量，厚重装甲外壳提供无与伦比的防护。它的能力令我印象深刻，我毫不怀疑它会在战斗中表现出色。使用它的人应准备好迎接一台高性能、高效率的机器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The “Cinderella” is a high speed flashbulb. Fast and nimble, this Gunsmith variant—developed for Team Godmother with a little help from FedSuns benefactors—features Clan-spec weapons and a laser antimissile system to maximize its reach, hitting power, and accuracy all at once Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “Cinderella”是一台高速闪光灯。这款 Gunsmith 变型既快速又灵活，由“教母小队”（Team Godmother）在联邦太阳国资助者的一点帮助下开发，配备部族规格武器和一套激光反导弹系统，从而同时最大化其射程、打击力与精度。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Light Striker & Scout
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型打击者与侦察

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The “Cinderella” is a high speed flashbulb. Fast and nimble, this Gunsmith variant—developed for Team Godmother with a little help from FedSuns benefactors—features Clan-spec weapons and a laser antimissile system to maximize its reach, hitting power, and accuracy all at once
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "灰姑娘"是一枚高速闪光弹。这台枪匠改型快速灵活——它是为教母小队研发的，并得到联邦太阳赞助人的一点帮助——采用氏族规格武器和一套激光反导弹系统，一举最大化其射程、打击力与精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This ComStar developed variant is equipped with a pair of Artemis IV-equipped MML-7 launchers with four tons of ammo. It keeps the Gauss Rifle of the standard Highlander and mounts a pair of ER Medium Lasers. CASE II systems protect the Gauss Rifle and missile ammunition from explosions. A C3 Slave unit allows the Highlander to share targeting data. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款由通讯之星开发的改型装备两具带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 MML-7 发射器，配 4 吨弹药。它保留了标准 Highlander 的高斯步枪，并加装两门增程中型激光。CASE II 系统可防止高斯步枪弹药和导弹弹药发生爆炸。C3 从属单元让 Highlander 能够共享瞄准数据。 特性：强化腿部 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Juggernaut & Heavy Cavalry
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主宰者与重型骑兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This ComStar developed variant is equipped with a pair of Artemis IV-equipped MML-7 launchers with four tons of ammo. It keeps the Gauss Rifle of the standard Highlander and mounts a pair of ER Medium Lasers. CASE II systems protect the Gauss Rifle and missile ammunition from explosions. A C3 Slave unit allows the Highlander to share targeting data.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一康星研发的改型装备一对带阿尔忒弥斯IV的MML-7发射器和四吨弹药。它保留标准高地人的磁轨炮，并装有一对增程中型激光器。CASE II系统保护磁轨炮与导弹弹药免于爆炸。一套C3从属系统让高地人能共享瞄准数据。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Anastasia is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The 'Mech is a hulking brute that moves fairly slow yet hits hard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-LGN-Pin“丑继妹阿纳斯塔西娅”（Ugly Stepsister Anastasia）由三台不同战斗机甲的部件拼装而成：一台 3050 年代出产的驼背、一台早期批次的军团士兵（Legionnaire）以及一台部族制造的翼羽（Pinion）。这台机甲是一头笨重迟缓却打击凶狠的巨兽。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Juggernaut & Sniper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主宰者与狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Anastasia is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The 'Mech is a hulking brute that moves fairly slow yet hits hard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-LGN-Pin"丑继姐"阿纳斯塔西娅由三台截然不同的战斗机甲的部件拼装而成：一台3050年代的老式驼背、一台早期批次的军团兵，以及一台氏族制造的翼羽。这台机甲是个庞大的蛮物，移动相当缓慢，但打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Drizella is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The mech has a decent speed and carries enough laser weapons to host a lethal, but short-ranged, rave party. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-LGN-Pin“丑姐妹”德里泽拉由三台不同战斗机甲的部件组装而成：一台3050年代的驼背、一批早期生产的军团兵，以及一台部族制造的翼羽。该机甲速度尚可，携带的激光武器足以开一场致命但射程有限的狂欢派对。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Juggernaut & Sniper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主宰者与狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Drizella is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The mech has a decent speed and carries enough laser weapons to host a lethal, but short-ranged, rave party.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-LGN-Pin"丑继姐"德莉泽拉由三台截然不同的战斗机甲的部件拼装而成：一台3050年代的老式驼背、一台早期批次的军团兵，以及一台氏族制造的翼羽。这台机甲速度不错，携带的激光武器足以举办一场致命但短程的电音派对。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech S model is highly specialized at long-range Autocannon fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 S 型号高度专精于远程自动炮火力支援。不过它没有多少防护，近距离武器也不多，所以要让它保持距离、远离危险。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sniper & Direct-Fire Support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狙击手与直射火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech S model is highly specialized at long-range Autocannon fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 S 型号高度专精于远程自动炮火力支援。它的防护与近程武器都不多，所以让它保持距离、远离危险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 迅捷D发热高、跑得快，但能迅速跃进战斗打出一记击倒重拳，即便面对更重的单位也一样。不过，这种速度与火力上的能力往往以装甲较薄为代价。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast Striker Cavalry
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快速打击骑兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 D 散热偏热、跑得很快，能迅速跃入战斗打出致命一击，即使对更重的单位也是如此。不过它在速度与武器上的本事，往往是以较低装甲容量为代价的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2775 as Aleksander Kerensky's forces were tightening the noose around the Amaris Empire, weapons development became increasingly frantic in hopes of finding a miracle weapon to turn the tides of the war. The most well known of these is the Matar, commonly referred to as Amaris' Folly, an attempt to create a BattleMech able to withstand an entire company. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2775 年，当 Aleksander Kerensky 的部队正逐步收紧对 Amaris 帝国的绞索时，武器研发变得愈发疯狂，人们希望找到一种奇迹武器来扭转战局。其中最有名的便是 Matar——通常被称为“Amaris 的蠢行”——其目标是造出一台能抵挡整整一个连队的战斗机甲。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Superheavy Prototype
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超重型原型

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2775 as Aleksander Kerensky's forces were tightening the noose around the Amaris Empire, weapons development became increasingly frantic in hopes of finding a miracle weapon to turn the tides of the war. The most well known of these is the Matar, commonly referred to as Amaris' Folly, an attempt to create a BattleMech able to withstand an entire company.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2775年，当亚历山大·克伦斯基的部队正收紧对阿马里斯帝国的绞索时，武器研发变得愈发疯狂，只为找到一件能扭转战局的奇迹武器。其中最著名的是玛塔尔，通常被称为“阿马里斯之愚”——一次尝试造出一台能抗衡整个连队的战斗机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Mongoose variant was developed for the SLDF Gunslinger Program, but never saw service. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款Mongoose变型是为SLDF枪手计划研发的，但从未投入使用。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Light Striker & Scout
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型打击者与侦察

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is one fast ghost. Invisible and packing a nasty punch; its a shame the star league never put this one into production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是个快得吓人的幽灵。隐形且带着凶狠的一击；可惜星盟从没把这一款投入生产。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是第一台真正的重型机甲。作为多面手近战机甲，猎户座能在各种距离上迎战敌人，凭借充足的装甲，它能在集火下坚持相当长的时间。速度是慢，但威力强大。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brawler & Close Assault
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 缠斗者与近距突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹 9R 是性能均衡的全能机甲，只是速度稍慢。它凭借跳跃推进器、可观的装甲以及招牌粒子炮的沉重打击弥补了这一缺憾，甚至曾被用于近身肉搏战并取得不错的效果。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sniper & Light Brawler
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狙击手与轻型缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹 9R 是扎实的全能机甲，只是稍偏慢。它靠跳跃推进器、可观的装甲和标志性 PPC 的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于近身肉搏，效果不俗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally built as a new assault class mech by Jade Falcon just three years after Project Eryie the Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM is based on the venerable 50 ton Phoenix Hawk LAM but almost twice as heavy at 90 tons. The Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM features as close as possible speed and agility to the original Phoenix Hawk LAM making it an effective fast interdiction unit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM 最初由翡翠隼在"鹰眼计划"仅三年后作为新型突击级机甲建造，它基于经典的 50 吨凤凰鹰 LAM，但重近一倍，达 90 吨。其速度与灵活度尽可能贴近原版凤凰鹰 LAM，使其成为有效的快速拦截单位。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, not surprising that at some point the Clanners decided to refit one and see what they could get out of it. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该系统于2692年为星际联盟防御军皇家师团研发，因此部族成员后来决定改装一台、看看能从中榨出什么性能，也就不足为奇了。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Phoenix Hawk LAM C
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 LAM C

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Phoenix Hawk LAM
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 LAM

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow, and here I thought that clanners were against such things. Jade Falcon been running some serious secret R&D.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，我还以为氏族反对这类东西。翡翠猎鹰一直在搞一些相当厉害的秘密研发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the C configuration, the F configuration of the Raptor carries five ER Medium Lasers and adds three additional double heat sinks. The Raptor F has added maneuverability with the addition of seven jump jets, allowing it to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 C 配置相似，猛禽 F 配置携带五门 ER 中型激光，并额外加装三台双倍散热器。F 型通过加装七个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳起至二百一十米。 特质：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.93 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proto OmniMech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型全能机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the C configuration, the F configuration of the Raptor carries five ER Medium Lasers and adds three additional double heat sinks. The Raptor F has added maneuverability with the addition of seven jump jets, allowing it to jump up to two hundred and ten meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 C 配置相似，猛禽 F 配置携带五门 ER 中型激光，并加装三台额外双倍散热器。猛禽 F 通过加装七个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至二百一十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thunderbolt SE models lose a little of their firepower in exchange for mounting Jump Jets. The greater mobility is intended to allow for more precision attacking maneuvers, though it all depends on the battlefield terrain. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 SE 各型号牺牲了一点火力，以换装跳跃推进器。更高的机动性旨在实现更精准的攻击机动，不过这一切都取决于战场地形。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Skirmisher
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型散兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thunderbolt SE models lose a little of their firepower in exchange for mounting Jump Jets. The greater mobility is intended to allow for more precision attacking maneuvers, though it all depends on the battlefield terrain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 SE 型号牺牲些许火力以加装跳跃推进器。更高的机动性意在实现更精准的攻击机动，不过这一切都取决于战场地形。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3140 on The Coliseum Arena and piloted by Kaley Macdonald, this Trebuchet upgrade is actually based more on a Clan Invasion-era model than the older medium support raider. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一投石车升级型于3140年在竞技场首次登场，由凯莉·麦克唐纳驾驶，其基础实际上更多来自部族入侵时代的型号，而非那台更古老的中型支援袭击者。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3140 on The Coliseum Arena and piloted by Kaley Macdonald, this Trebuchet upgrade is actually based more on a Clan Invasion-era model than the older medium support raider.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该改型于3140年在斗兽场竞技场首次亮相，由卡莉·麦克唐纳驾驶，这次投石机升级实际上更多基于氏族入侵时代的型号，而非更古老的中型支援袭扰者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Local news sources have started purchasing these retrofitted camera mechs for filming live combat. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当地新闻机构已开始购买这些加装了摄像设备的改装机甲，用于拍摄实况战斗。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.77 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Local news sources have started purchasing these retrofitted camera mechs for filming live combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本地新闻机构已开始采购这些改装过的摄影机甲，用于拍摄实况战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3144 on the Hartford Gardens Arena and piloted by Robert Benson, The Beast is a remote-operated drone controlled from the copilot seat of the Watchman known as Belle and may well be a triumph of modern military technology. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野兽于3144年在哈特福德花园竞技场首次亮相，由罗伯特·本森驾驶。它是一架遥控无人机，从名为“美人”的守夜人副驾驶座上操控，很可能代表了现代军事技术的一项成就。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3144 on the Hartford Gardens Arena and piloted by Robert Benson, The Beast is a remote-operated drone controlled from the copilot seat of the Watchman known as Belle and may well be a triumph of modern military technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凶兽于3144年在哈特福德花园竞技场首次亮相，由罗伯特·本森驾驶，它是一具遥控无人机，从名为"贝尔"的守夜人副驾驶座操控，很可能堪称现代军事技术的杰作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3141 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Ira Kuhn-Bedard, the variant keeps the best features of this hundred-year-old machine and make it even better. With Clan Ferro-Lamellor Armor improving its resistance to nearly all forms of damage and combined with a Clan-spec XL Engine model instead of the original Inner Sphere one to improve endurance. MASC boosting its land speed, and four Clan ER Medium Lasers replacing all the original weaponry. A Hatchet has been fitted to make it more Solaris Games enabled. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型于 3141 年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由伊拉·库恩-贝达德驾驶；它保留了这具百年老机体最优秀的特点，并使其更加出色。部族铁鳞装甲提升了它对几乎所有伤害形式的抵抗力，同时以部族规格的 XL 引擎取代原本的内层星域型号，以增强耐久性。MASC 提升了它的地面速度，四门部族中型增程激光则替换了原有的全部武器。此外还加装了一把战斧，使其更适应 Solaris 竞技赛。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solaris Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索拉里斯机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3141 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Ira Kuhn-Bedard, the variant keeps the best features of this hundred-year-old machine and make it even better. With Clan Ferro-Lamellor Armor improving its resistance to nearly all forms of damage and combined with a Clan-spec XL Engine model instead of the original Inner Sphere one to improve endurance. MASC boosting its land speed, and four Clan ER Medium Lasers replacing all the original weaponry. A Hatchet has been fitted to make it more Solaris Games enabled.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该改型于3141年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由伊拉·库恩-贝达德驾驶，它保留了这台百年老兵的最佳特性并使其更加出色。氏族铁甲装甲提升了它对几乎所有伤害形式的抗性，并以氏族规格的XL引擎型号取代原本的内天体型号以提升续战力。MASC提升了它的地面速度，四门氏族增程中型激光器替换了原有的全部武器。它还装上了一把斧头，使其更适合索拉里斯赛事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵亚历山大由安吉莉克·克劳指导、为兹尔布里根马疚研制，融合了部族与内层星域的实验技术，打造出一台独一无二的机甲。它采用部族制造的XL引擎以保持高速，并腾出空间安装更多装备。跳跃推进器、内骨架结构和短管粒子炮均为内层星域制造，而两具增程中型激光、铁纤维装甲和一对部分翼则出自部族之手。这对部分翼将幽灵的跳跃距离提升至270米。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solaris Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索拉里斯机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在安吉莉克·克劳的指导下为泽尔布林根马疚研发，幽灵亚历山大融合了氏族与内天体的实验科技，造出一台独特的机甲。采用氏族制造的XL引擎保持高速度，并允许安装更多装备。跳跃推进器、内层钢结构和短鼻PPC都是内天体制造，但两门增程中型激光器、铁纤装甲和一对部分翼由氏族建造。部分翼将幽灵的跳跃距离提升到270米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They've got to be kicking themselves for letting their VIP go out without more security. Their screw-up is our payday, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们一定在懊悔让贵宾没有更多护卫就出门。不过他们的失误就是我们的收获。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a VIP at a base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just received a garbled transmission from a local agent that the base will be attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They're striking at the VIP, and they know our forces are not in position to come to his aid. We need a team of competent mercenaries to protect the facility and our personnel.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处基地有一位贵宾，刚收到当地特工发来的混乱讯息，称基地将遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的袭击。他们的目标就是这位贵宾，而且他们知道我军的兵力无法及时赶到救援。我们需要一支能干的雇佣兵小队来保护设施和我们的人员。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} VIP
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}VIP

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As expected, we have multiple incoming {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不出所料，我们遭遇到多个来袭的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need to protect the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base and keep the VIP safe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们需要保护这座{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，确保VIP的安全.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them to the generators and we can boost our firepower and repel the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们可以加强自身火力，击退{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold the base, keep the buildings upright, and eliminate any threats. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住基地，保持建筑物屹立不倒，同时消灭任何威胁. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employers are providing us with extra support, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主正在为我们提供额外的支援，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The engineers are in position and have disembarked from the APCs. The vehicles will scatter and support you; just keep those turrets online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工程师已经就位并从装甲运兵车上下来了. 现在车辆将会散开支援你; 请保持那些炮台在线.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Garrison Duty
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守备任务

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, while there's a lot of fighting in the region, the supply depot is well behind the current front lines. I can't help but be suspicious about their 'no intel' claim.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，虽然该区域战斗频繁，但补给站远在当前前线之后。对他们“没有情报”的说法，我实在无法不起疑心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a centralized supply depot here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, located to support multiple fronts of hostile action. With so many troops elsewhere, we're looking for a lance of Mercs to babysit our outpost. We have no intel that suggests a specific threat, but better to be certain.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一个集中补给站，用来支援多个敌对战线的行动。由于兵力大多调往他处，我们想找一支雇佣兵分队来看守我们的前哨。没有任何情报显示存在特定威胁，但还是稳妥为上。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buckle up, Commander. This is going to get exciting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做好准备，指挥官. 好戏要开场了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maybe this will be a quiet contract for once--
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 也许这次合约能消停一回——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch that, Commander. Orbital imagery is showing multiple incoming hostile contacts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当我没说，指挥官. 轨道影像正显示多批敌方目标正在逼近.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周边布置了近距离防御设施，不过目前处于离线状态。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Professional Ethics
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 职业道德

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Professional
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 专家

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Why would anyone give their target a warning? And what the hell does 'professional ethics' mean? This is bizarre.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 怎么会有人去警告自己的目标？还有"职业操守"到底是什么意思？这太诡异了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, \"professional ethics.\" We have no idea what that means.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一个极其古怪的任务给你。我们在下面那颗行星上有一处制造设施，我们一直知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队在附近侦察。我们预计他们会有所动作，但没料到他们会……事先给我们发警告？显然他们雇了一名雇佣兵，那人联系我们告知攻击将在何时进行，因为——我引用原话——"职业操守"。我们完全不明白那是什么意思。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, my engineers are powering the turrets up now. The APCs will scatter and provide support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，我的工程师正在启动炮台. 装甲运兵车将散开提供支援.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，这里是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}本地司令部. 我们的炮台因破坏而失效了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有一队工程师，他们能手动重启炮台，但只能亲自在炮台控制站做到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，本地指挥部. 指挥官，看来我们这边要有些枪炮了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The manufacturing facility is just up ahead. Meyer, any sign of our polite opposition?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 制造设施就在前面. 梅耶尔，有什么我们彬彬有礼的对手的迹象吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To prove which of us is better: your whole company... or me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来证明我们哪个更好些: 你的整个公司...还是我.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是一场该死的灾难。我们回轨道上做简报吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clever Girl
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聪明的女孩

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raptors are notorious for using coordinated unit tactics, flanking, and misdirection. Be on your guard, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛禽组织以运用协同单位战术、侧翼包抄和声东击西而臭名昭著. 请保持警惕，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raptors are holed up at their Salinization Plant, converting all the raw materials they can get their hands on into salt. Intercepted transmissions from the facility have been somewhat garbled, but they're apparently on the brink of setting up something called a 'salt meme economy', whatever that is. What they're up to doesn't really matter; we're going to go in, demolish their operation, take them out, and collect that bounty.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些猛禽窝在他们的盐碱化工厂里，把能弄到手的原材料全变成盐。从该设施截获的通讯有些含混不清，但他们显然即将建立一种叫"盐梗经济"的东西，管它是什么。他们在搞什么都不重要；我们要进去，捣毁他们的运作，干掉他们，然后领走那笔赏金。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭猛禽增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move in, engage the base defenses, and start the demolition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动，和基地的防御力量交火，然后开始拆毁基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raptor garrison is still on-site, so be ready for opposition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛禽的驻军仍在现场，做好迎敌准备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Salinization Plant is just up ahead, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，盐碱化工厂就在前方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They've got multiple units protecting this facility. Be careful not to get caught in an ambush.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们有多支部队保护这座设施。小心别被伏击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不喜欢这听起来的样子，指挥官。没有卫星覆盖就没有地形情报。我们要在没有地图的情况下进入未知局面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们刚与一处设施失去联系，指挥官，我们需要你的帮助。今天早些时候，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的设施收到了一段他们以为是常规数据的传输。它严重错乱，他们要求重发后却毫无回应。此后不久，基地系统开始故障，然后我们同时失去了与该基地和覆盖该区域的同步卫星的联系。我们希望你去调查那处设施。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 调查设施并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As odd as this sounds... I agree with Mr. Virtanen. Anything that was exposed to that signal needs to be completely destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这听着有点怪...我同意维尔塔宁先生的看法. 任何暴露在那个信号下的东西都需要彻底摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, there's a garbage signal blasting out of that base's transmitters. Want me to put it through?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，那座基地的发射器正往外喷垃圾信号。要我接进来吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, with comms switched off, I have no idea if the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are part of an attack, or additional victims of the signal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，由于通讯关闭的关系，我就不知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队到底是攻击的一部分，还是这个信号的另一个受害者了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I wonder if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} intended this to happen, or if they were themselves infected?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在想{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}是不是有意让这事发生的，还是说他们自己也感染了?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need to pull out and alert our employers about this situation. Containing this signal is their problem, now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要撤出来，再向我们的雇主警告这一局面. 现在，控制这个信号是他们的问题了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Deniable Destruction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可以撇清关系的毁灭

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They're using us so the raid can't be traced to them. Shooting your own people... This is an ugly situation for them to be in, but nobody said the Periphery was a safe place to work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在利用我们，这样袭击就追查不到他们头上。向自己人开枪……对他们来说这处境实在难看，但没人说过外围地区是个能安心干活的地方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在找一家雇佣兵公司为我们做些隐蔽工作。我们失去了一处基地，落到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}手里，并相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员此刻正在受审。我们不能让那些人泄密，但如果被看到是我们自己摧毁了基地，那就难看了。我们需要可否认性。我们需要你把那座基地夷平，尤其是仓储与通讯设施。如果你能确保没有活口，我们将不胜感激；若清除全部抵抗者，我们还会付一笔奖金。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The captured base is just up ahead, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被夺走的基地就在前面，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The forces that captured the base are still on-site, so be ready for opposition.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Depending on what's being produced there, this could be trivial or terrifying. I wish I could be more specific, but our employers don't even know who we're fighting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 取决于那里在生产什么，这可能只是小事，也可能是件可怕的事。我希望自己能说得更具体，但我们的雇主甚至连我们在跟谁打都不知道。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对行星表面的一次例行扫描发现了意外之物：一处废弃设施的位置传出能量信号。从我们读到的数值看，那可能是一座正在通电启动的机甲工厂。我们在战略上无力宣称占有那座工厂，所以需要你找到并摧毁它。若我们行动迅速，就能在任何机甲被造出来之前解决此事。如果你真碰上任何新造出的机甲，当然，也该把它们拆成废铁。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Damn, I hate to see all that hardware turned to scrap. Imagine if we could have gotten a half-dozen of those Orions working.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, folks, I've spotted another DropShip in the area, with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} markings. So now we know who we're fighting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好了各位，我在区域内又发现一艘带 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 标识的空投舰。现在我们知道在跟谁打了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They've got multiple units protecting this facility, careful not to get caught in an ambush.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们有多支部队保护这座设施，小心别被伏击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Darius brings to the briefing an issue that has lingered on the back-burner ever since that ill-fated Contract to eliminate a defector from the Draconis Combine.

\"The Mercenary Review Board has finally reviewed our claim of Non-Payment, and have invited us to a sit down with the House Kurita envoy, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],Shugo Yamaguchi]].\" 

Sumire bristles in her chair. \"Finally! I say we take our pound of flesh, and an extra pound for our troubles!\"

Darius shakes his head. \"I can't believe I'm suggesting walking away from C-Bills, but If we allow Yamaguchi to save face here, we could gain a significant boost in our reputation with Kurita.\"

Dr. Murad clears her throat and pauses, holding the room's attention. \"Remember how the Shugo delegated the contract to his [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],underling]], so he could rush off to Herotitus? The notorious pleasure planet?\" She pauses again before adding,  \"Do you think we could get some leverage from that?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
达里乌斯在简报会上提出一个自那次不幸的清除龙尼斯联合体叛逃者合约以来一直搁置的问题。

"雇佣兵审查委员会终于审理了我们关于未付款的申诉，并邀请我们与栗田家族特使[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],山口修护]]坐下来谈谈。"

苏米蕾在椅子上浑身一紧。"终于！我说咱们得拿走应得的血肉，再额外多拿一磅辛苦费！"

达里乌斯摇摇头。"我简直不敢相信我会建议放弃C币，但如果我们让山口在这儿保住面子，我们与栗田的声望可能会有显著提升。"

穆拉德博士清了清嗓子，顿了顿，把全场的注意力都抓住了。"还记得吗，那位修护把合约委派给了他的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],下属]]，好让自己赶去赫罗提图斯？那颗臭名昭著的享乐星球？"她又停了一下，然后补上一句："你们觉得我们能拿这件事做点文章吗？"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackmail Yamaguchi to force a settlement before arbitration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勒索山口，迫使他在仲裁前达成和解.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Concede the case to curry favor with Kurita.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你放弃这件事，以获得栗田家的青睐.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let the evidence speak for itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让证据不言自明.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
You and Darius have finished networking for new contracts on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and find yourself in the tiniest dive bar in the port, along with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who is on shore leave.

Darius groans as a musician mounts the stage and begins to tune his guitar. {TGT_MW.Callsign} laughs. \"Come on, give the guy a chance.\"

And so he begins...

	\"{COMMANDER.Callsign}!
	The MechWarrior called... {COMMANDER.Callsign}!\"

Darius and {TGT_MW.Callsign} exchange jaw-dropped looks. The musician continues, while the rest of the bar sings along.

	\"The Steiners attacked, and we hid underground.
	We couldn't escape, we soon would be found.
	Our love for {COMMANDER.OBJ} ain't hard to explain.
	The Hero of the Valley,
	{COMMANDER.Callsign} is {COMMANDER.DET} name!\"

There are four more verses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
你和达里乌斯在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上为新合约拓展完关系网，发现自己待在港口最狭小的一家潜水酒吧里，同行的还有休岸假的[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

一名乐手登上舞台开始给吉他调音时，达里乌斯呻吟了一声。{TGT_MW.Callsign}笑了。"得了吧，给这家伙一个机会。"

于是他开始了……

　"{COMMANDER.Callsign}！
　那位被称作……{COMMANDER.Callsign}的机师！"

达里乌斯和{TGT_MW.Callsign}交换了一个目瞪口呆的眼神。乐手继续唱，酒吧里其余的人跟着合唱。

　"施泰纳人打来了，我们躲进地下。
　我们逃不出去，很快就会被找到。
　我们对{COMMANDER.OBJ}的爱并不难解释。
　山谷的英雄，
　{COMMANDER.Callsign}就是{COMMANDER.DET}的名字！"

后面还有四段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
You and Darius have finished networking for new contracts on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and are walking through a farmer's market with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who is on shore leave.

A street preacher suddenly appears at your elbow. \"Have you heard the good word of the Volkovites?\" He presses a pamphlet into your hands. As he does so, you can't help but notice the watchful gaze of a patrol of soldiers wearing the livery of Liao.

The preacher studies the insignia on your gear. \"You! You were there when the Capellan storm troopers descended on the great pilgrims. You are the saviours of the Prophet!\"

传教士端详你装备上的徽记。"你！卡佩兰风暴兵扑向伟大朝圣者的时候，你就在场。你们是先知的救主！"

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你和达里乌斯在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上完成了新合同的联络，随后发现自己坐在一家酒吧里，与正在休假的[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]在一起。 四面墙上满是播放索拉里斯VII比赛的全息屏幕。酒过几巡，话题转向与钢铁野兽的那场戏剧性战斗。{TGT_MW.Callsign}的声音在好几处都格外响亮。 沉重的脚步声逼近，几个喝得特别醉的人居高临下地站在你面前。“嘿，你就是那家干掉钢铁野兽的雇佣兵公司吧？”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A comm's buzz wakes you. Darius has a message from the planet's surface. \"You're not going to believe this, Commander. It's Ayasha Hadley.\" \"Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! I feel awful about how we left things, but no hard feelings, right? I really didn't want to go to jail.\" Seeing your stony response, she continues. \"I like you, Commander. You must know that. So I just had to bring you this opportunity that could benefit us both.\" She continues as if you'd agreed. \"You have a MechWarrior in your employ, goes by the callsign [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They're} the spitting image of a certain Davion official who has access to a Mydron research facility I'd very much like to see the inside of.\" \"Let me borrow {TGT_MW.OBJ} for a few weeks. If you play along, I'll give you one of whatever I find in there. What do you say? Partners?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通讯器的蜂鸣声把你吵醒。达里乌斯从行星地表发来一条消息。“你不会相信的，指挥官。是阿雅莎·哈德利。” “{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官！我们上次那样分手我很难过，但别记恨我，好吗？我真的不想进监狱。” 见你面无表情，她继续说：“我喜欢你，指挥官。你一定知道。所以我非得把这个能让我们俩都受益的机会带给你。” 她自顾自地说下去，仿佛你已经同意。“你手下有一名机甲战士，呼号[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:他|Female:她|NonBinary:Ta}长得和某位戴维恩官员一模一样，而那个人能进入一处迈德隆研究设施——我非常想看看那里面。” “把{TGT_MW.OBJ}借我几周。你配合的话，我在里面找到的东西分你一份。怎么样？合作？”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Raised voices echo down the barracks hallway and you arrive to find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] facing off with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. \"That's just not how it's done! We're mercenaries. We go where the money is.\" {SCN_MW.Callsign} sneers. \"Why the hell did we face that Steiner strike team for zero C-Bills?!? We didn't owe anything to Gwydion Company.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} suddenly erupts. \"My cousin is in the Gwydion Company. He's alive because of the Commander, and a better MechWarrior than you'll ever be!\" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stalk|Default:stalks} from the barracks. In the silence that follows, the room finally notices that you've arrived.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This sounds like a messy scenario, Commander. That satellite is only going to be overhead for a short time.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an operative in place in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility, and for the past year they've been gathering sensitive research data for us. They've notified us that they're ready for us to extract the data, and we need a deniable force to arrange that extraction. The research facility is not connected to any data networks, and all the secure laboratories are far enough underground that wireless data signals are blocked. To get the information out, we're going to need to position a satellite receiver directly above the site. Your task will be to place positioning beacons to allow the satellite to lock on to the research data signal and download it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的一处研究设施内安插了一名特工，过去一年里他们一直为我们收集敏感研究数据。他们已通知我们，准备好让我们取走数据，而我们需要一支可矢口否认的力量来安排这次提取。该研究设施不与任何数据网络相连，且所有安全实验室都深埋地下，无线数据信号被阻断。为把情报送出来，我们需要在该地点正上方部署一颗卫星接收器。你的任务是放置定位信标，让卫星锁定研究数据信号并下载它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'll try to keep this brief, because there's a lot happening on this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我尽量简短，因为这次事情很多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch yourself, Commander. I saw a hell of a lot of opposition on the way in.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，指挥官. 我看到下面有很多敌方单位.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你需要进入三个标记地点的位置. 这里...

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, there is nothing glamorous about sighting targets for big guns, but the fireworks can be exciting. Just make sure you're clear of the blast radius before those shells land.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，为大口径火炮观测目标不是什么光鲜的活，但那场面确实够刺激。只要确保炮弹落地之前你已经离开爆炸半径就行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base in this region. We have the equipment to level it, however our recon capability has been diminished. We would like you to take a team and attack the installation. Place beacons for our artillery to target, and exfiltrate while our guns destroy the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该区域有一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的基地. 我们有夷平它的装备，但侦察能力已受损. 我们希望你们派一支小队攻击该设施，为我们的火炮放置目标指示信标，然后在我方炮火摧毁基地时撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All units, close distance on enemy forces. Send a short wave burst near them to disrupt enemy Artillery from locking on! Move quickly!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有单位注意，缩短与敌军的距离. 在他们附近发起一次短促突击，扰乱敌方大炮的锁定! 快点!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha beacon deployed, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信标 Alpha 已部署，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Artillery does not discriminate about what it destroys. Be sure to clear the area once the firing starts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炮击可不长眼睛. 开火后务必确保撤离出该区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bravo beacon deployed, Commander.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on station. Thanks for clearing those defenses to make way for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队已就位。感谢你清除了那些防御设施为我们开路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, long range sensors are picking up an enemy bogey. They'll be landing any minute.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，远程传感器探测到一个敌方目标。他们随时会着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy units can disrupt the targeting of the beacons. They will deploy forces with the intent to disrupt our beacons. Do not let enemies get near them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方单位能中断信标的指示. 他们会派遣部队试图破坏我们的信标. 不要让敌人接近信标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Confirmed. Shot, out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控，这里是观察员: 确认——射击完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am putting a stop to this, no way we pull this out of the fire. Abort Mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正在叫停这个任务，我们没办法解决这个麻烦了. 放弃任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't have any way to know where they will land, but you can bet they will be close to the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我无法知道他们会在哪里着陆，但可以肯定他们会靠近基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the pressure on to prevent them a chance to place those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 继续压制，别给他们安放那些信标的机会!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what you got.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看你的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Shot Over. Splash in 30
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，请注意，这里是火控: 发射完毕. 30秒后弹着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Firing for Effect. HE 5 rounds. Danger Close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控: 目标锁定，实施火力压制——发射高爆5发，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the Fire Mission is complete, get out of there, extract at our established LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火力任务完成后，立刻撤离该区域，前往我们预设的着陆区进行撤退.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are tasked with marking an area for artillery strike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的任务是标定一块区域进行炮击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You need to place beacons to designate the attack position. This will take some time to do, so keep the unit placing the beacon nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你需要放置信标指示攻击位置. 这需要一些时间，所以让安放信标的单位留在附近.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The time-frame on this is tight, since we need the artillery strike to hit while the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} representative has everyone looking in the right direction. And Commander, I wouldn't take any bets on that military base actually being abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这件事的时间窗口很紧，因为我们需要在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}代表把所有人的注意力引向正确方向时让炮击命中。指挥官，至于那座军事基地是否真的被废弃，我可不打算打赌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are engaged in delicate negotiations with a private manufacturer from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} space, but we have reached an impasse. Our representative has requested a demonstration. \"Something dramatic,\" she said. So we turn to you. Your team will provide on-site assistance to target an abandoned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base near the trade conference. We'll have a WarShip standing by to light it up… dramatically.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正与一个来自{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}空间的私营制造商进行微妙谈判，但已陷入僵局。我们的代表要求做一次演示。"要有点戏剧性，"她说。所以我们求助于你。你的团队将提供现场协助，为贸易会议附近一处废弃的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地标定目标。我们会有一艘战舰待命，把它照亮——很有戏剧性地照亮。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, they are deploying vehicles and tanks from their motorpool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你使用武器库中的车辆和坦克.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Confirmed. Shot, out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控，这里是观察员: 确认——射击完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你好，指挥官。请理解，这座设施对 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} 的重要性，不亚于对我们的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am putting a stop to this, no way we pull this out of the fire. Abort Mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正在叫停这个任务，我们没办法解决这个麻烦了. 放弃任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't have any way to know where they will land, but you can bet they will be close to the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我无法知道他们会在哪里着陆，但可以肯定他们会靠近基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the pressure on to prevent them a chance to place those beacons!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 继续压制，别给他们安放那些信标的机会!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what you got.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看你的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Shot Over. Splash in 30.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这里是火控: 发射完毕，30秒后弹着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Firing for Effect. HE 30 rounds. Danger Close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观察员，这是火控中心: 目标锁定，实施火力压制——发射高爆30发，危险临近！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The client wants to put on a show. We're here to mark the target so that can happen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 客户想搞一场表演。我们来这里是为目标做标记，好让表演得以进行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Three points make a triangle around the target base. Set up beacons at those points and we can go home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要对目标基地进行三角测量，这就是为什么你需要将信标放置在基地周围的三个点上. 然后我们就可以离开这里了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning: Incoming artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告：炮击来袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在此等待自己的增援。去你的撤离点快走！我们掩护你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, one of our senior operatives has defected to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They know far too much about our operations to be allowed to share their knowledge with their new friends. It seems the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} handlers have realized how valuable the knowledge our operative possesses is, because they're being held in an extremely secure facility, deep underground. Such extreme defensive measures probably makes them feel as though they're untouchable. We have a military DropShip with a naval PPC on station to demonstrate to them just how touchable they are. We need you to help us precisely target the PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们一名高级特工叛逃到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}。他们对我们行动的知情太多，不能容许他们把所知分享给新朋友。看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的接头人已经意识到我们特工掌握的情报有多宝贵，因为他们被关押在一处极其安全、深埋地下的设施里。这种极端的防御措施大概让他们觉得自己不可触及。我们在轨道上有一艘装备舰载PPC的军用空投艇，可以演示给他们看他们有多可触及。我们需要你帮我们精准瞄准那门PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ok, Commander, the clock is ticking on this one, so let's cover the basics quickly. Right now there's a military DropShip inbound to this location. It's going to have only a few moments to make a flyby and take the shot.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow. Did you see that? Hell yes!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I just received a message from Professor Pillow. He's eager to show us something he's been working on and wants us to visit his lab. It might be worth our time to see what he's been up to. THIS FLASHPOINT REQUIRES 4 PILOTS THAT ARE ABLE TO PILOT MECHS AND VEHICLES.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我刚收到枕头教授的消息。他急着向我们展示他一直在做的东西，想请我们去他的实验室。去看看他在搞什么也许值得。 本闪点需要4名既能驾驶机甲又能驾驶车辆的飞行员。
