Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被自己的组织背叛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I require your help on a personal matter, Commander. No other mercenary company will do. If you accept, further details will be provided upon your arrival at Brockway.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我需要你帮忙处理一件私人事务，指挥官. 我需要你的雇佣兵部队. 如果你接受，详情将在你抵达布罗克维后提供.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Extracurricular Activities
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 附带活动

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have received a secret communication from Jade Falcon. They want us to test one of their new projects.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到了来自玉鹰的秘密通讯. 他们想让我们测试他们的一个新项目.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Alliance with Clan JadeFalcon has proven lucrative. They would like our help with a SECRET project. THIS FLASHPOINT REQUIRES 4 LAM PILOTS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们与翡翠猎鹰的同盟已被证明利润丰厚。他们想请我们协助一个秘密项目。 本闪点需要4名LAM飞行员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Eyrie
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鹰巢

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Betrayed by their own organization
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被自己的组织背叛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A seditionist group has taken root in the Capellan system of Cavalor. House Liao will handsomely reward any company that will root out and destroy these traitors to the Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个煽动叛乱的组织已在卡佩拉的卡瓦罗尔上扎根. 任何能铲除并消灭这些共同体叛徒的佣兵公司都将获得廖氏家族的丰厚酬劳.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Operation: Flattened Earth
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动: 焦土

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Part III of the Pirate Trilogy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗三部曲第III部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Queen' has requested our presence again. Claims we won't want to miss this. This Flashpoint is Long
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “女王”再次要求我们到场。她说我们不会想错过这个。这个闪点较长

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fortress Door
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 堡垒大门

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Betrayed by their own organization
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被自己的组织背叛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris gladiator has murdered my nephew, Arjun. With your help, I will see his killer brought to justice, Commander—make him suffer and I'll make you rich.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名索拉里斯角斗士谋杀了我的侄子阿尔琼。指挥官，在你的帮助下，我要让凶手受到审判——让他痛苦，我就让你富有。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Steel Beast
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢铁野兽

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have received a secret communication from Jade Falcon. They want us to test one of their new projects.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到了来自玉鹰的秘密通讯. 他们想让我们测试他们的一个新项目.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seems that Jade Falcon may be dabbling in forbiden technology. We have been invited to test some of this equipment out. THIS FLASHPOINT REQUIRES 4 LAM PILOTS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来翡翠猎鹰可能在涉足禁忌技术。我们受邀来测试其中一些装备。 本闪点需要4名LAM飞行员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Betrayed by their own organization
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被自己的组织背叛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Liao requires your assistance in the dismantling of a prominent crime syndicate. Working in concert with Capellan ground forces, you will capture the OpFor's personnel and seize their financial assets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 廖家族需要你协助瓦解一个显赫的犯罪辛迪加。与卡佩兰地面部队协同行动，你将俘获敌对方的人员并查封他们的金融资产。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Criminal Minds
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犯罪思维

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Betrayed by their own organization
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被自己的组织背叛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Davion seeks your assistance in a sensitive matter related to the security of our national borders. Expect a short deployment with exceptional salvage opportunities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩家族就一项涉及我国边境安全的敏感事务，请求贵方协助. 预计为短期部署，且附带极佳的残骸打捞机会.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Short Split Template
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短拆分模板

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. My name is Justin Allard. You don't know me, but I've heard a great deal about you. There is a small matter that I could use your assistance with, if you're so inclined. Meet me at your earliest convenience and we'll talk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。我叫贾斯汀·阿拉德。你不认识我，但我听过很多关于你的事。有件小事想请你帮忙，如果你愿意的话。你方便的时候来见我，我们谈谈。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bourbon & BattleMechs
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 波旁威士忌和战斗机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Steiner requires your assistance in leading a Davion-Steiner convoy across a broad swathe of hostile terrain. Payment will be remitted upon the safe delivery of the convoy's payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯坦纳家族需要你协助带领一支达维昂-施泰纳车队穿越一大片敌意地形。报酬将在车队货物安全送达后支付。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Joint Venture
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 合资企业

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Betrayed by their own organization
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被自己的组织背叛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You aren't gonna believe this, but Morgan Kell—the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],Morgan Kell]], of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKellHounds],Kell Hounds]]—wants us for a job. This isn't the sort of offer you say no to.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你不会相信，但摩根·凯尔——[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKellHounds],凯尔猎犬]]的那位[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],摩根·凯尔]]——想请我们干活。这种邀约你可不会拒绝。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We got a message from someone claiming they need our help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到一条消息，有人声称需要我们的帮助。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Received a Secret communication off channel. The Pirate Queen needs our help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到一条非公开的密语通讯。海盗女王需要我们的帮助。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are getting word that we are to return to Strana Mechty for an ancient ritual.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到消息，要返回斯特拉纳·梅克提参加一项古老仪式。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hot on the trail of the Pirate Queen, A discovery is made.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 紧追海盗女王的踪迹，一项发现浮出水面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It is finally time to take the fight back to the pirates.You should bring at least 6 pilots to this Flashpoint.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 终于到了把战斗打回海盗那边的时候了。你应当带至少6名飞行员参加这次闪点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Someone is causing Problems and blaming it on us. If we ignore this we may lose rep with the MRBC.Warning this Flashpoint is both Long and HARD
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有人在制造麻烦并栽赃给我们。如果我们置之不理，我们可能会在MRBC那里失掉声望。警告：本闪点既漫长又困难

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩家族请求贵方协助运输与交接一名高度敏感的囚犯. 款项将在囚犯移交我方后支付.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗认定一处防守薄弱的当地政府为目标。本闪点漫长

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a new contract posted to us. It says (Big Raid, Easy loot.) How they got this across the secure lines of MRBC I am not sure. This Flashpoint is Long.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到了发布给我们的一份新合约。上面写着（大劫掠，轻松打捞）。我不知道他们是怎么把这东西通过MRBC的安全线路传过来的。本闪点漫长。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take advantage of this planets sensor interference to approach enemy units unseen
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 利用该行星的传感器干扰，在不被发现的情况下接近敌方单位

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: TAKE CONTROL OF AT LEAST ONE STORAGE SILO
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 控制至少一座储料仓

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capturing more than one silo will help turn the tide for our employer, though even one will help...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺取一座以上发射井会更有助于扭转雇主的局面，虽然哪怕一座也会有所帮助……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the area has been cleared. Darius has given me the green light to land immediately. Hold position.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，该区域已清理完毕. 达吕斯已批准我立即着陆. 保持原地待命.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Explosive defusal is a go, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 开始拆除爆炸物，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Silo Charlie is under alert. Take it quickly, before they have time to destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Charlie储料仓拉响了警报. 赶在他们有时间摧毁它之前迅速拿下.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That silo is almost ready to blow!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那座储料仓就快要爆炸了!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defense: Itrom
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 防守: 伊特罗姆

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to Itrom to protect its people from the aggressors. The latest intel recommends a lance that balances speed and firepower, but can deal with Itrom's searing heat. Further details will be provided upon your arrival.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往伊特罗姆，保护其民众免受侵略者之害。最新情报建议组建一支兼顾速度与火力的分队，同时能应对伊特罗姆的灼热高温。抵达后将提供更多细节。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This planet has been under siege for a while. They are looking for some Mercs to protect the people from the aggressors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗星球已被围困一段时间了。他们正在找雇佣兵来保护民众免受侵略者侵害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭所有敌人

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁B隧道

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Hidden 摧毁所有单位

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方援军到达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect Sappers En Route to Pass Alpha
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在工兵前往A山口的途中保护他们

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect Sappers En Route to Pass Bravo
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在工兵前往B山口的途中保护他们

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the primary refinery facility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护主要精炼设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect The Refinery Complex
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护精炼厂建筑群

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostiles on the main approach, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主干道上出现敌人，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sapper Alpha reporting in. I am halfway to my destination and moving at full throttle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工兵A队报到. 我距离目的地还有一半路程，正在全速前进.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Agressors have been going after fuel processors and refineries throughout the badlands, Commander. The fission plants that power our cities rely on the materials that are produced and refined here—uranium, deuterium for heavy water, you name it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，侵略者一直在荒地各处追击燃料加工厂与炼油厂。为我们城市供电的裂变电厂依赖这里生产与精炼的材料——铀、用于重水的氘，诸如此类。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To the refinery! Go! Raze it to the ground and leave nothing standing!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 去精炼厂! 上! 把它夷为平地，什么都不要剩下!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Transport waypoint data uploaded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 运输车路径点数据已上传.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tunnel Alpha is toast, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A隧道已经被烤了，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Algea A Varient Quadvee, designed by Clan Hells Horse, is a force to be reckoned with. Equipped with 60 LRM tubes and a trio of ER medium lasers, this 100-ton assault mech is a versatile and deadly addition to any battlefield. With its impressive long-range capabilities and quick maneuverability, the Algea can rain down a barrage of missiles on enemies from afar or close in for devastating laser strikes. Its armor plating is reinforced with the latest materials and its engines are top of the line, ensuring both speed and protection. The Algea is a true feat of engineering and a testament to the ingenuity of its creator. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由地狱马部族设计的 Algea A 变型 QuadVee 是一支不可小觑的力量。这台 100 吨的突击机甲装备了 60 管 LRM 和三门增程中型激光，是任何战场上多才多艺且致命的战力。凭借出色的远程打击能力和灵活的机动性，Algea 可以从远处向敌人倾泻导弹弹幕，也能逼近目标施以致命的激光打击。其装甲板采用最新材料强化，引擎也是顶级配置，兼顾速度与防护。Algea 是真正的工程杰作，也是其设计者智慧的明证。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea A
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚 A

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea A
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚 A

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Variant B of the Algea Quadvee is equipped with 36 SRM tubes and a single ER medium laser. While it sacrifices some of the long-range capabilities of the original Prime variant, it excels in close combat situations with its impressive missile loadout. The single ER medium laser provides additional firepower for mid-range engagements. With its 100-ton weight and sturdy construction, the Algea Variant B is a formidable opponent on any battlefield. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Algea 四足变形车辆的 B 型配备 36 个 SRM 发射管和一具增程中型激光。它牺牲了原始 Prime 型的一部分远程能力，却凭借可观的导弹搭载量在近距离战斗中表现突出。单独一具增程中型激光为中距离交战提供了额外火力。凭借 100 吨的重量和坚固的结构，Algea B 型在任何战场上都是令人生畏的对手。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea B
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚 B

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea B
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚 B

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Algea Variant C was designed as a highly mobile skirmisher, utilizing its top speed of 64kph to engage enemies at range with its primary weapon, a Rotary Autocannon 5. It also boasts a quad array of ER medium lasers for additional firepower. While lacking in heavier weaponry, its lighter weight and speed make it a formidable opponent in the hands of a skilled pilot. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Algea 的 C 变型被设计为高机动游击机甲，凭借 64kph 的最高速度，以主武器一门旋转自动炮 5 在远距离与敌交战。它还拥有四联装增程中型激光阵列以增强火力。虽然缺乏更重的武器，但它较轻的重量与速度使其在熟练机师手中成为可怕的对手。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea C
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚 C

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea C
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚 C

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Algea's advanced targeting systems and enhanced sensor suite make it a formidable opponent, capable of engaging multiple targets simultaneously with deadly precision. Its armored hull, reinforced by cutting-edge composite materials, offers unparalleled protection against enemy fire, while its sophisticated ECM suite can disrupt enemy communications and sensors, rendering them ineffective against its onslaught. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Algea 先进的瞄准系统和增强型传感器套件使它成为一名令人生畏的对手，能够以致命的精度同时应对多个目标。其装甲外壳由尖端复合材料强化，对敌方火力提供无与伦比的防护；而精密的电子对抗套件则能干扰敌方的通讯与传感器，使其在它的猛攻面前形同虚设。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea Prime
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚主型号

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algea Prime
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔盖亚主型号

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 1G 多才多艺而强大，是现存最知名的战斗机甲之一。它通常装备多样化的能量武器阵列，能在任何距离接敌，打击力很强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: BattleMaster BLR-1G
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 BLR-1G

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3141 on the King of the Mountain Arena and piloted by Adrienne Caselotti, this variant of the Calliope packs a pair of Streak SRM-4, supported by a Clan ER PPC augmented by a PPC Capacitor and a Clan Improved Heavy Medium Laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型于3141年在“山之王”竞技场首次亮相，由阿德里安娜·卡塞洛蒂驾驶。卡利俄佩的这款变型装有2具连发SRM-4，并辅以1门加装PPC电容器的部族增程粒子炮和1门部族改进型重型中型激光。 <特性：易于维护 <投放费用倍率：1.02 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Calliope CAL-1MAFSW 'Snow White'
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡利俄佩 CAL-1MAFSW '白雪'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Occam's Missile
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥卡姆导弹

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Occam's Missile
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥卡姆导弹

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离交战，其伤害曲线随接近目标而上升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rhythm Nation
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 节奏国度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rhythm Nation
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 节奏国度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款定制Solaris改型于3128年在Noisiel首次登场，先后由Natalia Porter及其女儿Carolyn Fischer驾驶。这型Clint IIC的升级一反部族改装内层星域机体的潮流。它以部族制造的骨架为起点，拆除了跳跃推进器以更改武器配置。它保留了那两门部族增程中型激光，并把部族LB 10-X AC换成一门大型可变速度脉冲激光与一门中型再工程激光，再将它们全部连接至一具部族瞄准计算机。标准平板装甲则替换为实弹强化装甲。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom chassis based on the Cougar is apparently an attempt by the Jade Falcons to use experimental technology in a combat unit. Unlike the early prototype designated the Cougar XR, this unit actually is a fully developed Land Air Mech. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一基于美洲狮的定制底盘显然是玉猫部族在战斗单位上使用实验技术的尝试。与早期被编号为美洲狮XR的原型不同，此单位实际上是一台完整开发的地空机甲。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cougar LAM XR
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮 LAM XR

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cougar LAM XR
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮 LAM XR

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely hybridized brawler built from the husk of a CRB-20. Bogdan ''The Steel Beast'' Tubbs had the Big Steel Claw's chassis rebuilt to support the mounting of ballistic weaponry, presumably in the interest of creating a louder and more violent spectacle in the arena. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款由CRB-20残骸打造出的独特混合式斗士。博格丹·“钢铁野兽”·塔布斯让人重建了大钢爪的底盘，以支撑弹道武器的安装，想必是为了在竞技场中制造更响亮、更暴力的场面。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crab CRB-20-BSC
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 螃蟹CRB-20-BSC

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crab CRB-20-BSC
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 螃蟹CRB-20-BSC

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 1N 是一台结实的机器，能承受重击，但武器略显单薄。不过它作为重型机甲移动很快，这使它非常适合逼近较慢的目标进行近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Awesome Dragon
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卓越 Dragon

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Awesome Dragon
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卓越 Dragon

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets—a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮与巨型激光的沉重威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来——这是致命的组合。它能在中远距离一直到抵近射击的交战，这些机甲在战斗中灵活而令人意外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enforcer ENF-4R
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 执法者 ENF-4R

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry—even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者 3F 装备的武器数量即便对突击机甲而言也荒唐得多。它还以极其糟糕的散热管理著称，这是它为如此惊人的伤害输出付出的代价。强大，但需明智使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stalker STK-3F
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者 STK-3F

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机于 3144 年在田纳西河谷竞技场首次亮相，由玛丽·科斯塔驾驶。这台机器上最引人注目的技术是虚空信号系统，其次是取代了原有卡佩兰式星盾隐形装甲的部族规格铁纤维装甲，以及十一台双散热器。武器方面，原本的双联 MML-3 变成了一具 MML-9 发射器，同时该机甲舍弃轻型粒子炮，换用更多增程中型激光（现为三门）。鱼鹰主动探测器被取消，改为一具改进型纳克导弹信标。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 1N 利用跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全处向对手投掷火力。不过，如果它们整场都在战场上蹦跳打冷枪，也可能过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Griffin was introduced to the Taurian Concordat. It carries a Plasma Cannon and three ER medium lasers. It also has a higher top speed than its inspiration and can jump farther as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台狮鹫是为金牛座协约国推出的。它装备一门等离子炮和三门增程中型激光，最高速度也比其灵感来源更快，跳跃距离也更远。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Griffin GRF-4N
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫GRF-4N

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Gundam is a testament to cutting-edge technology and raw power. With advanced weapons and mobility systems, this machine is built for domination on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior provides unrivaled protection from enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent for any force that stands in its way. The Gundam is a technological marvel, and the pilots who use it should be ready for a high-powered and efficient machine. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高达是尖端技术与原始力量的证明。凭借先进武器与机动系统，这台机器为统治战场而生。其厚重装甲外壳提供无与伦比的防护，使它成为任何阻挡者的可怕对手。高达是技术奇迹，驾驶它的飞行员应准备好迎接一台高性能、高效率的机器。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gundam LAM GM-1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高达 LAM GM-1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gundam LAM GM-1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高达 LAM GM-1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Gundam is a testament to cutting-edge technology and raw power. With advanced weapons and mobility systems, this machine is built for domination on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior provides unrivaled protection from enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent for any force that stands in its way. The Gundam is a technological marvel, and the pilots who use it should be ready for a high-powered and efficient machine. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2775 as Aleksander Kerensky's forces were tightening the noose around the Amaris Empire, weapons development became increasingly frantic in hopes of finding a miracle weapon to turn the tides of the war. The most well known of these is the Matar, commonly referred to as Amaris' Folly, an attempt to create a BattleMech able to withstand an entire company. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multi-role brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes—but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座K是第一台真正的重型机甲。作为多面手斗士，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，并凭充足装甲在复合火力下存活相当长的时间。它确实慢——但很强。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹 9R 是扎实的全能机甲，只是稍偏慢。它靠跳跃推进器、可观的装甲和标志性 PPC 的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于近身肉搏，效果不俗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3144 on the Hartford Gardens Arena and piloted by Robert Benson, The Beast is a remote-operated drone controlled from the copilot seat of the Watchman known as Belle and may well be a triumph of modern military technology. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野兽于3144年在哈特福德花园竞技场首次亮相，由罗伯特·本森驾驶。它是一架遥控无人机，从名为“美人”的守夜人副驾驶座上操控，很可能代表了现代军事技术的一项成就。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuted in 3141 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Ira Kuhn-Bedard, the variant keeps the best features of this hundred-year-old machine and make it even better. With Clan Ferro-Lamellor Armor improving its resistance to nearly all forms of damage and combined with a Clan-spec XL Engine model instead of the original Inner Sphere one to improve endurance. MASC boosting its land speed, and four Clan ER Medium Lasers replacing all the original weaponry. A Hatchet has been fitted to make it more Solaris Games enabled. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型于 3141 年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由伊拉·库恩-贝达德驾驶；它保留了这具百年老机体最优秀的特点，并使其更加出色。部族铁鳞装甲提升了它对几乎所有伤害形式的抵抗力，同时以部族规格的 XL 引擎取代原本的内层星域型号，以增强耐久性。MASC 提升了它的地面速度，四门部族中型增程激光则替换了原有的全部武器。此外还加装了一把战斧，使其更适应 Solaris 竞技赛。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵亚历山大由安吉莉克·克劳指导、为兹尔布里根马疚研制，融合了部族与内层星域的实验技术，打造出一台独一无二的机甲。它采用部族制造的XL引擎以保持高速，并腾出空间安装更多装备。跳跃推进器、内骨架结构和短管粒子炮均为内层星域制造，而两具增程中型激光、铁纤维装甲和一对部分翼则出自部族之手。这对部分翼将幽灵的跳跃距离提升至270米。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Reinforcement Capabilities
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁增援能力

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We will only have a short amount of time to get to the control station to disable the landing pads, Make sure the 'Mechs you drop with have enough speed Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们只有很短时间来抵达控制站并瘫痪着陆平台，指挥官，确保你投放的机甲速度足够。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Defending army has a starport nearby. We have been contracted to disable the starport so the defending army will be cut off from their reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 防守方在附近有一处星港。我们已签约要瘫痪该星港，使防守军与其增援隔绝。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在工程师到达前消灭守备部队单位

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭守备部队单位

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Hidden 驻防部队警告标志

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏触发:主力警报

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take control of the Defender's turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺取防守方的炮塔控制权

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All targets eliminated. Sit tight, and I can collect you from where you are at right now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有目标都消灭了. 原地别动，我现在就去你们的位置接你们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bring down the Control Center and the rest will be easy Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干掉控制中心，剩下就好办了，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defense: Panzyr
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 防守: 潘济尔

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We had to deal with hunger back home. Stealing food from starving people is low.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们老家也得应付饥饿。从挨饿的人手里偷食物，太下作了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aggressors are attacking our famine relief effort on this planet. If they succeed, mass starvation will follow. They're trying to bait me into redirecting the main army and taking the field myself… but I can't let them do that. If our people are to survive, you will have to save them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侵略者正在攻击我们在这颗星球上的饥荒救济行动。若他们得逞，大规模饥荒将随之而来。他们想引我把主力调走、亲自上阵……但我不能让他们得逞。若要我们的人活下来，你必须救他们。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭所有进攻者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate all APCs to Bring the Turrets Back Online
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭所有装甲运兵车，令炮台重新上线

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏 Heavy Timer

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第 3 波的隐藏计时器

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第 4 波的隐藏计时器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent Commando APCs from Reaching the Command Center
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止突击队的装甲运兵车到达指挥中心

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the spaceport's Command Center from the Agressors' advance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抵御侵略者的推进，保卫太空港指挥中心

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stop the APC from Reaching the Barracks
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止装甲运兵车到达兵营

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hurry, Commander! Get those turrets back online!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快点，指挥官! 让那些炮台重新上线!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thank you for trying to save them. I know that you did everything you could.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谢谢你试图拯救他们. 我知道你已经尽力了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This planet is in desperate shape, Commander. Famine is a fact of life here, and the Agressors have targeted the spaceport we've been using to deliver emergency supplies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗行星的状况岌岌可危，指挥官。饥荒在这里是生活的常态，而侵略者把目标对准了我们一直用来运送紧急物资的太空港。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Those transports cannot be allowed to take this spaceport! Whatever it takes, we must push them back!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不能让那些运输车拿下太空港! 不管它要占领什么，我们都必须把他们打回去!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pirate Queen
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗女王

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Corporate Secrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 公司机密

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Locate the scientist. She'll need to ride along in one of the mechs, so keep that mech safe until extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 找到那位科学家。她需要搭乘其中一台机甲，所以要保证那台机甲安全直到撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I think I've lost track of how many layers of betrayal this represents. Is this a quadruple-cross? This must be some scientist.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已经数不清这是第几层背叛了。这是四重反水？这位科学家可真不简单。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} conglomerate has turned industrial spy for a rival corporation from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. She was privy to numerous industrial secrets that we would prefer not to fall into our competitor's hands. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell her back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to extract the scientist through more proactive means.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}企业集团的科学家的为来自{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的对手公司充当了工业间谍。她掌握着大量我们不愿落入竞争对手之手的工业机密。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层提出把她卖回给我们，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望为你争取时间，让你通过更主动的手段把这位科学家救出来。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领指定区域来回收科学家

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recover the Secondary Asset by securing the Secondary Designated Area
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领次要指定区域来回收第二项资产

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}'s double-crossing scientist and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接回 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} 那位两面三刀的科学家并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, commander. The wayward {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientist is on her way home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 这个任性的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}科学家在回家的路上了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sumire will be waiting for your signal to pick you up. Best of luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苏米尔会等候你的信号来接应你. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There it is. Move up and occupy the facility, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是那儿了. 行动起来占领设施，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the region where the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility is located.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个区域就是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施所在的位置.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Embassy Extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 撤出大使

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The enemy has to be expecting an attempt to break their siege, so there will be significant resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌人肯定会料到有人要尝试图突破他们的包围，所以会有激烈抵抗.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of our VIPs is in a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need to get her offworld, but the building is surrounded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. You will sweep aside the opposition, recover our VIP, and transport her to a designated landing zone for extraction. Be prepared for opposition - the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units surrounding the embassy won't let you extract our personnel without a fight. Payment will be issued when you deliver our VIP alive and in one piece.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一位贵宾在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施里。我们需要把她送出行星，但那栋建筑被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队包围。你要清扫对手，接回我们的贵宾，并把她送到指定着陆区撤离。为遭遇抵抗做好准备——包围使馆的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队不会让你安然带走我们的人员。当贵宾活着、完好地送到时，报酬即行支付。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, this should be a straightforward retrieval mission: get in, acquire the VIP, and get back out again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好了，这应该是一次简单明了的回收任务: 进去，找到VIP，然后再撤出来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once you have the VIP in hand, get her to the designated landing zone for extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦你掌握了VIP，就带她前往指定的着陆区撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The VIP is secure, Commander - well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VIP安全了，指挥官--做得不错.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Smash and Grab
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强夺行动

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if this is the real thing, it's going to be defended like you can't even imagine. This one will be tough.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果这是真货，它的防守会超乎你的想象。这一场会很难。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defector has given us an extremely interesting and time-sensitive piece of information, and we need a fast response. Before joining our side, this defector worked at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on this planet. She claims she was responsible for extracting data from a device that sounds, from her descriptions, very much like a Star League era memory core. We don't know what data is on it, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} cannot be allowed to keep it.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}叛逃者给了我们一条极其有趣且时效紧迫的情报，我们需要快速反应。在投向我们这边之前，这名叛逃者在这颗行星上的一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施工作。她声称自己负责从一个装置中提取数据，从她的描述看，那东西非常像星盟时代的记忆核心。我们不知道上面是什么数据，但不能让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}留着它。[警告：丧尸]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not much to say, Commander. Shoot to kill.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, and no prisoners.[WARNING: Zombies]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲小队一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们烧毁居民点、焚烧农田与炼油厂、劫掠仓储设施。他们显然在尽其所能把我们的人赶走。这是纯粹的恐怖主义。我们需要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不要俘虏。[警告：丧尸]

We'd like you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it.[WARNING: Zombies]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The spaceport in front of you is packed wall-to-wall with civilians, most of them refugees from the capital. The Agressors have been targeting them as enemy combatants. I need your help to keep those people safe until we can evac them to safety.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] sprints into the Command Center, excitedly waving a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMRBC],MercNet]] bulletin.

\"Commander, a bounty was just posted against a paramilitary group known as The Raptors, and it appears they're here in this system. I've always suspected they were really pirates and it looks like they finally crossed the line. For years I've hoped to have a chance at taking them down, but they've always proved too clever. No more.\"


[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],Darius]] looks over the bulletin, his eyes twinkling as he gets to the numbers at the bottom. \"Say the word Commander, and we'll hit the Raptors hard and collect this bounty. Should be a pretty good payday! The bounty is set at 250,000 c-bills on top of whatever we can salvage on-site.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]冲进指挥中心，兴奋地挥舞着一份[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMRBC],雇佣网]]公告。

"指挥官，刚刚发布了一笔针对一个叫"猛禽"的准军事团体的赏金，而他们似乎就在这个星系。我一直怀疑他们其实是海盗，看来他们终于越了线。多年来我一直盼望有机会干掉他们，但他们总是太狡猾。不会再有下次了。"

[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],达里乌斯]]看着公告，当目光落到最下面的数字时眼睛发亮。"你一句话，指挥官，我们就把猛禽狠狠打一顿并领走这笔赏金。应该是笔相当可观的进账！赏金定为25万C币，外加我们在现场能打捞到的一切。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Soarece was an experimental superheavy combat vehicle produced for the Free Worlds League in the early decades of the Third Succession War. The design was commissioned by then-Captain-General Philippa Marik in 2881. It was envisioned as a low-cost, highly survivable design that could engage BattleMechs and equip the League's depleted defensive formations . It would be over two decades (2904) until the final form of this design was settled, by which time it had become a mammoth of a tank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Limited Amphibious Values A S Front 770 126 Left 660 126 Right 660 126 Rear 350 126 Turret 760 126 Total 3200 630 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索阿雷斯是一款实验性超重型战斗车辆，于第三次继承战争最初几十年为自由世界联盟生产。该设计由时任总上将菲利帕·马里克于2881年下令研制，设想为一种低成本、高生存性的设计，可对抗战斗机甲并装备联盟损耗严重的防御编队。直到二十多年后（2904年），该设计的最终形态才确定下来，此时它已成了一头庞然巨兽般的坦克。 生态限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：有限两栖 数值 A S 正面 770 126 左侧 660 126 右侧 660 126 后方 350 126 炮塔 760 126 总计 3200 630 特性：精准武器 - 弹道
